english_value: A sword based enchantment which deals additional damage which will bypass protection. Each level deals an additional half heart of damage.

english_value: A sword based enchantment which gives the damaged mob poison. Each level increases the power of the poison effect applied.
zh_tw: 一種劍類附魔，會使受傷的生物中毒。每提升一級，所施加的中毒效果就更強。

english_value: Note: This item/block has been added to help achieve compatibility with other mods. As of now these do not do anything and are not an ordinary part of this mod. No new ores or tools will be added this is ONLY for for mod compatibility.

english_value: This enchantmentwill do 3 fire damage to mobs within 2.4 blocks of the damaged mob. Both the player and the target mob will not be set on fire.
zh_tw: 此附魔會對受傷生物周圍 2.4 格內的生物造成 3 點火焰傷害。玩家與目標生物都不會被點燃。

english_value: This enchantmentwill warp the player where they are looking when used. This effect has a range of 18 blocks per level. This enchantmentwill damage the item by 50 points every time it is used. The player will also take 1 damage in fall damage.
zh_tw: 此附魔會在使用時將玩家傳送到其視線所指之處。此效果每級範圍為 18 格。此附魔每次使用都會使物品損耗 50 點耐久。玩家同時也會受到 1 點摔落傷害。

english_value: This enchantmenthas a 15% chance of activating when the player is hit. When activated the player will warp to a random mob within 30 blocks. This mob may not always be friendly. If no mob is found then the effect will be canceled.
zh_tw: 此附魔在玩家受到攻擊時有 15% 的機率觸發。觸發後，玩家會傳送到 30 格內的隨機生物身邊。該生物不一定是友善的。若找不到任何生物，則效果會被取消。

english_value: This enchantmentwill propel targeted mobs upwards into the air. Hit the mob before it hits the ground to make increase the launch aspect of the effect exponential amount.
zh_tw: 此附魔會將被鎖定的生物向上推入空中。在生物落地前再次擊中它，可使彈射效果呈指數倍增。

english_value: This enchantmentwill cause the player to fall at a much slower rate than normal. To activate the effect press and hold shift.
zh_tw: 此附魔會使玩家以遠低於正常的速度下落。按住 Shift 以啟動效果。

english_value: This enchantmentwill blind the target mob for 1.5 seconds. There is also a 12% chance that the wither effect will be applied for a second.
zh_tw: 此附魔會使目標生物失明 1.5 秒。另有 12% 的機率對其施加 1 秒的凋零效果。

english_value: This enchantmentwill kill all mobs on the map that are an instance of the target mob. This can be used on boats to kill all boats in the world and can be used to manage entities in the world. This effect will not target players.
zh_tw: 此附魔會殺死地圖上所有屬於目標生物同類的生物。可用於船隻以殺死世界中所有的船，也可用來管理世界中的實體。此效果不會以玩家為目標。

Research can get boring and tedious sometimes.There's only so many hours you can spend taking apart bits of cobblestone in the sad hope of finding esoteric insights before you start considering a change in careers.

Thankfully,you've devised a way to expedite the process.The Crystal Scribing Tools contain a small pool of esoteric knowledge which will slowly be transferred into your mind as you carry them around.

Your chakras are going to be SO aligned!

english_value: My name is Tiberius. I was a kid when the demons came for my village during The Wars. They ransacked the houses and turned the shacks into splinters, wielding fire and water to blast the land asunder. I woke up to some traveling merchants who were passing by, equipping the warriors who were futilely trying to drive off the demons that still clawed the village. I was brought to a nearby village, where a magician named Magus helped tend to my wounds. The magic that he used was something that I had never seen before - it wasn't Thaumaturgy, nor Alchemy, and it was definitely not Botany. He winked at me once he saw that my eyes were open, holding his finger to his lips. Fast-forward several years, and I have learned almost everything from Master Magus, being his third student ever to master his arts. Against his wishes, I have recorded my research and put several wards and spells on this book. So welcome, apprentice. I am known as The Architect, and I am a Blood Mage. It took several years of pestering before I managed to convince Magus to teach me. He kept on telling me that, "Magic that uses the life essence of living beings requires patience and preparation in order to master it. One false move, go a little past your natural endurance, and you may find yourself taking a nice vacation in Tartarus." The thing was, I wanted to go there - I had some unfinished business with the demons. The process that Magus originally constructed required powerful artifacts that he constructed himself, but were rather lacking where teaching was concerned. After studying a bit of alchemy and the process of "Equivalent Exchange", I managed to construct myself an altar that would transmute items inside of its basin into new powerful forms. The only issue was that it needed a worthy catalyst, and so with a prick of the finger I set the Blood Altar alight!
zh_tw: 我的名字是 Tiberius。當惡魔在戰爭期間襲擊我的村莊時，我還只是個孩子。它們洗劫了房屋，把棚屋轟成碎片，操縱火與水把大地炸得四分五裂。我醒來時，身邊是幾位路過的行商，他們正在為徒勞地想把仍在村裡肆虐的惡魔趕走的戰士們配備裝備。我被帶到附近的一座村莊，一位名叫 Magus 的魔法師替我治療傷口。他使用的魔法是我從未見過的——既不是神秘學，也不是煉金術，更絕對不是植物學。他見我睜開眼睛，對我眨了眨眼，並把手指按在唇上。時光飛逝，幾年過去，我已從 Master Magus 那裡學會了幾乎一切，成為他有史以來第三位精通其技藝的學生。違背他的意願，我把我的研究記錄下來，並在這本書上施加了幾道結界與法術。所以，歡迎你，學徒。我被稱為「建築師」，我是一名血法師。我纏了他好幾年，才說服 Magus 教我。他總是對我說：「運用生靈生命本質的魔法，需要耐心與準備才能精通。只要一步走錯，稍微超出你天生的承受極限，你就可能發現自己正在 Tartarus 度一場不錯的假期。」問題是，我想去那裡——我與惡魔們還有未了的恩怨。Magus 當初構築的過程需要他親手打造的強大神器，但在教學方面卻相當欠缺。在研究了一些煉金術以及「等價交換」的過程之後，我成功為自己打造了一座祭壇，能將盆中的物品轉化為全新而強大的形態。唯一的問題是，它需要一個合適的催化劑，於是我刺破指尖，點燃了血祭壇！
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: To start any form of transmutation involving blood, you would need to construct a blood altar and a sacrificial knife, as well as have a solitary diamond in your possession. After placing the blood altar down, Magus advised me to be careful as I filled it slowly with my blood, and said that I would need to be really close to the altar (about a meter) for the knife to work. With about 2 buckets of blood in the altar, which Master Magus reminds me is about 10 hearts worth, I placed the diamond inside of the altar by activating it with the diamond in hand.
zh_tw: 要開始任何涉及血液的轉化，你需要建造一座血祭壇和一把獻祭匕首，並且持有一顆孤零零的鑽石。放好血祭壇之後，Magus 提醒我要小心，要慢慢地用自己的血把它注滿，還說我必須非常靠近祭壇（大約一公尺），匕首才會起作用。當祭壇裡有了大約 2 桶血（Master Magus 提醒我，這大約相當於 10 顆心）之後，我手持鑽石啟動祭壇，將鑽石放了進去。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The blood dissipated in a cloud of red swirls as I waited for the atoms of the diamond to shift and reform. There were a few moments where the particles turned gray, which meant that the altar was empty and I had to hurry to fill it. After the diamond burst in a shower of red particles, what finally sat in the altar was a Weak Blood Orb.
zh_tw: 我等待著鑽石的原子位移並重組，血液則化作一團紅色漩渦消散。有那麼幾刻，粒子變成了灰色，那表示祭壇空了，我必須趕緊把它填滿。鑽石在一陣紅色粒子的噴發中爆開之後，祭壇裡最終留下的是一顆虛弱血球。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: One thing that I initially didn't understand was the overarching connection between the blood orb and myself. When I initially met Magus, I could see many sparkling strands branching off of him, flowing throughout his house and linking with intricate stones and runic drawings. I asked Magus about the strands, but he had no clue what I was talking about. It took three years of thorough research to finally find the answer, and when I brought my notes to him he was really impressed with what I have found. When you send power into the orb, the energy is transmitted from the strand connecting the orb and into the very soul of the person the orb is bound to. Similarly, and Magus managed to show this effect with several of his rituals, when you use something that drains energy it will drain the energy directly from the soul. The thing is that if you use an item whose owner has no energy left, the item will instead grab the requisite energy from the user of the item. Directly. From his or her life force. As such, the unit of measurement is called "Life Points", or LP. I experimented with this, and one heart equals 200 LP. I have christened this system to be the "Soul Network", and it is used in all branches of Blood Magic indirectly.
zh_tw: 起初我不明白的一件事，是血球與我之間那種無所不在的連結。剛認識 Magus 時，我能看見許多閃閃發光的絲線從他身上分出去，貫穿他的整間屋子，並與精巧的石頭和符文圖樣相連。我向 Magus 問起那些絲線，他卻完全不知道我在說什麼。我花了三年縝密的研究才終於找到答案，當我把筆記拿給他看時，他對我的發現讚嘆不已。當你把力量注入血球時，能量會順著連接血球的絲線，傳入血球所綁定之人的靈魂之中。同樣地——Magus 以他的幾種儀式展示了這個效果——當你使用會消耗能量的東西時，它會直接從靈魂中汲取能量。問題在於，如果你使用的物品，其擁有者已經沒有能量了，那麼該物品就會轉而從使用者身上奪取所需的能量。直接地。從他或她的生命力中。因此，這個計量單位被稱為「生命點數」，即 LP。我對此做過實驗，一顆心等於 200 LP。我把這個系統命名為「靈魂網路」，它間接地被用於血魔法的所有分支之中。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Magus is a master at rituals. His power in the intricate layering of stones and inks is unmatched. The problem is that these rituals are rather... static in nature. Sure, being able to call the bounty of the earth to the surface is all fine and dandy, but won't exactly protect you when you are on fire. To this end, I decided to link my soul network to powerful items that I have created. To start, I decided to transmute a piece of smooth stone in the Blood Altar with just 1kLP to create a blank slate.
zh_tw: Magus 是儀式大師。他在石頭與墨水的精細層疊上所展現的力量無人能及。問題在於，這些儀式本質上相當……靜態。當然，能把大地的恩賜召喚到地表是很棒，但當你身上著火時，它可幫不上什麼忙。為此，我決定把我的靈魂網路連結到我所打造的強大物品上。首先，我決定在血祭壇中用僅僅 1kLP 轉化一塊平滑石頭，製作出一塊空白石板。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The first thing I did was to arrange the blank slate with some reflective glass and my Weak Blood Orb. Pouring my power into the configuration created a Divination Sigil, which I could link to my network and see how much power that my soul network holds. What is more, holding the sigil to the Blood Altar flooded my mind with information, giving me the knowledge about its current tier, capacity, and even how much it was holding. Happy with the sigil, I brought a fresh unbound one to Master Magus for him to use. When I took the divination sigil back in my hands and tried to use it to view his network, for some reason I could not glean any information from him. I don't really see why this is, considering that I used this same method for other people and I saw that they had no power at all, but to glean actually... nothing from Magus is strange.
zh_tw: 我做的第一件事，是把空白石板與一些反光玻璃以及我的虛弱血球排列在一起。將我的力量注入這個配置後，產生了一枚占卜印記，我可以把它連結到我的網路，查看我的靈魂網路蘊含了多少力量。更棒的是，將印記對著血祭壇，就會有大量資訊湧入我的腦海，讓我得知它目前的等級、容量，甚至裡面存了多少。對這枚印記很滿意之後，我拿了一枚全新、未綁定的給 Master Magus 使用。當我把占卜印記拿回手上，試圖用它查看他的網路時，不知為何我什麼資訊都讀不到。我實在不明白這是為什麼，畢竟我對其他人用過同樣的方法，也看到他們一點力量都沒有，但從 Magus 身上讀到的竟然真的……什麼都沒有，這就很奇怪了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I've been training my body, lately. Master Magus told me that in order to extract most of my power, I have to get my mind, soul, and body into as perfect shape as possible. Even though my mind takes time to hone, and my soul requires methods I have yet mastered to strengthen, my body is something I can actively manage. No more cookies for me, apparently, since they have horrible saturation for the work I do. And it's hard to grow cocoa right now, anyway. The temperature is ridiculously high, and with it the humidity is pretty freaking low. Some bright spark of a thaumaturge got it into their head that it would be good to open up the Obelisk to the far north of the village, and because of it a large influx of taint spewed forth from the eldritch tomb. It looks like someone wasn't focusing enough on their sanity training! Thankfully Master Magus decided to head out to the site up north with a few stones and a new vat of ink, saying over his shoulder that he had a new ritual that he'd like to test to fix the problem.
zh_tw: 最近我一直在鍛鍊身體。Master Magus 告訴我，要發揮出我大部分的力量，我必須讓心智、靈魂與身體都處於盡可能完美的狀態。儘管心智需要時間磨練，而靈魂需要我尚未掌握的方法來強化，但身體卻是我可以主動管理的。顯然我不能再吃餅乾了，因為它們對我所做的工作而言飽足感差得可怕。而且現在也很難種可可。氣溫高得離譜，濕度則低得見鬼。某位自作聰明的神秘使腦子一熱，覺得開啟村莊遙遠北方的方尖碑會是個好主意，結果一大股汙穢從那座詭異的墓穴中噴湧而出。看來有人在理智訓練上不夠專心啊！幸好 Master Magus 決定帶著幾塊石頭和一桶新的墨水前往北邊的現場，他頭也不回地說他有一個想試試看的新儀式，可以解決這個問題。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: In the meantime, I was tasked to create something to fix our water problem. I thought about perhaps cooling the environment around the village in order to condense the water in the air, or perhaps find a way to create rain - neither of which I would be able to accomplish, because I'm sure that either task would take more than the 5 kLP capacity I currently have with my blood orb. So, I had to think small. At my desk, I mixed some dirt into the spare water I had for experimentation and started to paint on one of the blank slates I recently created to layer a bit of a base. Once I was satisfied, I took a bunch of buckets (to be safe in case that what I did would fail) and arranged them around the damp slate and then took my orb from the chest nearby. I then tapped the orb onto the slate, and the water started to boil and swirl out of the surrounding buckets, rushing into the slate! After a quick, bright flash, the new sigil lay steaming on the table in a puddle of water. Thankfully the sigil was what I needed. I could link it to my network and place water wherever I wanted by simply tapping it on the ground. The water was pricy, requiring a full 100 LP for each bucket's worth that I created in the world, but for an infinite supply of water, creeping upwards to 50 full buckets for my puny network was something that I desperately needed. It's just a shame that it started to rain an hour after I created the sigil.
zh_tw: 同時，我被交付了一項任務：做出能解決我們缺水問題的東西。我想過也許可以降低村莊周圍環境的溫度，讓空氣中的水氣凝結，或者想辦法製造降雨——但這兩件事我都辦不到，因為我確定無論哪一件，所需的力量都會超過我的血球目前擁有的 5 kLP 容量。所以，我得從小處著手。我在書桌前把一些泥土混進實驗用的備用水中，並開始在我最近做好的一塊空白石板上塗抹，鋪上一層底料。滿意之後，我拿了一堆桶子（以防萬一我做的東西失敗），把它們排列在濕潤的石板周圍，然後從附近的箱子裡取出我的血球。接著我用血球輕觸石板，水便開始沸騰並從周圍的桶子中旋轉湧出，衝進石板裡！一道短暫而明亮的閃光之後，新的印記躺在桌上一灘水中冒著蒸氣。幸好這枚印記正是我所需要的。我可以把它連結到我的網路，只要用它輕觸地面，就能在任何我想要的地方放出水來。這水的代價不菲，我在世界中每製造一桶水就需要整整 100 LP，但對於我這小小的網路而言，擁有能無限供應水、最多可達 50 滿桶的來源，正是我迫切需要的。只可惜，在我做出這枚印記一小時後，就下雨了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: There was an explosion in the lab today as I was trying to work out a few more artifacts. When I tried to infuse a few buckets of lava with my power, and used some glass to contain the effect, the assembly simply burst into flames and flew me across the workshop. I wasn't really hurt, and thankfully my water sigil was used promptly to put out the fires, however it seemed that my experiment failed rather heartily. Apparently I needed just a little bit more time, however, since I got it to work a week after. By combining some glass and Obsidian together with a few buckets of lava, and throwing in my blood orb and a diamond to hold it all together, the diamond was transmuted into a fiery crystal that seemed to... do nothing at all. I peeked out from behind the blast shield, since by then I learned that playing with lava was not the safest of hobbies, and gingerly linked the crystal to my network. As soon as the pact was completed, I felt a wave of heat emanate from the crystal, and promptly tossed it into a furnace before it could burn my fingers. I was unsuccessful on that front. The furnace immediately kindled, and the pork that was sitting in the top slot began to cook quickly. Quickly feeling a wave of nausea, I checked my network out and found that I had nothing left to offer. Once I pulled the blasted thing out of the furnace and stuffed it into a chest, the nausea subsided. So this Lava Crystal could work in any sort of furnace and feed off of the owner's network, but if the network was dry it would instead cause the owner to feel a hearty blast of nausea unless removed from the solid fuel-burning machine. Good to know, since now I know of a way to trade my services with the blacksmiths in the village.
zh_tw: 今天實驗室裡發生了一場爆炸，當時我正試著研究出更多神器。我嘗試用我的力量灌注幾桶熔岩，並用一些玻璃來限制效果，結果整個裝置直接燒了起來，把我炸飛到工坊另一頭。我並沒有真的受傷，所幸我的水之印記及時用來撲滅了火焰，不過看來我的實驗是慘敗收場。顯然我只是還需要一點時間，因為一週後我讓它成功了。我把一些玻璃和黑曜石與幾桶熔岩組合在一起，再放入我的血球和一顆鑽石把這一切固定在一起，鑽石就被轉化成一顆火焰般的水晶，但它似乎……什麼也沒做。我從防爆屏障後面探出頭，因為到這時我已經學到，玩熔岩並不是最安全的嗜好，然後小心翼翼地把水晶連結到我的網路。契約一完成，我就感到一股熱浪從水晶散發出來，於是趕緊把它扔進熔爐，免得燒到我的手指。我在這方面並不成功。熔爐立刻燃了起來，放在上方格子裡的豬肉也開始迅速烹煮。我隨即感到一陣噁心，查看網路後發現我已經沒有任何東西可以提供了。我把這該死的東西從熔爐中拿出來塞進箱子後，噁心感就消退了。所以這顆熔岩水晶可以在任何一種熔爐中運作，並從擁有者的網路中汲取能量；但如果網路乾涸了，它就會讓擁有者感到一陣強烈的噁心，除非把它從燃燒固體燃料的機器中取出。這很好知道，因為現在我知道一個能與村裡的鐵匠們交換我服務的辦法了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Finally, the day that I have been waiting for the past 7 months has come. The "Hell's Harvest Festival" is a day that the village celebrates the creation of the first portal to the Nether a century ago. It's funny that when I ask the villagers why it is that we celebrate the formation of a portal to Hell, they simply laugh and say that I'll see when I finally go in. The portal was located in a vast stone cathedral, a three days' walk from the village on foot. Magus said that he'd meet us there, because he had a few things that he needed to prepare before actually going over to the Nether, but I was curious as to how he'd make it there in time - knowing Master Magus, he'd spend a day or two reading up on a new theory for a ritual and forget himself in his works. When we entered the hall, however, Master Magus was already talking to one of the guards of the unlit portal, stowing away a gem into his pocket. I knew something was up, because I could see a strand connecting the gem in his pocket to both himself and one that trailed off back to the village. Not wanting to be distracted, I pulled out my wand (Master Magus insists on all of his apprentices learning of another field of magic, and Thaumaturgy has proved itself useful) and set alight the portal as was the custom of the newest member to the harvest. It seems that the harvest, however, was not exactly a trade. I saw giant stone walls and vast pumps throughout the land, grabbing all of the lava from the great pool below. A large collection of bound pigmen walked by, led away by someone in a full set of shining steel armor. Huge machines that processed the lava were emblazoned by the brands of industrialization: Thermal Expansion, BuildCraft, Greg Tech, and many other labels dotted throughout the base of operations. So much for a festival - it seemed that the Conglomeration, the governing body that oversaw all of the villages in the land, saw it fit to turn a civilization into a circus.
zh_tw: 終於，我過去 7 個月來一直在等待的日子到了。「地獄收穫節」是村莊慶祝一個世紀前第一座通往下界的傳送門誕生的日子。有趣的是，當我問村民們為什麼要慶祝一座通往地獄的傳送門的形成時，他們只是笑著說，等我終於進去就會明白。傳送門位於一座巨大的石造大教堂中，從村莊步行要三天的路程。Magus 說他會在那裡跟我們會合，因為在真正前往下界之前，他還有一些事情要準備，但我很好奇他要怎麼準時趕到——以我對 Master Magus 的了解，他八成會花上一兩天去研讀某個新的儀式理論，然後沉浸在他的研究中忘了自己。然而當我們走進大廳時，Master Magus 已經在和一名守衛未點燃的傳送門的衛兵說話，並把一顆寶石收進口袋。我知道事情不對勁，因為我看見一條絲線把他口袋裡的寶石與他本人相連，另一條則延伸回村莊的方向。不想被分心，我拿出了我的法杖（Master Magus 堅持要他所有的學徒都學習另一個魔法領域，而神秘學已證明了它的用處），並按照收穫節中最新成員的慣例點燃了傳送門。然而，這場收穫似乎並不完全是一場交易。我看見巨大的石牆與龐大的幫浦遍布大地，從下方的大熔岩池中抽取所有熔岩。一大群被綁定的豬人走過，由一個身穿全套閃亮鋼製盔甲的人帶領著。處理熔岩的巨型機器上烙著工業化的印記：Thermal Expansion、BuildCraft、Greg Tech，以及許多其他的標誌散布在整個作業基地。哪裡還有節慶的樣子——看來管轄這片土地上所有村莊的統治機構「Conglomeration」，認為把一個文明變成馬戲團是合情合理的。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: After accepting a few supplies from the farce, I walked back home by myself two days early. There were some things that I wanted to create, but wasting my time there would have been fruitless. Clearing my desk of debris charts of alchemical constructs, I set to work with a vat of magma cream that I brought with me, attempting to combine it with another slate. Casting my orb aside, I fished the lava crystal from my chest and combined it with the cream and some fresh buckets of lava - thankfully not from the Nether. Once the light faded, I picked up the new Lava Sigil that lay in front of me. What this sigil does is siphon energy and use the properties of the lava crystal to superheat rock, creating a source of lava wherever the wielder touches the ground. So, infinite lava, and infinite fire hazards. Unfortunately, it takes about 1 kLP per single use, which is a lot for my network as it currently stands. It looks like I need more power, but seeing that Master Magus is currently enjoying himself at the festival, I'm going to have to find a way to boost the Blood Altar myself.
zh_tw: 從那場鬧劇中接受了一些補給後，我提早兩天自己走路回了家。我有幾樣東西想要製作，但在那裡浪費時間只會徒勞無功。清掉書桌上散落的煉金構造圖表後，我拿出隨身帶來的一桶岩漿膏開始工作，試著把它與另一塊石板結合。我把血球擺到一旁，從箱子裡取出熔岩水晶，與岩漿膏和幾桶新的熔岩——幸好不是來自下界的——組合在一起。光芒消退後，我拿起了面前新做好的熔岩印記。這枚印記的作用是抽取能量，並利用熔岩水晶的特性將岩石加熱到極高溫，在持有者觸碰地面之處製造出熔岩源。所以，是無限的熔岩，也是無限的火災隱患。不幸的是，每次使用大約需要 1 kLP，對我目前的網路來說太多了。看來我需要更多力量，但眼見 Master Magus 正在慶典上玩得開心，我只好自己想辦法提升血祭壇了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Of course! Runes! Why didn't I think of this earlier? The power of the altar itself comes from the structure of the components used to create it. The force of the diamond alone is not enough to create stronger materials through transmutation. What I need to do is construct several runes to extend the altar, and thus the altar's power. The only thing that I could do on such short notice is to take several blank slates (I have about 16 left) and quite a bit more stone and combine them with my Weak Blood Orb.
zh_tw: 當然！符文！我怎麼沒早點想到呢？祭壇本身的力量，來自於建造它所使用的各種組件的結構。光靠鑽石的力量，不足以透過轉化製造出更強的材料。我需要做的，是建造幾枚符文來擴充祭壇，進而擴充祭壇的力量。在這麼倉促的情況下，我唯一能做的，就是拿幾塊空白石板（我還剩大約 16 塊）和相當多的石頭，與我的虛弱血球結合。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: What came next was the hard part. After I made 8 runes for myself, I sat puzzling over the altar. "How could I extend this thing?" I asked myself. It took a few hours, but when I placed the 8 runes in the ground around the altar in a ring, I felt a strange reverberation in the air. Something felt like it awoke, as if the power in the surrounding environment doubled. Quickly, I grabbed my Divination Sigil and slapped it onto the altar, and focused into it to view the power of the altar. I was pleased to find out that the altar was finally at its second tier, which should open up many more transmutation recipes. The problem now, as I sank slowly into my bed to sleep after the long day, was to find out what I could now do. Although Magus was pleased with the upgraded altar, I was caught in a bind. I couldn't seem to do anything with it that the previous altar could not do. The first thing I did was place one of my leftover blank slates into the basin, and it promptly consumed 2 kLP worth of essence as it reinforced the structure. Although this Reinforced Slate was much more durable, this process appeared to make the slate no longer work with creating both the lava and water sigils, as well as making it a waste to use in additional rune creation.
zh_tw: 接下來才是困難的部分。我為自己做好 8 枚符文後，坐在祭壇前苦思。「我該怎麼擴充這玩意兒？」我問自己。花了幾個小時，但當我把這 8 枚符文圍成一圈嵌在祭壇周圍的地面上時，我感覺到空氣中傳來一陣奇異的迴響。有什麼東西彷彿甦醒了，就像周遭環境中的力量翻了一倍。我迅速抓起占卜印記拍在祭壇上，集中精神查看祭壇的力量。我欣喜地發現，祭壇終於來到了第二等級，這應該能解鎖更多轉化配方。漫長的一天之後，我慢慢陷進床鋪準備入睡，而此刻的問題是，要弄清楚我現在能做些什麼。儘管 Magus 對升級後的祭壇很滿意，我卻陷入了困境。我似乎沒辦法用它做出任何先前的祭壇做不到的事。我做的第一件事，是把一塊剩下的空白石板放進盆中，它隨即消耗了相當於 2 kLP 的精華來強化其結構。雖然這塊強化石板耐用得多，但這個過程似乎使這塊石板不再能用於製作熔岩與水之印記，而且拿來製作額外的符文也太浪費了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I can note, however, that when I combined one of the runes with a few more blank slates and some leftover Sugar from the harvest, it seemed to augment the altar even further. The Sugar had to be laid in a configuration that mimicked a bow and arrow on top of the rune, and by doing so it created what I can dub a Speed Rune. What this rune appeared to do was increase the speed of the altar's processes, both the transmutation rate as well as the speed that a bound orb will consume the essence from the altar, by an additive 20% per rune. This tier doesn't seem perfect, however, since it seems that for the second tier only the four edge runes (not the corners) could be used as upgrade "slots" for the purpose of augmentation of the altar.
zh_tw: 不過我可以記下的是，當我把一枚符文與更多的空白石板和收穫節剩下的一些糖結合時，似乎能進一步增幅祭壇。糖必須在符文上擺成模仿弓與箭的形狀，這樣做之後，就製作出了我可以稱之為速度符文的東西。這枚符文的作用似乎是加快祭壇的各項流程，包括轉化速率，以及綁定的血球從祭壇汲取精華的速度，每枚符文疊加 20%。不過這個等級似乎並不完美，因為在第二級時，似乎只有四個邊上的符文（不含角落）能作為增幅祭壇的升級「槽位」。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The "eureka" moment came when I accidentally dropped a few things on the floor of the lab. When I bent down to fish the items from the floor, I noticed that one of the emeralds rolled right up to the altar, almost as if it longed to be inside its basin. It occurred to me that if a simple diamond inside the altar created a Weak Blood Orb, perhaps a much rarer gem would make a stronger version! Quickly fetching my knife from the table, I filled up the altar over the course of the day so that I could make sure I didn't mess anything up, and then dropped the emerald into the altar. The speed runes made sure that the transmutation took no time at all! Wow, those things work fast - I better make a note of removing the runes when I try to create more difficult items inside the altar, because if I was not prepared it would have chewed through my supply in no time! After a few tantalizing moments waiting, the altar burst in a shower of particles and the new orb sat there, revolving on top of the altar. Master Magus must have heard my shout of exclamation, because he hurried over from his side of the house and helped me to my feet. Not noticing the pain in my palm from earlier, I reached for the orb and sealed it to my network. Master Magus then helped me fill up the orb inside the altar, and when we were done that day I had a total of 25 kLP inside my network.
zh_tw: 「頓悟」的時刻，是在我不小心把幾樣東西掉在實驗室地板上時到來的。當我彎下腰去撿地上的東西時，我注意到其中一顆綠寶石一路滾到了祭壇邊，彷彿它渴望待在祭壇的盆中。我突然想到，既然祭壇裡一顆普通的鑽石能做出虛弱血球，也許一顆稀有得多的寶石能做出更強的版本！我迅速從桌上拿起匕首，花了一整天把祭壇注滿，確保不會搞砸任何東西，然後把綠寶石丟進祭壇。有了速度符文，轉化瞬間就完成了！哇，這些東西運作得真快——我最好記得，在祭壇裡製作較困難的物品時要把符文拆掉，因為如果我沒有準備好，它轉眼間就會把我的存量吞得精光！在令人心癢難耐的幾刻等待之後，祭壇在一陣粒子的噴發中炸開，新的血球就在祭壇上方旋轉著。Master Magus 一定是聽到了我驚呼的叫聲，他從屋子另一頭匆匆趕來，把我扶了起來。我沒注意到先前手掌上的疼痛，伸手拿起血球並將它封入我的網路。Master Magus 接著幫我把血球在祭壇裡注滿，那天結束時，我的網路中總共有 25 kLP。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: After resting the rest of the day at the insistence of Magus, I returned to work this morning full of inspiration. While I lay in bed half awake, the thought struck me that so far I had managed to use sigils to create fluid. So why not make one that can remove it? My first attempts with things like glass bottles and bowls failed, with all of them working for a brief moment, then returning to their old forms. It was almost lunchtime when the thought crossed me that I used buckets for the first two, so why not here? Half an hour, six buckets, a bit of twine, and a Reinforced Slate later, I had my first Void Sigil.
zh_tw: 在 Magus 的堅持下休息了一整天之後，今天早上我滿懷靈感地回到工作中。當我半夢半醒地躺在床上時，腦中閃過一個念頭：到目前為止，我只做到用印記來製造流體。那為什麼不做一枚能移除流體的呢？我最初用玻璃瓶和碗之類的東西嘗試都失敗了，它們都只管用了短短一瞬，然後就變回原來的樣子。快到午餐時間時，我才突然想到，前兩枚我用的是桶子，那這次為什麼不呢？半小時、六個桶子、一點細繩和一塊強化石板之後，我做出了我的第一枚虛空印記。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: While tending to our small farm a few days later, I noticed a bird land on our fence. I turned to face it as it flew off, and had a revelation as I watched how it flew. If I could use magic to create a gust of wind like that made by bird wings, I could fly through the air! After hastily finishing the day's chores, working out details in my head all the while, I rushed to my workstation to start work on what I have now dubbed the "Air Sigil." Using feathers and a Ghast Tear as ink on a Reinforced Slate, I formed a sigil that on use creates a rush of air behind where you face to propel you forward. Flight using this sigil is fast, if a little pricey and hard to control, not like the flight provided by Magus's thaumostatic harness. Also, landing is a bit of a problem, as I learned the hard way...
zh_tw: 幾天後在照料我們的小農場時，我注意到一隻鳥停在我們的柵欄上。我轉身面向牠，牠隨即飛走，而看著牠飛行的方式，我頓時有了領悟。如果我能用魔法製造出像鳥翼那樣的一陣風，我就能在空中飛翔了！匆匆做完當天的雜務，腦中一直在推敲細節，我衝向我的工作台，開始製作我如今稱之為「空氣印記」的東西。我在強化石板上以羽毛和一滴 地獄幽靈之淚當作墨水，形成了一枚使用時會在你面朝方向的後方製造出一股氣流、把你向前推進的印記。使用這枚印記飛行很快，只是有點貴又難以控制，不像 Magus 的 thaumostatic harness 所提供的飛行。此外，降落也是個問題，這是我吃了苦頭才學到的……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I've grown a little annoyed at my Divination Sigil. While it is able to read the current tier and essence of a Blood Altar, that is ALL it can read. As a result, my current goal is to improve its design using my new Blood Orb. So far it is going well. The "Sigil of Sight" is able to read the buffers of the altar to show how much they store, as well as how far along a craft in the altar is and how fast it is using LP. The downside of this upgrade is that it loses the power to read the altar's tier or the user's soul network, but so far this is an unavoidable loss. For now I'll settle with what it does now, and might try to improve it further later.
zh_tw: 我對我的占卜印記有點不滿了。雖然它能讀取血祭壇目前的等級與精華，但那就是它所能讀取的「全部」。因此，我目前的目標是利用我的新血球來改進它的設計。目前進展順利。「視覺印記」能讀取祭壇的緩衝槽，顯示它們儲存了多少，以及祭壇中的合成進行到什麼程度、消耗 LP 的速度有多快。這次升級的缺點是它失去了讀取祭壇等級或使用者靈魂網路的能力，但目前看來這個損失是無可避免的。現在我先滿足於它現有的功能，之後也許會嘗試進一步改良。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Even after all this time, I still don't fully understand the Blood Altar. Sure, I built the thing, but... it is almost like working directly with raw life essence has given it a bit of life of its own. After running a few experiments to try and make my life easier, I've noticed some odd behavior coming from it. First, I tried using some basic piping to extract life essence to store later to use for more pricey infusions. As it turns out, the altar doesn't like giving up its essence. I managed to get a bucket of LE out before it seemed to slow to a trickle feed, nothing more than 20 LP a second. Further tests show that it has a "buffer" tank that siphons off LP from the main tank, holding roughly 10% of the main tank's capacity. As I mentioned, it does this very slowly, so piping is out of the question for now... A later test shows that it also doesn't like essence being piped in, as a similar restriction applies to inputting essence. I will definitely need to find a way to improve this transfer rate... Another strange phenomenon about the altar is its "hunger" for life. After the failure of the piping, I tried using a few regeneration potions from the local village to speed up the rate at which I recovered health. A normal or extended potion seemed fine, and was very effective for speeding up slate production. But a strengthened regeneration potion caused the altar to have a slight "hum" about it, and I felt my energy being sapped by something. After talking with Magus about this, we have determined the altar senses the life flowing through us, and the potion makes the altar's "hunger" for this life create a sort of aura that causes you to lose energy akin to hunger. As a result of this, regeneration is still effective, but a sizable supply of food is needed for extended use to recover energy.
zh_tw: 即使過了這麼久，我仍然沒有完全理解血祭壇。沒錯，是我建造了這東西，但是……彷彿直接與原始的生命精華打交道，賦予了它一點屬於自己的生命。在進行了幾次試圖讓我生活更輕鬆的實驗後，我注意到它有一些古怪的行為。首先，我嘗試用一些基本的管道來抽取生命精華，儲存起來供之後更昂貴的灌注使用。結果發現，祭壇不喜歡交出它的精華。我成功取出了一桶 LE，之後似乎就變成了涓涓細流，每秒不超過 20 LP。進一步的測試顯示，它有一個「緩衝」槽，會從主槽中抽走 LP，容量大約是主槽容量的 10%。如我所說，它做這件事非常緩慢，所以管道目前是行不通了……之後的一項測試顯示，它也不喜歡精華被管道輸入，輸入精華同樣受到類似的限制。我肯定需要找到提升這個傳輸速率的方法……祭壇的另一個奇怪現象，是它對生命的「飢渴」。管道實驗失敗後，我嘗試用一些從當地村莊買來的再生藥水來加快我恢復生命的速度。普通或延長版的藥水似乎沒問題，對加快石板的製作非常有效。但強化版的再生藥水卻讓祭壇發出輕微的「嗡嗡」聲，我也感覺到自己的精力被什麼東西榨取了。與 Magus 談過之後，我們判斷祭壇能感知流經我們體內的生命，而藥水讓祭壇對這種生命的「飢渴」形成了一種光環，使你像飢餓一樣流失精力。因此，再生仍然有效，但長時間使用需要大量的食物來恢復精力。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I've decided to experiment with passive effects for sigils, since everything so far has been an active effect. While wandering through town looking for supplies, I noticed people cutting wood for a fire and some smashing stones to build a small fire pit. I kept coming back to how slow both of them were in my train of thought, then started going over ways to improve the tools. Then it hit me: why improve the tools when you can improve the person? A few anatomy books and failed tests later, I had the Sigil of the Fast Miner and two very tired arms. After activating the sigil, it speeds up muscle movements in the arms, allowing you to break blocks far faster at a small LP cost every few seconds. I do need to keep reminding myself to turn it off when not in use, but the stinging pain of life essence being taken is always a quick reminder...
zh_tw: 我決定試驗印記的被動效果，因為到目前為止的一切都是主動效果。在鎮上到處找補給時，我注意到有人在砍柴生火，還有人在敲碎石頭搭建小型火坑。我腦中不斷回到這兩件事實在太慢了，於是開始思考改良工具的方法。然後我恍然大悟：既然可以改良人，何必改良工具呢？幾本解剖學的書和幾次失敗的測試之後，我做出了速掘印記，也換來兩條疲憊不堪的手臂。啟動這枚印記後，它會加快手臂的肌肉動作，讓你能以快得多的速度破壞方塊，代價是每隔幾秒消耗少量 LP。我確實需要不斷提醒自己不用時要關掉它，不過生命精華被抽走時那種刺痛，總是能立刻提醒我……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Today I pushed myself too far. I've gotten close a few times, but today was the first time I passed out due to draining too much life essence. Magus was thankfully with me at the time, and moved me to a bed to recover. As I regained my senses, I noticed something odd about my soul network threads: they were thin and looked damaged. As I kept watching my threads, it seemed like they were slowly reforming and repairing themselves. I mentioned this to Magus, and we theorized that after coming so close to death, my soul was still recovering from the shock. I made a sacrifice at the altar to test this, and it seems that this state affects how much life essence a heart is worth quite negatively, with it only giving a tenth the normal amount.
zh_tw: 今天我把自己逼得太過頭了。我有好幾次已經很接近了，但今天是我第一次因為耗盡太多生命精華而昏倒。幸好 Magus 當時就在我身邊，把我搬到床上休養。當我恢復意識時，我注意到我靈魂網路的絲線有些古怪：它們變得細弱，看起來受損了。我持續觀察那些絲線，它們似乎正在慢慢重組並自我修復。我向 Magus 提起這件事，我們推測，在如此接近死亡之後，我的靈魂仍在從衝擊中恢復。我在祭壇上獻祭來測試這個推測，結果似乎這種狀態會對一顆心所值的生命精華造成相當負面的影響，只能給出正常數量的十分之一。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Today Magus showed me his Green Grove ritual, a way to speed up crops. Unfortunately, it is very static and has a small range, limiting its uses. To amend this, I've been toying with the concepts behind the ritual in an attempt to make it more portable. By creating an ink from oak saplings and sugarcane, then inscribing a rune on a Reinforced Slate, I have created the Sigil of the Green Grove. It seems a little slower and more expensive than the ritual form, but it can be carried on your person and acts like bonemeal when used on plants. While I had it active, I could barely keep up with our farm, and by the end we needed to give a few of our neighbors some of the excess we didn't need. They all accepted it, but with varied degrees of reluctance.
zh_tw: 今天 Magus 向我展示了他的綠林儀式，這是一種加速作物生長的方法。可惜它非常靜態，範圍又小，限制了用途。為了改善這點，我一直在把玩這個儀式背後的概念，試著讓它更便於攜帶。我用橡樹樹苗和甘蔗製成墨水，再在一塊強化石板上刻下符文，做出了綠林印記。它似乎比儀式的形式更慢、更昂貴一些，但可以隨身攜帶，對植物使用時效果就像骨粉。啟動它的時候，我幾乎要應付不了我們的農場，到最後我們還得把一些用不完的多餘作物送給幾位鄰居。他們全都收下了，只是勉強程度各有不同。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: My work on sigils has slowed for now, as I'm reaching the limits of what my little green orb can do after only two weeks. As a result, I have turned my attention to other aspects such as runes to pass the time. Magus is currently out dealing with a large forest fire to the east of us, and the village is in a bit of a lull with nothing planned for several weeks. Right now my task is to slaughter a few chickens Magus brought home from the market to prepare for his return home, and it seems the perfect time to test an idea I've been thinking about for a while... I will not mark it here, just in case it is another false hope. Success! I've managed to perfect my idea for a new source of life essence. Before, the only option was to cut ourselves to give our own life essence to the altar, but now we have a way to use other living things as a source. Unfortunately, it is a little gruesome and a bit "all or nothing" for them... Regardless, it works! ...I have realized that, in my excitement, I may have forgotten to write down what it is. I call it "The Dagger of Sacrifice", formed in a Blood Altar out of an iron sword and 3k LP. The dagger doesn't deal much in the way of damage. It doesn't need to, as its main purpose is to "mark" a living thing for the altar, which takes care of the rest by forcibly extracting their life essence all at once. Through my tests, it seems that your common farm animal's life isn't worth nearly as much as a person, only giving 250 LP regardless of where it comes from. While I set about cleaning the animals after the tests were done, a common zombie managed to sneak in the door I left open when bringing the chickens down here. As soon as I noticed it, reflexes that were drilled in by Magus every morning kicked in and I managed to poke it with my dagger before it had a chance to hurt me. At first I thought nothing happened, then it fell to the floor as lifeless as it should have already been. I glanced at the altar, quickly noting that a zombie was worth 500 LP. Looking over the fallen creature as it started crumbling, I noticed that some of the defenses Magus had set up took their toll on the zombie, as it was burned and freshly cut in several areas... Seems that the amount of HP they have is irrelevant to the altar, giving the same amount of LP regardless. As I finished preparing the meat to cook after disposing of the zombie's ash (which reminds me, I wanted to look up why this happens...), a very dark thought crossed my mind. The knife works by giving life to the altar. The dagger works by taking life forcibly from a target. What would happen if a human was marked by the dagger? I asked this to Magus after showing him the dagger and telling him everything that happened. "In all honesty, I'm not sure. I have a theory, but I don't really feel like testing it..." I asked him to elaborate, so he told me the basics of it. It seemed that the source of the life essence mattered with the dagger, since the chicken and zombie gave two different amounts, so depending on the person in question they would be split into one of three groups: Passive, Hostile, and Innocent. The passive would be like the chicken, only giving a little. The hostile would be the bandits, the thieves, the murderers - the ones who gave in to evil and now seek to hurt or steal from anyone, the unredeemed - and would probably be like the zombie. The final group were the innocents, anyone who doesn't fall into the first two groups. It was nothing but a guess, but we agreed that using the dagger on an innocent villager would extract all of their life essence like ours: 2k LP, all at once... We also couldn't work out what would divide the passive from the rest, but it was only a theory, so we put it to rest.
zh_tw: 我在印記上的工作暫時放緩了，因為僅僅兩週，我就快要觸及我那顆小小綠色血球所能做到的極限了。因此，我把注意力轉向符文等其他方面來打發時間。Magus 目前外出處理我們東邊的一場大型森林火災，而村莊也進入了一段平靜期，接下來幾週都沒有任何安排。眼下我的任務是宰幾隻 Magus 從市場帶回家的雞，為他回家做準備，這似乎正是測試我思考已久的一個點子的絕佳時機……我不會把它寫在這裡，以防它又是一次空歡喜。成功了！我成功完善了我的想法，找到了一種新的生命精華來源。以前唯一的選擇是割傷自己，把自己的生命精華獻給祭壇，但現在我們有辦法把其他生物當作來源了。不幸的是，這有點血腥，而且對它們來說有點「不成功便成仁」……不管怎樣，它有效！……我意識到，在興奮之中，我可能忘了寫下它是什麼。我稱它為「獻祭匕首」，在血祭壇中以一把鐵劍和 3k LP 製成。這把匕首造成的傷害不大。它也不需要，因為它的主要目的是替祭壇「標記」一個生物，其餘的由祭壇處理，一次性強行抽出牠們的生命精華。透過我的測試，一般農場動物的生命似乎遠不如人類值錢，無論來自哪裡，都只給 250 LP。測試結束後，當我開始清理那些動物時，一隻普通的殭屍設法溜進了我帶雞下來時沒關上的門。我一注意到它，Magus 每天早晨訓練到我骨子裡的反射動作就啟動了，我趕在它有機會傷害我之前，用匕首戳中了它。起初我以為什麼都沒發生，接著它就倒在地上，變得如同它本來就該有的那樣毫無生氣。我瞥了祭壇一眼，立刻注意到一隻殭屍值 500 LP。我端詳著開始崩解的倒下生物，注意到 Magus 設下的一些防禦在這隻殭屍身上留下了痕跡，它有好幾處被燒傷，還有新的割傷……看來牠們有多少生命值對祭壇來說無關緊要，無論如何給出的 LP 都一樣。處理完殭屍的灰燼（這讓我想起，我一直想查查為什麼會這樣……）、準備好要烹煮的肉之後，一個非常黑暗的念頭閃過我的腦海。匕首的運作方式，是從目標身上強行奪取生命。刀子的運作方式，是把生命獻給祭壇。如果一個人類被匕首標記了會怎樣？我向 Magus 展示匕首並告訴他所發生的一切之後，向他問了這個問題。「說實話，我不確定。我有一個理論，但我不太想去測試……」我請他詳細說明，於是他告訴了我大致的內容。對匕首而言，生命精華的來源似乎很重要，因為雞和殭屍給出的數量不同，所以依據當事人的不同，會被歸入三類之一：被動、敵意與無辜。被動的就像那隻雞，只給一點點。敵意的就像強盜、小偷、殺人犯——那些向邪惡屈服、現在想傷害或搶劫任何人的人，那些無法救贖的人——大概就像殭屍。最後一類是無辜者，也就是不屬於前兩類的任何人。這只不過是猜測，但我們都同意，對一名無辜的村民使用匕首，會像我們一樣一次抽走他們全部的生命精華：2k LP，一次抽盡……我們也想不出是什麼把被動者與其他人區分開來，但這畢竟只是個理論，所以我們就把它擱置了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Looking at these little speed runes, I have decided to see what else I can make. My goal isn't anything in particular, just improving it in some way. The speed rune was made with powdered Sugar, so another type of powder should work... Redstone failed, Gunpowder failed, Glowstone... Glowstone worked. I currently have no idea what it does; all I know is it didn't fall to bits seconds after creating it, so that is progress. The altar seems to accept it as a proper rune, so all that is left is to run a few tests in the morning. For now, I am tired and feel a bed calling me... I've run dozens of tests trying to find out what this new rune does. After two days of obsessing over this, I finally noticed it. It slightly increases the amount of LP self-sacrifice gives. When I say slight, I mean one rune increases LP gained by ten percent on an additive rate. For those who don't understand that, it basically adds an additional twenty LP per self-sacrifice. If my theory is right, I should be able to make a similar rune for normal sacrifice... What else would the altar respond to?
zh_tw: 看著這些小小的速度符文，我決定看看還能做出什麼。我的目標並不特定，只是想以某種方式改良它。速度符文是用糖粉做的，所以另一種粉末應該也行……紅石失敗了，火藥失敗了，螢石……螢石成功了。我目前完全不知道它有什麼作用；我只知道它做出來之後沒有在幾秒內碎成片，這就算是進展了。祭壇似乎把它當作一枚正規的符文接受，所以只剩明天早上做幾次測試了。現在，我累了，覺得床在召喚我……我做了幾十次測試，想弄清楚這枚新符文有什麼作用。沉迷其中兩天後，我終於注意到了。它稍微提升了自我犧牲所給出的 LP 數量。當我說稍微，我的意思是每枚符文以加算的方式增加百分之十的 LP 收益。對於不懂這個意思的人來說，基本上就是每次自我犧牲額外增加二十 LP。如果我的理論正確，我應該也能做出一枚針對一般獻祭的類似符文……祭壇還會對什麼起反應呢？
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Well, if there is anything thaumaturgy and magic in general has taught me, it is that gold is a very good metal for magic. By simply replacing the Glowstone in the recipe with gold ingots, a sacrifice rune is formed. It has the same additional ten percent per rune per sacrifice, meaning the more LP the mob sacrificed has, the more LP the runes add. This has got me thinking... The altar was constructed with both diamond and gold. It seems to resonate with the diamond enough to make the first blood orb, and even a second, so why not try making one out of gold? I'll need to revisit this idea later, as a test run showed some reaction to a block of solid gold (I didn't ask Magus where he got it, and he doesn't seem forthcoming about these matters), but the altar couldn't cope with the strain needed to shape the block. Before catastrophic failure happened, a few safety precautions Magus and I had built into the altar triggered, stopping the transmutation before... well, neither of us are really sure what would happen. But Magus said he has dealt with matters of unstable and untested magic, and knew most of them end with a crater in the floor (hence the safety precautions). It has been a few days since the experiment with the gold block. Magus and I have been discussing what to do now, as the altar is getting bigger than the basement. Magus has suggested moving it to some of the lower basement floors, but considering just how large it might be in the future... I finally got him to agree to building it behind his home, as long as I helped put up a few wards and spells to keep people away. Currently, we're planning out the structure and needed runes for upgrading. The current altar only has eight runes, but what I have planned will more than triple that number to twenty-eight. The current limitation we suffer is the strength of the altar itself, as it can only take power from runes adjacent to it. My plan is to use something the altar is naturally attuned to as a way to not only increase the range of this effect, but also act as a counterbalance and stabilize it to prevent it from becoming uncontrollable. For this to work, the blocks in question must be above the altar and an equal distance apart. We've run several tests and calculations, and have a layout in mind for this upgrade: four pillars topped with Glowstone blocks, twenty runes in sections of five, built one block down and two out from the last set of runes. In theory, this should provide a huge boost in power to the altar without risking our safety (well, more than we normally risk it), but until we test full scale, I can't be sure. For now, we have a lot of runes to make. After much debate, we've decided to invest in the self-sacrifice runes, as having a steady supply of mobs will be tricky. But now I face the issue of making dozens of reinforced slates... I need to think on this.
zh_tw: 嗯，如果說神秘學和魔法整體教會了我什麼，那就是黃金是非常適合魔法的金屬。只要把配方中的螢石換成金錠，就能形成一枚獻祭符文。它同樣是每枚符文每次獻祭額外增加百分之十，這代表被獻祭的生物擁有的 LP 越多，符文增加的 LP 也越多。這讓我開始思考……祭壇是用鑽石和黃金兩者建造的。它似乎與鑽石共鳴得足以製作出第一顆血球，甚至還有第二顆，那為什麼不試試用黃金來做一顆呢？我之後需要重新審視這個想法，因為一次試驗顯示它對一塊實心金塊有些反應（我沒問 Magus 他是從哪裡弄來的，而他對這些事似乎也不太願意多說），但祭壇承受不了塑造這個方塊所需的壓力。在發生災難性故障之前，Magus 和我內建於祭壇中的幾道安全防範措施觸發了，在轉化……嗯，我們兩個都不太確定會發生什麼事之前就將其中止了。不過 Magus 說他處理過不穩定且未經測試的魔法，知道其中大多數都會在地板上留下一個大坑（這就是安全防範措施的由來）。距離金塊實驗已經過了幾天。Magus 和我一直在討論現在該怎麼辦，因為祭壇正變得比地下室還大。Magus 建議把它搬到更深的地下室樓層，但考慮到它將來可能會有多大……我終於讓他同意把它蓋在他家後面，條件是我要幫忙設下一些結界和法術來讓人們遠離。目前我們正在規劃升級所需的結構與符文。現在的祭壇只有八枚符文，而我規劃的將讓這個數量增加到三倍以上，達到二十八枚。我們目前面臨的限制是祭壇本身的強度，因為它只能從與其相鄰的符文汲取力量。我的計畫是利用祭壇天生會產生共鳴的東西，不僅擴大這個效果的範圍，還能作為制衡並穩定它，防止它失控。要讓這個方法奏效，相關的方塊必須位於祭壇上方，且彼此間距相等。我們已經進行了幾次測試與計算，並想好了這次升級的配置：四根頂端是螢石塊的柱子，以及二十枚分成五枚一組的符文，建造在比上一組符文低一格、向外兩格的位置。理論上，這應該能在不危及我們安全（嗯，比我們平常冒的險更大一點）的前提下，大幅提升祭壇的力量，但在全面規模測試之前，我無法確定。眼下，我們有很多符文要做。經過一番激烈辯論，我們決定投入自我犧牲符文，因為要穩定地取得源源不絕的生物會很棘手。但現在我面臨一個問題，就是要製作幾十塊強化石板……我得好好想想。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It's so simple! I've discovered a way of obtaining LP for making slates that means I don't wait at the altar all day: the Blood Letter's Backpack. Made with a modified leather chest piece with a blank slate reinforced glass tank, it allows the wearer to gather LP by feeding it into the pack over time. Whenever the wearer has more than five hearts, the pack will drain their life and store it inside, up to 10k LP, to be dumped into an altar later. This pack does have two shortcomings, however. When the life essence is deposited into the altar, runes will have no bonus to the amount added. The second problem is that the altar will only accept LP from the pack when not performing a transmutation. Despite these limitations, it will prove quite valuable for simply allowing me to step away from the altar to do other tasks. This is a simple progress update, as it's been a few weeks since I last wrote in this journal. I've been making slow but steady progress with assembling the slates needed for the runes, and we're now halfway through. This isn't the only reason for the lack of entries, as I've been preoccupied with my research through thaumaturgy. An old friend of Magus has been visiting and happens to be a well-versed thaumaturge, and he has been giving me pointers on how I could be doing better while Magus has been preoccupied in his library dealing with a mountain of paperwork. Now that Master Ridden has returned home, I hope to progress further in making runes in the next few days.
zh_tw: 太簡單了！我發現了一種獲得製作石板所需 LP 的方法，意味著我不必整天守在祭壇旁等候：放血者的包裹。它以一件改造過的皮革胸甲搭配一個用空白石板強化的玻璃槽製成，讓穿戴者能隨著時間把生命注入背包中來收集 LP。只要穿戴者的生命超過五顆心，背包就會抽取其生命並儲存在其中，最多 10k LP，之後再倒入祭壇。不過這個背包確實有兩個缺點。第一，當生命精華注入祭壇時，符文不會對所加入的量提供任何加成。第二個問題是，祭壇只有在沒有進行轉化時，才會接受背包中的 LP。儘管有這些限制，它仍會證明相當有價值，因為它讓我能直接離開祭壇去做其他事。這只是一份簡單的進度更新，因為距離我上次在這本日誌裡寫字已經過了幾週。我在組裝符文所需的石板上進展緩慢但穩定，現在我們已經完成一半了。這並不是缺少紀錄的唯一原因，因為我一直忙於透過神秘學進行研究。Magus 的一位老朋友前來拜訪，而他恰好是一位學識淵博的神秘使，在 Magus 忙於在他的藏書室裡處理堆積如山的文書時，他一直給我指點，告訴我可以怎麼做得更好。現在 Master Ridden 已經回家了，我希望在接下來幾天能在製作符文上取得更多進展。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Or not, as it seems Fate has other, far more interesting plans for us. Today we had a knock on our door while I was making the last of the runes, and after opening it I was greeted by three apparent orphans. The two boys in the front looked like they were brothers, or at least close relatives. The girl hiding behind them, on the other hand, had very different hair and eye color, so relation was unlikely at best. All of them were covered in dirt, clothing ripped, torn, and patched with various levels of skill. The one on the left had an old sword with a chipped blade on his side, was slightly thinner and taller than his brother, had a few deep scars that looked recent, long and messy dark brown hair, and was looking at me with a kind poker face. The brother looked more muscled and was staring at me with very analytical eyes and a similar poker face; his hair was slightly shorter and lighter than his brother's. From what I could see of the girl, she had a simple dress on that was almost caked in dirt and dried mud. The fabric near her elbows was becoming threadbare, and a large rip near the bottom of the dress exposed some of her right leg. Her hair was a light blond, almost pale white color, but the most shocking feature was her eyes... I haven't seen haunted eyes like that in years, and last time it was in a mirror. From the looks of them, all of them hadn't eaten anything in days and seemed to have everything they owned on their bodies or in the simple packs on their backs. I asked them if there was anything they needed, to which the elder brother said they were looking for Master Magus. I called Magus to the door, visitors being a rare thing as it stands, with ones who ask for him by name and aren't clearly mages being rarer still. Five minutes later we all sat in the main room, eating simple sandwiches I had prepared for us all at the request of Magus. Needless to say, this day was not going as expected. Magus spent the next few minutes practically interrogating the elder brother, asking questions on both of our minds. As it turns out, the two brothers, Vlad and Demir, used to be caravan traders: the eldest an alchemist with basic knowledge of potion brewing, the younger with enough mana and training already to cast basic spells. The girl, on the other hand, had a story all her own. From what the brothers had managed to gather, her village was raided like my own was, and she was evidently the sole survivor. What shocked me was when they said she was found wandering the ashes, demons having left hours before without so much as a scratch on her body. Vlad was with the traders when they found her, and he was forced to leave them if he wanted to help the girl named Bella. Their story seemed to win Magus over, as he told them he would try to do what he could for them. Not long after that, Magus asked me to help him do some shopping for our new guests. On the way to the village, Magus asked me what I thought of the three. "I can't say I believe all their story, but I also don't think they're lying. Did you notice the girl's eyes? Haven't seen a look like that since..." Magus finished for me with, "Your own?" I nodded at the dark memories of that time. We continued going over the details of their story, but we agreed that just leaving them in the cold wasn't an option worth considering. We decided to at least try to keep our recent endeavors into blood magic a secret from them, but when push comes to shove, I think we might have to let them in on the secret. Magus let out a long sigh. "It's been years since I had to juggle this many apprentices at once. I'm going to need your help training them. But something tells me that we're going to be learning as much from them as they will from us..." I asked him why he felt that way, and he said it was just a gut feeling. I must say I had a similar feeling. Things like this don't happen without reason, and of all mages to come to, they stopped at our door - something far easier said than done. An hour later we returned home, both our arms heavy with fabrics, food, and other necessities that we will need to take care of the new apprentices. I watched in amazement as the three ate, trying to make up for days with little food all at once. After that, Magus and I laid the three on various chairs and couches to rest, the strain of travel catching up with them. While Magus dug around looking for a few of his old things that we'd soon need, I started creating some new clothing from enchanted fabric for the three to replace their current worn and ratty clothing. Now that that is done, I should try to get some sleep. Something is telling me tomorrow is going to be quite busy. Early this morning, Magus and I started carving out the earth for the three new bedrooms, since the old ones Magus used to have had since been converted into a storage closet, an alchemy lab, and a small study. It didn't take nearly as long as I expected, with Magus using a few spells to clear away earth while I went behind, using an equal trade foci to transmute it into stone brick before gravity caught on. Once that was done, Magus raised a few walls to separate the space into three rooms and a hallway. Only after that was done did I notice the three children had awoken and were watching us as we worked. Magus told them that he had some spare furniture in some storerooms they could use, but sadly only knew of one bed. It didn't take long for them to decide Bella got the bed; the brothers would make do with a pillow and a blanket on the floor. After that, we spent the rest of the day hunting for then moving furniture to their rooms, building little work areas and libraries for each of them. The following day was more of the same, with the evening filled with helping them find books to read from the grand library. Vlad grabbed as many alchemy books as possible, Demir took a few books on spell casting, and Bella took a Lexica Botanica to read through. Later this evening, after the three had retired to their rooms, I sat in the main room with Magus, arms and legs aching from the heavy lifting of the last two days. I told Magus how I thought their rooms should be almost finished, and how I spent the last hour before they retired just answering seemingly endless questions. "I'm sure. I've gone through the same more than once, when I have apprentices new to magic. You were the same, I recall." I opened my mouth to protest, but closed it as I thought back to those days. I decided I probably was as bad as them, and left it at that. It's been just over a week, and the three have settled in nicely. They join Magus and me in morning exercising, have started studying like true scholars, and have calmed the hungry nodes in their stomachs (well, Vlad and Bella have. Demir, on the other hand, is another matter, but I feel he will always be like that). Unfortunately, like true scholars and mages, they've stumbled into places we didn't want them to go. Vlad has created a chemistry set that uses life essence from a blood orb as a fuel source, Demir has turned an old table into a way to use life essence to cast powerful spells, and Bella... she's left me questioning what I know about demons, after taming one and using a blood orb to bind it to her. All three of them have stumbled blindly into blood magic, and now I don't think we'll be able to stop them. Magus and I have agreed to give them a choice in whether they are blood mages or not, but I've seen the light in their eyes... I can't imagine any of them saying no. To seal their dedication to the art, we will have them make blood orbs of their own to use.
zh_tw: 或者說不會，因為命運似乎對我們另有更有趣得多的安排。今天我正在製作最後幾枚符文時，有人敲了我們的門，開門後迎接我的是三個看起來像孤兒的孩子。站在前面的兩個男孩看起來像兄弟，或至少是近親。躲在他們身後的女孩則有著截然不同的髮色與眼珠顏色，所以有血緣關係的可能性微乎其微。他們全身沾滿泥土，衣服被撕裂、扯破，並以各種不同程度的手藝縫補過。站在左邊的那個腰間掛著一把刃口缺損的舊劍，比他的兄弟稍微瘦高一些，身上有幾道看起來很新的深疤，留著又長又亂的深棕色頭髮，用一張和善的撲克臉看著我。他的兄弟看起來肌肉更結實，用一雙非常善於分析的眼睛盯著我，擺著類似的撲克臉；他的頭髮比哥哥稍短、顏色稍淺。從我所能看到的女孩身上來看，她穿著一件簡單的洋裝，上面幾乎糊滿了泥土與乾掉的泥漿。手肘附近的布料已經磨得稀薄，裙襬附近有一道大裂口，露出了她的一部分右腿。她的頭髮是淺金色，近乎蒼白的白色，但最令人震驚的特徵是她的眼睛……我已經好幾年沒見過那樣縈繞著陰影的眼神了，上一次是在鏡子裡。從他們的樣子看來，三個人好幾天沒吃東西了，似乎所有家當都穿在身上或放在背後的簡陋背包裡。我問他們有沒有什麼需要，哥哥說他們在找 Master Magus。我把 Magus 叫到門口，畢竟訪客本來就罕見，而指名找他、又顯然不是法師的訪客就更罕見了。五分鐘後，我們全都坐在主廳裡，吃著我應 Magus 的要求為大家準備的簡單三明治。不用說，這一天的發展完全出乎意料。Magus 接下來的幾分鐘幾乎是在盤問那位哥哥，問著我們兩人心中都有的疑問。結果，這對兄弟 Vlad 和 Demir 曾經是商隊的商人：年長的是具備基礎藥水釀製知識的煉金術士，年幼的則已有足夠的魔力與訓練，可以施放基本法術。至於那個女孩，則有著屬於她自己的故事。據兄弟倆所能拼湊的，她的村莊就像我的村莊一樣遭到了襲擊，而她顯然是唯一的倖存者。令我震驚的是，他們說她是在灰燼中遊蕩時被發現的，惡魔數小時前就已離去，她身上卻連一道擦傷都沒有。商隊發現她時 Vlad 就在其中，如果他想幫助這位名叫 Bella 的女孩，就必須離開他們。他們的故事似乎說服了 Magus，他告訴他們他會盡其所能幫助他們。不久之後，Magus 請我幫他為我們的新客人採買東西。在前往村莊的路上，Magus 問我對這三個人怎麼看。「我不能說我全盤相信他們的故事，但我也不認為他們在說謊。你有注意到那女孩的眼睛嗎？我已經很久沒見過那樣的眼神了，自從……」Magus 替我把話說完：「你自己的？」我對那段時間的黑暗回憶點了點頭。我們繼續討論他們故事的細節，但我們一致認為，就這樣把他們丟在寒冷中不是一個值得考慮的選項。我們決定至少試著向他們隱瞞我們近期投入血魔法的事，但當事情到了緊要關頭，我想我們可能不得不讓他們知道這個祕密。Magus 長嘆了一口氣。「我已經好多年沒有同時應付這麼多學徒了。我需要你幫我訓練他們。但有種感覺告訴我，我們從他們身上學到的，將跟他們從我們身上學到的一樣多……」我問他為什麼這樣覺得，他說只是一種直覺。我必須說，我也有類似的感覺。這種事不會無緣無故發生，而且在所有法師之中，他們偏偏停在我們家門口——這可是說來容易做來難。一小時後我們回到家，兩人的手臂上都滿載著布料、食物和其他照顧新學徒所需的必需品。我驚奇地看著這三人吃東西，試圖一口氣補償那幾天幾乎沒吃東西的日子。之後，Magus 和我讓這三個孩子躺在各種椅子和沙發上休息，旅途的勞頓終於追上了他們。Magus 到處翻找他一些很快就會用上的舊物時，我則開始用附魔布料為三人製作新衣服，取代他們現在破舊的衣物。現在這些做完了，我該試著睡一會兒了。有個聲音告訴我，明天會相當忙碌。今天一大早，Magus 和我就開始為三間新臥室挖掘土地，因為 Magus 以前擁有的舊房間後來已被改成儲物間、煉金實驗室和一間小書房。這花的時間遠沒有我預期的長，Magus 用幾個法術清除泥土，我則跟在後頭，使用等價交換的焦點，在重力發揮作用之前將其轉化為石磚。完成之後，Magus 築起幾面牆，將空間隔成三間房和一條走廊。直到那之後我才注意到，三個孩子已經醒了，正在看著我們工作。Magus 告訴他們，他的一些儲藏室裡有備用的家具可以給他們用，但可惜只知道有一張床。他們沒花多久就決定床歸 Bella；兄弟倆則將就著在地板上用一個枕頭和一條毯子。之後，我們花了一整天尋找並搬運家具到他們的房間，為他們每個人搭建小小的工作區和藏書區。隔天也是類似的情況，傍晚則是協助他們從大藏書室中找書來讀。Vlad 盡可能抓了最多的煉金書，Demir 拿了幾本施法的書，而 Bella 拿了一本 Lexica Botanica 來細讀。今晚稍晚，三人回房休息後，我和 Magus 坐在主廳裡，手臂和雙腿因過去兩天的重物搬運而痠痛。我告訴 Magus，我認為他們的房間應該快完成了，以及在他們就寢前的最後一小時，我只是不停回答看似無窮無盡的問題。「我敢肯定。每當我有剛接觸魔法的新學徒，我都經歷過不只一次同樣的事。我記得你當年也一樣。」我張開嘴想抗議，但回想起那些日子，又把嘴閉上了。我決定我大概跟他們一樣糟，就不再多說了。才剛過一週多一點，這三人就已經適應得很好了。他們和 Magus 與我一起晨間運動，開始像真正的學者一樣研讀，也安撫了他們胃裡飢餓的節點（嗯，Vlad 和 Bella 是這樣。至於 Demir 就是另一回事了，不過我覺得他永遠都會是那樣）。不幸的是，就像真正的學者和法師一樣，他們闖進了我們不希望他們去的地方。Vlad 做了一套以血球的生命精華作為燃料來源的化學套件，Demir 把一張舊桌子改造成利用生命精華施放強力法術的方式，而 Bella……她讓我質疑起我對惡魔的了解，因為她馴服了一隻惡魔，並用血球將它綁定給自己。他們三人都盲目地闖進了血魔法，現在我想我們已經無法阻止他們了。Magus 和我已同意讓他們自己選擇是否成為血法師，但我已經看到了他們眼中的光芒……我無法想像他們之中有任何一個會說不。為了確立他們對這門藝術的投入，我們會讓他們各自製作屬於自己的血球來使用。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Even with all the chaos of the last week, I've managed to finish the altar construction, and it has been more successful than I predicted. With full access to twenty-eight runes, each heart is now worth over seven hundred LP. I've already started prepping to try again with the gold block, having a few instant healing potions at hand. I got a brief glimpse with my Sigil of Sight, and this transmutation will take twenty-five thousand LP to finish - over double what the altar can hold! Writing this down does give me an idea, however... I'll need to look into it further once I have finished making this.
zh_tw: 即使經歷了上週的一片混亂，我還是設法完成了祭壇的建造，而且成果比我預期的更成功。有了全部二十八枚符文，現在每顆心值超過七百 LP。我已經開始準備再次嘗試金塊，手邊備了幾瓶瞬間治療藥水。我用視覺印記匆匆瞥了一眼，這次轉化需要兩萬五千 LP 才能完成——超過祭壇所能容納量的兩倍！不過，寫下這些確實給了我一個想法……等我做完這個之後，需要進一步研究一下。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It was close, but I finished the orb today. I was down to the last of my three potions and barely had the strength left to hold the knife, but I pulled through and finished my shiny new blood orb! I've already used it to craft a few things I had made before, and it handles it all with such ease! Now that this is finished, I have a small list of ideas to go through... To start off the process, I want a stronger slate. As it stands, the reinforced type is cracking under the strain I'm starting to place on it. Well, I got a new slate type when I last upgraded the altar... Let's see if it works again. It does! A reinforced slate in a tier three altar with around five thousand LP makes a new slate... I'll call it an imbued slate for now, and come up with a better name later.
zh_tw: 差一點，但我今天完成了血球。我的三瓶藥水只剩最後一瓶，幾乎沒有力氣握住匕首，但我撐了過來，完成了我閃閃發亮的新血球！我已經用它製作了幾樣我之前做過的東西，而它處理起來是如此輕鬆自如！既然這件事完成了，我有一份小小的想法清單要逐一處理……作為開頭，我想要一塊更強的石板。照目前的狀況，強化石板在我開始施加給它的壓力下正在龜裂。嗯，我上次升級祭壇時得到了一種新的石板……來看看它是否再次有效。有效！在三級祭壇中，一塊強化石板加上大約五千 LP，就能製作出一種新的石板……暫時我就叫它灌輸石板，之後再想個更好的名字。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: First up on the drawing board: Rune of Capacity. The basic idea is simply to add more room to the altar, so a greater amount of LP can be stored at once to make bulk crafting or difficult crafts easier. Each rune adds 1.5K to the altar's main tank capacity, but what is interesting is that the buffer tanks expand as well, to a lesser degree. From a few trial tests (my back is starting to hurt from moving runes all day), the buffer tanks are always ten percent of the main tank's size. This will be something to keep in mind later. After helping patch a hole in the wall caused by Demir accidentally unleashing a spell, then helping Vlad dispose of a few failed alchemical "experiments", I finally have an hour to myself to work on my ideas for runes. After the success of the last documented attempt, I've been on a bit of a failure streak. I've had runes fail to do anything, crumble to dust, blow up, and one attempt turned into cheese (I asked Magus about this, and he said this isn't the first time he's seen that happen to a magical experiment. However, he is just as stumped as I am over why it is always cheese, of all things). Thankfully, I finally found something that doesn't need a blast shield to use or start growing mold after a while.
zh_tw: 首先出現在製圖板上的是：容量符文。基本概念很簡單，就是為祭壇增加更多空間，使一次能儲存更多 LP，讓大量合成或困難合成變得更容易。每枚符文會為祭壇的主槽增加 1.5K 容量，但有趣的是，緩衝槽也會跟著擴大，只是幅度較小。從幾次試驗測試來看（我整天搬運符文，背開始痛了），緩衝槽的大小始終是主槽的百分之十。這是之後要記在心上的事。在幫忙修補 Demir 不小心放出法術炸出的牆洞，然後再幫 Vlad 處理幾次失敗的煉金「實驗」之後，我終於有了一個小時屬於自己的時間，來研究我的符文想法。自從上一次有紀錄的嘗試成功之後，我就一路陷入了一連串的失敗。我做過什麼都不會發生的符文、碎成灰燼的符文、爆炸的符文，還有一次嘗試變成了起司（我問過 Magus 這件事，他說這不是他第一次看到魔法實驗發生這種事。不過，對於為什麼偏偏總是起司，他和我一樣困惑）。幸好，我終於找到了一個不需要防爆屏障就能使用、過一陣子也不會開始長黴的東西。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Named the Dislocation Rune, its only function is to increase the rate at which life essence flows into and out of the buffers. Each rune increases the transfer rate by twenty percent, and this effect stacks multiplicatively. That sounds great, until you realize the first rune only raises the transfer rate by four LP per second. Needless to say, you're going to need around a dozen of these runes before you have any noticeable impact on the transfer rate. While these runes make it possible to automate the creation of slates by storing life essence outside the altar, you're going to be sacrificing speed, capacity, and generation efficiency for this.
zh_tw: 我將它命名為錯位符文，它唯一的功能是提升生命精華流入與流出緩衝槽的速率。每枚符文使傳輸速率提升百分之二十，且此效果以乘算疊加。這聽起來很棒，直到你發現第一枚符文只讓傳輸速率提升每秒四 LP。不用說，你需要大約十幾枚這樣的符文，才會對傳輸速率有明顯的影響。雖然這些符文讓你能透過把生命精華儲存在祭壇之外來自動化石板的製作，但你將為此犧牲速度、容量與生成效率。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It's been a few weeks since I last made any headway with my blood magic research, needing to help with the tutoring of Vlad, Demir, and Bella along with my normal duties as a mage. I've had to leave twice this month in order to sort out one mess or another, whether it be helping with a pack of wild wolves or a bad harvest. Today, however, I managed to get some inspiration for a new sigil. When I was in the market buying more food, I noticed two children playing with a rock that was slightly magnetic. They were just running around, seeing what it would stick to and cheering when it did, or seeing how close they could push it to something before it pulled itself closer... That is what sparked my idea: a sigil that acts as a magnet, pulling items off the ground closer to you. In theory, I could rig the magic on it to apply a similar effect to all items and not just metallic ones... Three hours later, and my sigil is finished. It needs a great deal of mass in the form of four iron blocks, along with the classic gold plating infused into an imbued slate (drat, I never did work on a better name). This sigil needs to be toggled to activate, and while active will draw all nearby items to the user if they have room for them. Simple, but very effective...
zh_tw: 距離我上次在血魔法研究上有所進展已經過了幾週，因為我除了身為法師的日常職務外，還得協助輔導 Vlad、Demir 和 Bella。這個月我已經兩度離開，去處理各種麻煩事，無論是應付一群野狼還是歉收。不過今天，我終於為一枚新的印記獲得了靈感。我在市場買更多食物的時候，注意到兩個孩子在玩一塊略帶磁性的石頭。他們就只是到處跑，看看它能吸住什麼東西，吸住時就歡呼，或者看看能把它推到離某樣東西多近，它才會自己被吸過去……這點燃了我的靈感：一枚像磁鐵一樣、把地上的物品吸向你的印記。理論上，我可以調整其上的魔法，讓類似的效果作用於所有物品，而不僅僅是金屬物品……三個小時後，我的印記完成了。它需要大量質量，也就是四個鐵塊，還有經典的鍍金，灌注到一塊灌輸石板中（可惡，我始終沒去想更好的名字）。這枚印記需要切換才能啟動，啟動期間，只要使用者有空間，它就會把附近所有物品吸向使用者。簡單，但非常有效……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I've been asked to visit a small town to settle a few complaints that have been voiced lately by them, and am currently surprised that a closer bridge isn't one of them. I've had to walk three miles to cross this river, and now must walk another two tomorrow to reach them. If only I didn't need a bridge, or had thought to grab my air sigil (I still have a bruise from the last landing I had with it, so I wasn't keen on using it again so soon). Wait... What if I had a bridge that went with me? Better yet, what if I had a bridge that formed under my feet as I walked? Yes, that would be amazing... I'm back home after dealing with a feud over who really owned a cow (answer: neither of them, it wandered into town and they both thought it was one of their own), and have set out my workstation to try and capitalize on my idea. I'd want the sigil to place blocks that are phantasmal, only there temporarily before fading into nothing after I leave. For that, I'd need a special material... Soul sand might work... Add in a little stone for structuring around an imbued slate, then use the orb... Done! Now then, for a test run... Drat, I left the auto-writing quill running again. It works better than I hoped! The sigil creates a small five-by-five platform under me, staying at the same elevation as I walk through the air. Not only that, but I've tweaked it so that holding shift lowers the platform by one under you, and the blocks it makes can be easily broken for a quick descent. Not only that, but it will only spawn the blocks if you are on the ground; jumping or flying will not cause the bridge to reform until you touch solid ground, unless you hold shift, forcing it to form under you. And for one final convenience touch, right-clicking a phantom block with a block replaces it with that block, making roofs and platforms far easier to build. That should be enough for one night. I'll dub this sigil "The Phantom Bridge" and call it a night.
zh_tw: 我被請求去拜訪一座小鎮，解決他們最近提出的一些抱怨，而我現在很驚訝其中竟沒有一項是抱怨缺少一座更近的橋。我得走三英里才能過這條河，明天還得再走兩英里才能抵達他們那裡。要是我不需要橋，或者有想到帶上我的空氣印記就好了（上次用它降落留下的瘀青還在，所以我不太想這麼快又用它）。等等……要是我有一座能跟著我走的橋呢？更好的是，要是有一座在我行走時於腳下形成的橋呢？對，那會很棒……我處理完一場關於誰才是一頭牛真正主人的爭執（答案：兩個都不是，那頭牛是自己晃進鎮上的，他們卻都以為是自己的牛）後回到家，擺好我的工作台，試著把握這個想法。我希望這枚印記放置的是幻影般的方塊，只暫時存在，在我離開後就消失無蹤。為此，我需要一種特殊的材料……靈魂沙也許可行……加入一點石頭用來圍繞灌輸石板構成結構，然後使用血球……完成了！那麼，來試用看看……可惡，我又讓自動書寫羽毛筆一直開著了。它的效果比我期望的還要好！這枚印記會在我下方生成一個五乘五的小平台，我在空中行走時它會保持在同樣的高度。不僅如此，我還調整了它，讓按住 Shift 時平台會在你腳下降低一格，而它製造的方塊可以輕易破壞，以便快速下降。不僅如此，只有在你站在地面時它才會生成方塊；跳躍或飛行時，橋不會重新形成，直到你碰到堅實的地面，除非你按住 Shift，強迫它在你腳下形成。最後再加上一點便利的小功能，用方塊對著幻影方塊按右鍵，會把它替換成那種方塊，使屋頂和平台的建造容易得多。這樣一個晚上就夠了。我要把這枚印記命名為「幻影之橋」，然後收工。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Vlad asked me to help him today, requesting my assistance learning the sigils. Partway through, he asked if it was ever burdensome having so many on me at once... and I told him it was. Now, with a little of his help, I've created the Sigil of Holding, and it... well, it holds other sigils. Shift-right-clicking with it will allow you to place up to five sigils into one sigil (no physics here), and you can switch between the sigils that it holds by using the mouse scroll wheel while holding shift. If you ever want the sigils back, you can simply take them out whenever you wish.
zh_tw: Vlad 今天請我幫他，要求我協助他學習印記。進行到一半時，他問我同時帶這麼多枚在身上是否曾經是個負擔……我告訴他確實是。現在，在他一點點的幫助下，我做出了集持印記，它……嗯，它能收納其他印記。按住 Shift 右鍵點擊，可以將最多五枚印記放入一枚印記中（這裡沒有物理限制），並且按住 Shift 同時使用滑鼠滾輪，可以在它所收納的印記之間切換。如果你想把印記拿回來，隨時都可以直接把它們取出。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Demir hurt himself again today with a fire spell that backfired (well, it worked perfectly if setting the ground around him on fire was the intention). In hopes of stopping further injuries, I have infused the powers of the Water, Lava, and Air Sigils into an imbued slate. This seems to let the sigil act as a protective aura around the user, shielding them from drowning, burning, or fall damage at a higher LP consumption rate. Since I asked Demir to use it, he hasn't burned or bruised himself, but did pass out once from a lack of LP to fuel it. Sometimes solving one problem only makes more... But he has been learning, and I've been amazed at what his spells can do. Recently, he made a long-range teleportation spell and a flight spell not unlike the Air Sigil, but far faster.
zh_tw: Demir 今天又被他自己的火焰法術反噬而受傷了（嗯，如果目的是讓自己周圍的地面著火，那麼它可說是完美運作）。為了防止他再受傷，我把水、熔岩與空氣印記的力量灌注進一塊灌輸石板。這似乎讓這枚印記成為使用者周圍的保護光環，以更高的 LP 消耗速率保護他們不受溺水、燃燒或摔落傷害。自從我請 Demir 使用它之後，他就沒再燒傷或擦傷過，不過有一次因為缺少 LP 來驅動它而昏倒。有時解決了一個問題反而製造出更多……但他一直在學習，而他的法術能做到的事讓我大感驚奇。最近，他做出了一個長距離傳送法術，還有一個類似空氣印記但快得多的飛行法術。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: After a few days of nothing, I turned my attention to the construction of Master Magus's ritual stones. Looking them over, I might be able to replicate their usage and features using reinforced slates and Obsidian... A master stone, more complicated than the average ritual stone, might be possible if I use my Magician's Blood Orb and four ritual stones to handle its complex nature, along with a little more Obsidian... Yes, yes, it should be possible to recreate them without sacrificing any of their functionality. After asking him how he originally made the elemental scribing tools, I believe I can also replicate their manufacture in the Blood Altar... But it looks like the dusk inks are too complex for this altar to handle, creating an ink closer to dark gray than midnight black... Perhaps I'll have the power to form them later. For now, these four will work.
zh_tw: 無所事事的幾天後，我把注意力轉向建造 Master Magus 的儀式石。仔細檢視後，我也許能使用強化石板和黑曜石複製它們的用途與功能……主石比一般的儀式石更複雜，如果我使用我的魔術師血球和四塊儀式石來處理其複雜的特性，再加上多一點黑曜石，也許就有可能……對，對，應該有可能在不犧牲任何功能的情況下重現它們。在問過他當初是怎麼製作元素書寫工具之後，我相信我也能在血祭壇中複製它們的製作……但看來黃昏墨水對這座祭壇來說太複雜了，做出來的墨水更接近深灰色，而非午夜般的漆黑……也許之後我會有足夠的力量將它們製成。目前，這四種就夠用了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I had a flash of inspiration today (quite literally, as watching a few town guards light a replacement torch nearly blinded me from the sudden light). They spend so much on coal and charcoal to fuel those things... What if I had a simple replacement? A near-invisible light source that never goes out, can be made almost endlessly, and can easily be carried on your person? Never again would you need to place a torch to light a room, and they can ruin a room's look (not to mention the fire hazard they pose, ruining the look even more. "Charred mess" is never in style). Harnessing the power of Glowstone by running a "current" of LP through it, I can create a sigil that fires a projectile which, upon landing, forms a stable light source on par with that of a torch. The only sign of its existence is the light it gives off and faint red particles. While it uses a small amount of LP, the advantage over carrying stacks of torches is enough to justify it.
zh_tw: 我今天靈光一閃（字面意義上的，因為看著幾名鎮上的守衛點燃一支替換的火把，那突如其來的光線差點讓我失明）。他們在煤炭和木炭上花了那麼多錢來為這些東西提供燃料……如果我有一個簡單的替代品呢？一種近乎隱形、永不熄滅、幾乎可以無限製造、並且能輕易隨身攜帶的光源？再也不需要為了照亮房間而放置火把，而火把會破壞房間的美觀（更別提它們帶來的火災隱患，讓外觀更加慘不忍睹。「焦黑一團」從來不是流行款式）。利用螢石的力量，讓一股 LP 的「電流」流過它，我就能製作出一枚會發射拋射物的印記，拋射物落地後會形成一個與火把相當的穩定光源。它存在的唯一跡象，就是它發出的光和淡淡的紅色粒子。雖然它會消耗少量 LP，但比起攜帶成堆的火把所具有的優勢，已足以說明其價值。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Today, Magus gave us a lecture on armor, going over the practical applications (protection from large pointy sticks shoved in your direction and holding magic to improve the abilities of the wearer), typical construction of armor, and notable armors through the ages (and the very fatal flaws that their owners eventually discovered, much to their short-lived dismay). Seeing and reading all this, I feel it is time I take my own try at this art using blood magic. After testing a wide array of materials and structures, I discovered a process to make an almost indestructible metal using a casing filled with life essence, with glass hardened with diamonds and reinforced with bright red blood shards (more on their properties later) Magus showed me a while back (making the prototypes of this armor took longer than you would believe). The process needs the soul of a demon bound to it, but this seems to be a small price to pay.
zh_tw: 今天，Magus 給我們上了一堂關於盔甲的課，講解了實際用途（抵禦朝你戳來的大尖棒，以及容納魔法以增強穿戴者的能力）、盔甲的典型構造，以及歷代著名的盔甲（以及它們的主人最終發現的那些致命缺陷，令他們短暫地懊悔不已）。看了讀了這一切之後，我覺得是時候以血魔法親自嘗試這門技藝了。在測試了一大堆材料和結構之後，我發現了一種製程，可以用一個裝滿生命精華的外殼，搭配以鑽石硬化、並以鮮紅血之碎片強化的玻璃（血之碎片的特性稍後再談，那是 Magus 前陣子給我看的），製造出幾乎堅不可摧的金屬（製作這種盔甲的原型花的時間超乎你的想像）。這個製程需要綁定一隻惡魔的靈魂，但這似乎只是個小小的代價。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: To start, you need to make a "Soul Armor Forge." This block summons the demon soul and controls the transformation of the socket blocks into proper armor. By placing the filled socket blocks around the Soul Armor Forge in roughly the shape of the armor piece you want, with the forge in a gap, you set what it makes. Right-clicking the forge will then finish the process, creating the armor piece and binding the demon to the shards inside the armor. You will need to bind the armor to yourself, allowing the armor to drain your network to repair any damage it takes (another benefit of using blood shards in the creation). After donning the armor (making a few adjustments, still refining the creation process), I asked Magus to help test just how resistant this armor really is. Several nasty bruises later, we have decided this armor shields the wearer from ninety percent of damage from mundane sources. What is interesting is that it also blocks roughly eighty percent of magical damage, meaning many armor-piercing methods are far weaker. The metal also doesn't seem to hold enchantments, and the demons inside react quite negatively to our attempts to do so. Using the Ritual of Unbinding, we are able to deconstruct the armor back into the component sockets and anything that was inside them. I mention this because we seem to be able to "augment" the armor before creation by adding a combination of sigils, blood shards, and an orb. The sigil added to the armor piece (you can add anything to the socket by right-clicking with the item in hand) determines the effect and adds a passive cost to wearing the armor piece. The blood shard lets you add an upgrade; the weak shards we have at our disposal only allow one upgrade, but in theory a stronger shard should allow more to be added. Finally, the orb seems to lower the cost of the upgrade. Every sigil seems to have something to do with the normal effect of the sigil, either giving you a passive bonus or having the effect of the sigil happen automatically around you. A few examples are a Water Sigil making you immune to drowning, Fast Miner always being active, and a Green Grove Sigil acting around you.
zh_tw: 首先，你需要製作一個「靈魂裝甲鍛造石」。這個方塊會召喚惡魔靈魂，並控制插槽方塊轉化為正式盔甲的過程。把裝滿的插槽方塊大致擺成你想要的盔甲部件形狀，圍繞在靈魂裝甲鍛造石周圍，並讓鍛造石位於其中的空隙，這樣就設定了它的產物。接著對鍛造石按右鍵就會完成整個過程，製造出盔甲部件，並將惡魔綁定到盔甲內的碎片上。你需要把盔甲綁定給自己，讓盔甲能抽取你的網路來修復它受到的任何損傷（這是在製作中使用血之碎片的另一項好處）。穿上盔甲後（做了一些調整，製作流程仍在改良中），我請 Magus 幫忙測試這件盔甲到底有多耐打。幾處嚴重的瘀青之後，我們判定這件盔甲能為穿戴者抵擋百分之九十來自一般來源的傷害。有趣的是，它也能擋下大約百分之八十的魔法傷害，這意味著許多穿甲手段要弱得多。這種金屬似乎也無法容納附魔，而且裡面的惡魔對我們試圖這麼做的舉動反應非常負面。利用解綁儀式，我們能把盔甲拆解回組成它的各個插槽以及裡面的任何東西。我之所以提到這點，是因為我們似乎可以在製作之前，透過加入印記、血之碎片和血球的組合來「增幅」盔甲。加到盔甲部件上的印記（你可以手持物品對插槽按右鍵，將任何東西加入其中）決定了效果，並為穿戴該盔甲部件增加被動消耗。血之碎片讓你加入一項升級；我們手邊的虛弱碎片只允許一項升級，但理論上更強的碎片應該能加入更多。最後，血球似乎能降低升級的消耗。每一枚印記似乎都與該印記的原本效果有關，要嘛給你被動加成，要嘛讓印記的效果在你周圍自動發生。幾個例子：水之印記讓你免疫溺水，速掘印記始終處於啟動狀態，以及綠林印記在你周圍起作用。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I've managed to use my newfound knowledge of armor and experience making bound armor to try to improve thaumium armor using blood magic. By throwing Goggles of Revealing or a thaumium chestplate, leggings, or boots into the ritual, the armor is transformed into a "Sanguine" version, with a small vis discount and protection on par with pure diamond. What is really interesting is that this armor can be augmented with runic shielding, and then socketed into bound armor in the same fashion as a sigil to pass on the runic shielding, with the bonus that adding the Sanguine Helm to the bound helm will allow the wearer to see things like aura nodes as if you had goggles on. I should note that you can only socket a Sanguine armor piece into the same armor type (helm into helm, boots into boots...), and that any vis discount is lost when you do this.
zh_tw: 我運用我對盔甲新獲得的知識，以及製作綁定盔甲的經驗，嘗試用血魔法改良神秘金屬盔甲。將揭示護目鏡，或是神秘金屬的胸甲、護腿或靴子投入儀式後，這件盔甲會被轉化成「血色」版本，擁有小幅的 vis 折扣，以及與純鑽石相當的防護力。真正有趣的是，這種盔甲可以用符文屏蔽來增幅，然後以與印記相同的方式鑲嵌到綁定盔甲中以傳遞符文屏蔽，額外的好處是，將血色頭盔加入綁定頭盔後，穿戴者就能像戴著護目鏡一樣看見靈氣節點之類的東西。我需要說明的是，你只能將血色盔甲部件鑲嵌到相同類型的盔甲上（頭盔對頭盔、靴子對靴子……），而且這麼做時任何 vis 折扣都會消失。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Having the armor's special effects active all the time has become a little bothersome. To deal with this, I have managed to create an "Armor Inhibitor" to suppress the special effects it offers in cases where they are more bothersome than helpful. Unfortunately, it is a bit all-or-nothing in this regard.
zh_tw: 讓盔甲的特殊效果一直處於啟動狀態變得有點煩人。為了解決這個問題，我成功製作出了「裝甲抑制器」，用來在特殊效果弊大於利的情況下抑制它所提供的效果。不幸的是，在這方面它有點「全有或全無」。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It's coming up on the three-year anniversary of Magus taking me on as an apprentice. Time seems to have flown by while I've been engrossed in research on applications of blood magic and working with Magus... I should make a gift for Magus as a thank you for these last few years. Considering the complex nature of his rituals, an aid to building them might just be the perfect gift... Ugh... Making a way to build rituals more easily proved to be quite the task (and it reminds me of the rule of conservation of effort...), but I finally have it ready in time for the anniversary. While it isn't cheap to craft (costing the four elemental inks, four diamonds, and an emerald), I've gone to great pains to make it easy to use. Shift-right-clicking will cycle through a preset list of rituals, and shift-right-clicking on a block will also rotate the direction the ritual will face (for anything like the Ritual of Speed, where that matters). Shift-left-clicking will go through this list in reverse, for those times you accidentally go past the one you want. By normal right-clicking on a Master Ritual Stone, the diviner will take stones out of your inventory, place them in the world, and ink them to build the selected ritual. To make it clear it is working, it emits green particle effects whenever it places a block successfully. However, it can only place a block in an empty space. Anything at all in the way will stop the process until the obstruction has been removed. It is a small annoyance, but nothing major enough to risk breaking the diviner (again). Magus adores his gift; having rituals faster and easier to build is the one thing he could actually use (that he doesn't already have). The fact that it makes anyone who uses rituals' lives easier is just a bonus at this point. As it turns out, he got me a gift as well: a pair of ichorium wand caps, the one thing I had been dreaming about for a long time...
zh_tw: 再過不久就是 Magus 收我為學徒的三週年紀念了。我沉浸在血魔法應用的研究以及與 Magus 共事之中，時間似乎飛逝而過……我應該為 Magus 準備一份禮物，感謝這幾年來的栽培。考慮到他的儀式複雜的特性，一件輔助建造儀式的工具，也許正是最完美的禮物……唉……事實證明，要做出一種讓儀式更容易建造的方法相當費工（這讓我想起了「努力守恆定律」……），但我終於在紀念日前趕出來了。雖然製作成本不低（需要四種元素墨水、四顆鑽石和一顆綠寶石），但我費盡心思讓它容易使用。按住 Shift 右鍵會在一份預設的儀式清單中循環切換，而按住 Shift 對方塊右鍵也會旋轉儀式所朝的方向（針對速度儀式這類方向重要的儀式）。按住 Shift 左鍵則會反向瀏覽這份清單，方便你不小心跳過想要的那個時使用。對著主儀式石按一般的右鍵，占卜器就會從你的物品欄中取出石頭，放置到世界中，並為它們上墨，以建造選定的儀式。為了讓你清楚知道它正在運作，每當成功放置一個方塊時，它都會發出綠色的粒子效果。不過，它只能將方塊放置在空的空間。路徑上若有任何東西阻擋，整個過程就會停止，直到障礙被移除。這是一個小小的困擾，但還不到值得冒著（再次）弄壞占卜器的風險去處理的程度。Magus 非常喜歡他的禮物；讓儀式建造得更快更容易，是他唯一真正用得上（而他還沒有的）東西。至於它能讓任何使用儀式的人生活更輕鬆這點，在此刻只是額外的附加價值。結果他也送了我一份禮物：一對 ichorium 的法杖頂蓋，正是我長久以來夢寐以求的東西……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Reading through my older entries for inspiration on what to do with our current power (I believe we have started reaching the limit, struggling to stretch what we have as far as it will go), I noticed that I might have forgotten about covering blood shards like I said I would a few months ago... I'd best start from the top. Blood shards, as Magus has likely stated already, are fragments left behind after vanquishing a hostile mob with a demonic weapon (the Bound Sword or Energy Blaster). Upon close inspection, I see small strands that look shockingly like those of our soul networks... Well, in theory anything with a "soul" could have a network, but this is a surprise nonetheless.
