english_value: That is what we have so far. We are working on trying out a stronger blood orb, but Magus keeps telling us that what we need to upgrade the altar is extremely hard to get. To bind my time, I have started talking with Sinferrous about "Greater Demons." We have decided that our next goal is to start summoning them, but their auras are so strong that the gateway our Master Blood Orb can form is far too weak. We will need something better, and so we have reached square one again, needing the stronger orb. Well, the Hell's Harvest Festival is soon, so I will write if anything comes up. Strangely, Magus mentioned having replies from people he is inviting coming soon. Well, I had no idea what was coming with the Hell's Harvest. Magus calls up a doorway from the ground to a giant building full of technology, something extremely rare in the mage guild. Most people come here to get away from all the technology of the other lands, to get back to basics and make their own way in life. Yet what I saw down there was beyond even my wildest dreams. Tech that was only spoken of in hush tones, machines that aren't even available to private businesses, let alone the public! Magus had mentioned once before that he worked on the conglomeration's members board, but this... I thought he meant that he was a grunt worker, or some administrator or manager. But he is on THE board, where all the world's leaders meet... And Magus told us they will be meeting here this year since he is the host. I always thought Magus had secrets, but reality seems to go beyond my wildest dreams. Magus asked us to help prepare "The Hall", as he referred to it. After a few months of hard work, the Hell's Harvest is only a few days away. Magus started calling in favors for help, and the boys started talking about just who would be coming. Only now have I realized that I'm going to meet some of the most powerful people in the world! Magus gave us a few books on every member, so we would know something about each of them. Sadly, the books he gave us didn't include pictures, so we had no idea what they would look like. I'll write again after the festival is over. I have met so many people the last few days, from so many places and from countless walks of life. I became friends with a woman by the name of Iza Lemming, and another girl about my age by the name of Carrin Calclavia. For such amazing people, they seem so... normal. Another man I met, Magus keeps referring to as "Greg." As it turns out, Greg owns GregTech, and he is the reason the demons are running rampant like they are. Strangely, I don't hate him. By all rights I should hate him for everything he has done, all the people who have died to the demons... But I don't. From what both Magus and Greg have told me, he did the same thing I did: opened up a portal to Tartarius without knowing what would come out. The real difference was that I had a demon to help me build the portal, and he had to do it from scratch. Without the help of a demon, the portal he opened was unstable and drove any demon to walk through it mad, and they lost control of themselves. He had no idea that would happen, that that could happen. I can't bring myself to blame him for something he could have never predicted. In other news, Magus has gotten us the Nether Stars we need for our next altar upgrade. The bad news is we must kill the Withers to claim them. Thirty Withers, to be exact. I have mastered witchcraft, Botania, and have learned what I can of blood magic from my brothers and Magus. But will it be enough to kill one of those... things? I asked Sinferrous one night, and he told me he had no idea what a "Wither" was, but if I needed to fight one, he was willing to stand by my side, as would any of the other demons I had a pact with. With all of them by my side, I might stand a chance. We beat the Withers. All of them. I... was terrified of it from the moment I saw it. I had three skulls for heads, and it made unnatural sounds as it started warming up. Then the attacks it used, launching flying blue and black skulls, were devastating in the blast and the "Withering" effect they leave behind if you get hit. Thankfully, the "Freezer" we fought them in was completely blast-proof (warded octuple compressed Cobblestone), so falling into holes was not a problem. After an eternity compressed into an hour, we had beaten all thirty Withers. My brothers were all injured, so I needed to go change a few bandages. I'll write again when I get a chance. Now that my brothers have fully healed, life almost seems to have gone back to normal. Well, as normal as it will ever be in a house full of mages. I've started experimenting with Nether Stars in my efforts to summon Greater Demons, but I still haven't managed one. In other news, the number of demon attacks has been getting smaller as of late. Magus said this might be the calm before the storm, and asked me to start leaving the mage guild to help with demon attacks in the other lands. Most people are happy to have my help, but others... let's say I rarely sleep in the inns and leave it at that.
zh_tw: 目前我們就只有這些。我們正在嘗試研究更強的血球，但 Magus 一直告訴我們，升級祭壇所需的東西極難取得。為了打發時間，我開始和 Sinferrous 談論「高階惡魔」。我們已決定下一個目標是開始召喚它們，但它們的靈氣實在太強，我們的大師血球所能形成的通道遠遠不夠。我們需要更好的東西，於是我們又回到了原點，需要更強的血球。嗯，地獄收穫節就快到了，所以如果有什麼事情發生，我會寫下來。奇怪的是，Magus 提到他邀請的人很快就會有回覆。嗯，我完全不知道地獄收穫節會發生什麼。Magus 從地面召喚出一扇門，通往一棟充滿科技的巨大建築，這在法師公會中是極其罕見的。大多數人來到這裡是為了遠離其他土地的所有科技，回歸基本、自力更生。然而，我在下面看到的景象，超出了我最瘋狂的想像。只能以低聲耳語談論的科技、連私人企業都無法取得的機器，更別說一般大眾了！Magus 之前提過一次他在 Conglomeration 的成員董事會工作，但這個……我以為他是指自己是個基層工人，或是某種行政人員或經理。但他是在那個董事會裡，就是全世界的領袖開會的地方……而 Magus 告訴我們，今年他們會在這裡開會，因為他是東道主。我一直覺得 Magus 有祕密，但現實似乎超出了我最瘋狂的想像。Magus 請我們協助準備他所稱的「The Hall」。經過幾個月的辛勤工作，地獄收穫節只剩幾天了。Magus 開始請人幫忙，男孩們則開始談論到底有誰會來。直到現在我才意識到，我即將見到世界上一些最有權勢的人！Magus 給了我們關於每位成員的幾本書，這樣我們就能對每個人有所了解。可惜，他給我們的書裡沒有圖片，所以我們完全不知道他們長什麼樣子。我會在慶典結束後再寫。這幾天我認識了好多人，來自許許多多地方、各行各業。我和一位名叫 Iza Lemming 的女士，還有另一位和我年紀相仿的女孩 Carrin Calclavia 成了朋友。對於如此了不起的人，她們似乎非常……平凡。我遇到的另一個人，Magus 一直稱他為「Greg」。結果，Greg 擁有 GregTech，他就是惡魔如此肆虐的原因。奇怪的是，我並不恨他。按理說我應該因他做過的一切、因所有死於惡魔手下的人而恨他……但我並沒有。從 Magus 和 Greg 告訴我的來看，他做了和我一樣的事：在不知道會出現什麼的情況下，開啟了通往 Tartarus 的傳送門。真正的差別在於，我有一隻惡魔幫我建造傳送門，而他必須從頭開始做。沒有惡魔的幫助，他開啟的傳送門是不穩定的，會讓任何走過它的惡魔發瘋，失去自我控制。他完全不知道會發生這種事，也不可能預知。我無法讓自己去責怪他做了一件他永遠不可能預料到的事。另一方面，Magus 已經為我們弄到了下一次祭壇升級所需的下界之星。壞消息是，我們必須殺死凋零怪才能取得它們。確切地說，是三十隻凋零怪。我已精通巫術、植物學，並從我的哥哥們和 Magus 那裡學到了我所能學的血魔法。但這足以殺死其中一隻那種……東西嗎？有天晚上我問了 Sinferrous，它告訴我它不知道「凋零怪」是什麼，但如果我需要與之一戰，它願意站在我身邊，與我訂立契約的其他任何惡魔也一樣。有它們所有人在我身邊，我也許還有一線機會。我們打敗了凋零怪。全部。我……從見到它的那一刻起就嚇壞了。它有三顆頭骨作為頭，開始蓄力時發出了不自然的聲音。然後它所使用的攻擊，發射飛行的藍色與黑色頭骨，其爆炸以及被擊中後留下的「凋零」效果都具有毀滅性。幸好我們戰鬥的「冷凍庫」完全防爆（經結界加持的八重壓縮圓石），所以掉進洞裡不成問題。在一個小時被壓縮成永恆的時間之後，我們擊敗了全部三十隻凋零怪。我的哥哥們都受了傷，所以我需要去換一些繃帶。有機會我會再寫。現在我的哥哥們已完全痊癒，生活幾乎像是回到了正軌。嗯，在一棟滿是法師的屋子裡，能多正常就多正常。我已開始在召喚高階惡魔的努力中實驗下界之星，但仍然沒有成功。另一方面，近來惡魔襲擊的數量一直在減少。Magus 說這可能是暴風雨前的寧靜，並要我開始離開法師公會，去協助其他土地上的惡魔襲擊。大多數人樂於得到我的幫助，但其他人……這麼說吧，我很少睡在旅店裡，就說到這裡。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Magus has sent out a call for all free mages, with little in the way of context for why. Even I don't know what this is about... He did say there would be a picnic in a little over a week, however. But knowing him, he has something up his sleeve. The conclave of mages was held today, with some... interesting results. Fifty people in total showed up, from all walks of magic and life. We met on a hill under the shade of a grove of trees about a mile from here; many of the mages brought their own meals for the picnic. After ten minutes faffing about with people getting settled, Magus called the conclave to order. "I'm sure you all have ideas on why I called you here, and I know Jarico was running lots... so I might as well sate your curiosity. I finally have a plan on how we can deal with the incursion of demons. For the last few years, they have been a hazard, an endless army we have fought off. The two things that have complicated our efforts: the fact we didn't know where they have been coming from, and the side effects of closing the portal. Thankfully, I have managed to address both issues." At this point, Magus unrolled a map with a few hand-drawn markings, which everyone crowded around. "This circled area here is the location of the portal they are getting in: a secret GregTech research lab in the middle of a forest. I have gained permission to mount an excursion to close this portal, but it sadly isn't that simple. The portal is unstable and has been slowly damaging the fabric of space here." At this point, one of the others interrupted with "But if it is slow, how bad could it be?" Magus responded with "Very. This portal has been left open for the better part of the last three decades, and the damage keeps getting worse and worse. As it stands, closing the portal might cause more harm than good, as strange as that may seem." A different mage, a bit older, a little wiser, and a lot more cranky, interrupted this time. "If that is the case, why have you called us here? I assume you intend to do more than waste our time." Magus smiled at this, replying, "Yes, I think you will be interested in my discovery. To prevent a spatial fracture from occurring, we will need to jump through a few hoops, as it were. You see, closing the portal won't cause any issues. It is the removal of the connection between our world and theirs that ends with all the nasty side effects. Now, a few of you might think the portal and the connection are one and the same. That isn't the case; instead, the portal is the entrance and exit, while the actual connection is the road they lead to. So we should be able to close the portal here, then open a new portal here..." Magus pointed to a second circled location on the map, far into the mage guild in mostly unpopulated land. "...before the connection collapses in on itself. If we can pull that off, then the new stable portal will not only allow the connection to remain but will ease the burden that the old one is causing. Over time, the strain on space should dissipate, and we can close the portal for good. Any questions?" A female mage was the quickest, asking "Wait, if we are opening another of those portals, won't demons be able to come out of it as well?" "Yes, but they won't be in pain as they are now. While they can flow in, we will be able to choose where we open the portal." An older mage, who looked to be going for the classic white beard but could only manage a gray patchy fuzz, said "So that is why you circled Venric's Folly. Place is a canyon with steep walls a hundred and fifty meters high. There are less than half a dozen valleys in or out of there." Magus smiled, saying "Right, the area should function as a prison. We send one group to terraform and secure the area, while a second sieges the research lab to close the old portal. The tricky part comes in the fact that we have roughly a five-minute time limit between closing the portal and opening the new one. We must open the new one after the old has closed so a new connection isn't formed, but wait too long and the connection collapses in itself." Magus started assigning people to each group, with a fairly even split by the end. Magus and I would be with the terraforming group (Magus to open the portal, and myself because of my strange affinity with demons), while the other three aid in the siege. Apparently closing that portal should be as simple as shutting off the generators for the lab and thus cutting all power to the portal. Because it sounds simple, it will be nothing of the sort. The demonic aura of the area seems to mess with some forms of magic, as an experiment we ran a few weeks ago showed. We shared this discovery when someone asked why Magus didn't just drop a meteor on it. "We tried that. Three times, in fact. All of them ended in different, strange ways", answered Magus. Tiberius tacked on, "First one was pushed away and landed a mile from the target", followed by Demir with, "Second turned into blue cheese" (this got a few worried looks from some of the more experienced mages. Things turning into cheese was bad, but normally it was cheddar or jack. Blue was almost unheard of). I added, "The third was teleported away, and we still haven't found it." Vlad couldn't help but add, "On an unrelated note, we haven't heard from the Redpower Institute in a while." The general plan was for the group to brute-force their way into the lab, locate the generators, then set up a foothold inside at the generators to rest at while waiting for the predetermined time. The terraforming group was to travel to Venric's Folly and close off any entrances and exits, level some ground, and change the biomes inside the depression in preparation for the ritual to open the portal. Most forms of communication would either not work, be too slow, or be unavailable to one or both parties, so Magus opted for a simple time-based system. This entire operation would take around two weeks; group one would need three days to prepare for the siege, a little over a week to get to the lab, then the remainder would be to enter the building, find the generators, then hold off the demons by building a foothold to wait in. Group two, on the other hand, would have only a day to gather everything they could carry on their backs, then regroup at Ank to ride the wagons for a ten-day trip to the canyon to start working. After that, we need to build the ritual and hope to time it right... then move on from there. Once the new stable portal is open, all bets are off as to what might happen next. The other mages have left to ready their things, and we leave for Ank in the morning. It has been a rough and bumpy week and a bit, but we have arrived at Venric's Folly (I asked about the name on the way here. Apparently there is a legend about how the area was formed involving a mage named Venric and a large magical explosion. No one knows if it is true, but knowing mages I'd say it was possible.) The next few days are going to be filled with us working our magic on this area, smoothing out the walls to a near vertical surface and sealing off any and all possible exits to keep the demons in and foolhardy travelers out. After that, we clear out an area near the heart of the canyon to build the ritual. Magus has requested I find a feral demon, something not too difficult all things considered, then bring it back to the ritual location. I'll try to write again when the ritual has been finished. It is the day before we open the portal, and Magus has brought us all together around the wicked-looking structure he has built. "Tomorrow the peace ends and begins!" he cried when the mages had started gathering. "For the common man outside these walls, we will have brought peace and security to their lives, with the threat of demons ransacking their homes gone. For us, however, we will have created a lot of bloody work. We will need people to keep an eye on these demons, examine the walls, and make sure nothing gets in or out. We will create a schedule, but that will come later as I know we are all weary. But this is not why I have called you here, as it is far more dire that a heinous error is corrected! I forgot to name this ritual behind me, with everything that has happened lately. Bella, can you come up here?" I walked up quickly, eyes of the fellow mages following me. "Bella, I give the honor of naming this ritual to you." In the space of seconds, it felt like I ran through thousands of possibilities. I finally settled on a name that seemed most appropriate. "Let us call it the Convocation of the Damned."
zh_tw: Magus 發出了召集所有自由法師的呼籲，對原因幾乎沒有說明。連我也不知道是怎麼回事……不過他說過，再過一週多一點會有一場野餐。但以我對他的了解，他一定有什麼底牌。法師議會今天召開了，結果有些……有趣。總共有五十個人出席，來自各種魔法領域和社會階層。我們在離這裡大約一英里的一座樹林蔭下的山丘上碰面；許多法師自備了野餐餐點。人們花了十分鐘瞎忙著安頓好後，Magus 宣布議會開始。「我相信你們都對我為何召集你們有自己的想法，而我知道 Jarico 傳了很多話……所以我不妨滿足你們的好奇心。我終於有了一個計畫，可以應對惡魔的入侵。過去幾年，它們一直是個威脅，是我們一直在擊退的無窮大軍。使我們的努力複雜化的兩件事：我們不知道它們是從哪裡來的，以及關閉傳送門的副作用。幸運的是，我已設法解決了這兩個問題。」此時，Magus 攤開一張有幾處手繪標記的地圖，所有人都圍了上來。「這個圈起來的區域就是它們進來的傳送門所在地：一座位於森林中央的 GregTech 祕密研究實驗室。我已獲准發動一次行動去關閉這扇傳送門，但可惜事情沒那麼簡單。這扇傳送門不穩定，一直在慢慢損害這裡的空間結構。」此時，另一人打斷說：「但如果是慢慢的，能有多糟？」Magus 回答：「非常糟。這扇傳送門已經敞開了將近三十年，而損害一直在不斷惡化。照目前的狀況，關閉傳送門可能弊大於利，儘管這看起來很奇怪。」這時，另一位年紀稍大、稍微睿智、而且脾氣暴躁得多的法師打斷了他。「如果是這樣，你為什麼召集我們來這裡？我想你不只是要浪費我們的時間吧。」Magus 對此微微一笑，回答：「是的，我想你們會對我的發現感興趣。為了防止空間裂縫發生，我們需要跳過幾道，如某種障礙。你們看，關閉傳送門本身不會造成任何問題。真正導致所有惡劣副作用的，是我們的世界與它們的世界之間連結的移除。現在，你們有些人可能認為傳送門與連結是同一回事。其實不然；傳送門是入口與出口，而真正的連結則是它們所通往的道路。所以我們應該能夠在這裡關閉傳送門，然後在這裡開啟一個新的傳送門……」Magus 指向地圖上第二個圈起來的地點，位於法師公會深處、大多無人居住的土地上。「……在連結自我崩塌之前。如果我們能做到，那麼新的穩定傳送門不僅能讓連結繼續存在，還能減輕舊傳送門所造成的負擔。隨著時間推移，空間的壓力應該會消散，我們就可以永久關閉傳送門。有什麼問題嗎？」一位女法師動作最快，她問：「等等，如果我們要開啟另一個那種傳送門，惡魔不也能從裡面出來嗎？」「是的，但它們不會像現在這樣痛苦。雖然它們可以湧入，但我們可以選擇開啟傳送門的地點。」一位年紀較大的法師，看起來想留經典的白鬍子，卻只能弄出灰色的稀疏絨毛，說道：「所以這就是你圈起 Venric's Folly 的原因。那地方是一座峽谷，峭壁高達一百五十公尺。進出那裡的山谷不到半打。」Magus 微笑著說：「沒錯，那個區域應該能作為一座監獄。我們派一組人去改造地形並確保該區域的安全，同時第二組圍攻研究實驗室以關閉舊傳送門。棘手之處在於，從關閉傳送門到開啟新傳送門之間，我們大約只有五分鐘的時限。我們必須在舊傳送門關閉之後開啟新的，這樣才不會形成新的連結，但等得太久，連結就會自我崩塌。」Magus 開始將人員分配到各組，到最後分得相當平均。Magus 和我會在改造地形的組別（Magus 負責開啟傳送門，而我則是因為我與惡魔之間奇特的親和力），而其他三人協助圍攻。顯然，關閉那扇傳送門應該就像關掉實驗室的發電機、從而切斷傳送門的所有電力那麼簡單。因為聽起來簡單，所以絕不會那麼簡單。該區域的惡魔氣息似乎會干擾某些形式的魔法，正如我們幾週前進行的一項實驗所顯示的。有人問 Magus 為何不直接朝那裡扔一顆隕石時，我們分享了這項發現。「我們試過了。事實上，三次。每一次都以不同的奇怪方式收場。」Magus 回答。Tiberius 補充說：「第一顆被推開，落在離目標一英里遠的地方。」接著 Demir 說：「第二顆變成了藍起司。」（這讓一些經驗較豐富的法師露出擔憂的神情。東西變成起司已經夠糟了，但通常是切達或傑克起司。藍起司幾乎聞所未聞。）我補充道：「第三顆被傳送走了，我們到現在還沒找到它。」Vlad 忍不住補了一句：「題外話，我們已經好一陣子沒有 Redpower Institute 的消息了。」整體計畫是由那組人強行闖入實驗室，找到發電機，然後在發電機處設立據點，在等待預定時間期間在那裡休息。改造地形的組別則前往 Venric's Folly，封閉任何出入口，整平一些地面，並改變窪地內的生態域，為開啟傳送門的儀式做準備。大多數形式的通訊要不是無法運作，就是太慢，或是對一方或雙方不可用，因此 Magus 選擇了簡單的基於時間的系統。整個行動將耗時約兩週；第一組需要三天來準備圍攻，一週多一點抵達實驗室，其餘時間則用來進入建築物、找到發電機，然後建立據點抵擋惡魔並在那裡等待。另一方面，第二組只有一天時間來蒐集他們能背得動的一切，然後在 Ank 集合，搭乘馬車進行十天的旅程前往峽谷開始工作。之後，我們需要建造儀式，並希望能掌握好時機……然後從那裡繼續。一旦新的穩定傳送門開啟，接下來會發生什麼就難以預料了。其他法師已經離開去整理行裝，我們明早出發前往 Ank。這是艱難而顛簸的一週多，但我們已經抵達 Venric's Folly（我在路上問過這個名字。顯然有個傳說講述了這片區域如何形成，涉及一名叫 Venric 的法師和一次巨大的魔法爆炸。沒有人知道是否屬實，但以我對法師的了解，我會說這是有可能的。）接下來幾天，我們將忙著在這個區域施展魔法，把牆壁修整成接近垂直的表面，並封死任何可能的出口，以將惡魔困在裡面、將魯莽的旅人擋在外面。之後，我們清理峽谷中心附近的一片區域來建造儀式。Magus 要我找一隻野生惡魔，考慮到所有情況這並不太難，然後把它帶回儀式地點。等儀式完成後，我會試著再寫。今天是我們開啟傳送門的前一天，Magus 把我們全都召集到他建造的那座看起來邪惡的結構周圍。「明天，和平將結束，也將開始！」法師們開始聚集時，他喊道。「對於這些牆外的平民百姓，我們將為他們的生活帶來和平與安全，惡魔洗劫他們家園的威脅將消失。然而，對於我們，我們將創造出大量血腥的工作。我們需要人來監視這些惡魔、檢查牆壁，並確保沒有東西進出。我們會制定一份時間表，但那是之後的事，因為我知道我們都累了。但我召集你們來這裡並不是為了這個，因為更緊迫的是糾正一個可惡的錯誤！由於最近發生的一切，我忘了為我身後這個儀式命名。Bella，妳可以上來嗎？」我快步走上前，同行法師們的目光跟著我。「Bella，我把為這個儀式命名的榮譽交給妳。」在幾秒鐘的時間裡，我感覺自己彷彿閃過了上千種可能性。最後我選定了一個似乎最貼切的名字。「我們就叫它『詛咒者的集會』。」
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It has been a few days since we opened the portal, and I have noticed a few interesting things about the demons that have come out. First, they are already bound in service of other demons, so they won't be willing to serve us. Second, these demons are just the grunts, the weaklings, the dime-a-dozen henchmen. Considering that they have proved strong enough to dispatch a skilled mage with ease, I worry about facing the higher-ranking demons. According to Sinferrous, these grunts can come in one of five types: Fire (the ones we got; a portal seems to lock on to a set type), Ice, Earth, Wind, and Normal/Untyped. Each one has some advantages and disadvantages over the others, so we will need to prepare based on what comes out of the portal.
zh_tw: 傳送門開啟已經過了幾天，我注意到從裡面出來的惡魔有幾個有趣之處。首先，它們已經被綁定為其他惡魔服務，所以不會願意為我們效力。其次，這些惡魔只是小兵，弱者，隨處可見的廉價爪牙。考慮到它們已證明有足夠的實力輕易解決一名熟練的法師，我擔心要面對更高階的惡魔。根據 Sinferrous 的說法，這些小兵分為五種類型：火（我們遇到的就是這種；傳送門似乎會鎖定某個類型）、冰、土、風，以及普通／無屬性。每一種相對於其他種類都有一些優缺點，所以我們需要根據傳送門出來的類型做好準備。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: My life use to be simple. Get up at dawn, move with the caravan, keep an eye out for bandits, fight any that show up, do any odd jobs that needed doing, go to bed. For about ten years my daily routine was just this, with a few days a year where this cycle was broken. Living with traders was a hard life, but it wasn't bad. I gave up this life when my brother, Vlad, decided to take care of Bella, and I was given the choice of staying with the Merry Lamp or leaving with my brother. Wasn't much of a choice, really. He knows more details than I do, but soon after he found her the three of us were walking to the home of someone called "Magus Arcana." After we set up camp I asked my brother if he knew where we're going. I quickly learned that we didn't have much to go on. My brother had heard a few rumors, but nothing really concrete. With only the general direction of "To the lands of the mage guild!" we set off. So our adventure began, if a little out of the blue. My name is Demir Highborn, and I am a blood mage. I have since earned the title of "The Battle Mage" to go with my brots "The Alchemist", my teacs "The Ritual Master", my friend Tiberius' "The Architect" and my adoptive sister Bellas "The Demon Kin." But I am getting ahead of myself, back to the beginning of our little "Journey." About two days after leaving the caravan, we stopped at a small town to get my brother a sword (We only had enough spare money for one) while I went to sell a few gems. While at the market I noticed two men in mage's robes, so if anyone was going to know where to find Magus here it would be them. I walked up to a vendor near them, neither of the two noticing me walk past them while they chatted. I traded the gems for a fair bit of coin, then asked the merchant in a voice a little louder then normal, "While I'm here, have you heard any rumors of a man called "Magus Arcana"? I have some business with him." The merchant chuckled and told me that he was nothing but legends told to kids to calm them down. Thankfully, he wasn't the one I was asking. Out of the corner of my eye I saw both of the robed men glance at me, then quickly turn back. They never would have made it as traders. I thanked him for his time, then started walking out of the market, down a narrow path under a few oak trees that had very few people. As I walked away, I noticed both of the robed men following me, just as I planed. I slowly walked down the narrow path, giving the pair more than enough time to catch up with me. "Hey," one of them said as they drew close to me. I turned around, acting surprised that they had stopped me. "Why hello there. ' Didn't see you walk up." I told them, a simple trick to fool even mages that could tell when you're lying. While it was true that I didn't "see" them, I still knew fully well that they were coming. The one on the right nodded, reading that I told them the truth. "We heard you asking about Magus, what business do you have with him?" The one one the left asked me. "Well, that is a little complicated. I need to find him so that he might teach my brother and I. I already know a little about magic, but people willing to teach for little to no coin are few and far between these days." The one on the right nodded again, then said "That is far too true. My brother Way and I were once apprentices to Magus, and he refused every coin we tried to give him. If you want to find Magus, head north east to a village called Lurric at the heart of these lands. We can't give exact directions, but I'm sure this is better then what you had. But fair warning, he tends to be reluctant to teach just anyone who comes knocking." I thanked them both, and they told me to say hello to their old teacher. Returning to the well, where my brother said to meet up, I found both Bella and Vlad waiting for me. "What took so long? You normally don't take this long to make a sell.", my brother asked. I told him what I found out. "I got more then coin this time. I got a name: Lurric. That is where Magus is suppose to be living, and we should find it if we head north east." About three weeks of walking later, we arrived at Lurric. It was as lackluster as the rumors said, with very few signs that a mage lived around here. Vlad found one such sign while Bella and I went to find some antiseptic for the wounds he had gotten when a skeleton caught us off guard. He meet us with a grin on his face, then pointed us to a cobble stone path out of the village. After walking for about a quarter of a mile, we finally saw the fabled stone house of the great mage Magus Arcana. To say it didn't look like the house a mage would live in was an understatement. The outside was simple, with nothing really standing out that screamed "Magic!", so I became very skeptical of just how great he is if he lives in a place like this. It was smaller than the homes of some of the local lords, let alone most of the nobles. We walked up to the simple wooden door, the only possessions we had left were the clothes on our backs, Vlad's brewing stand, a few odd items that Vlad had collected over the years that we couldn't sell, and the sword we had bought a few weeks ago that had saved our lives more than once. I wouldn't have let us in, let alone take us under his wing and teach magic. We looked more like street urchins then potential mages, in all honesty. When we walked up to the door, Vlad asked us both if we were ready. I told him I was, and Bella (Who had hidden behind me and Vlad) gave him a quick nod. With our blessing, Vlad knocked on the door sharply. After almost a minute the door opened, and a tall man answered us. Vlad talked to him, asking if Magus was here. Another minute later and a slightly taller man greeted us. I let Vlad do all the talking, watching as the man first seemed puzzled, then curious, and as he let us in he had a face of amusement. I forget most of what happened after that, mostly due to the fact that Magus had the other man make sandwiches. By the time I had finished my second sandwich, they were done talking. Magus and the other man left us, and I began talking with my brother. An hour later, Magus and his apprentice Tiberius (Vlad had filled me in on what happened while I was eating. I was almost hurt when he said that he wasn't surprised that I was more interested in the food than the man who gave us said food.) returned, gifts in hand. While Tiberius barely managed to bring in a large roll of fabric, Magus came in arms loaded with more food. Once again, what happened next is a blur. The next thing I remember clearly was Magus and Tiberius creating new rooms for the house using their magic. No wonder it looked so normal from the outside, most of the building was under ground. With three new rooms and a hallway built, each of us had a room to call our own. This was odd for Vlad and I, as we had always shared one room (Normally with other people as well). Once we bathed and changed into the clothing Magus had made out of "Enchanted fabric", each robe dyed to a different color. Vlads green, mine red, and Bella asked for purple. Once we were all changed, we met for breakfast. It was a simple meal of waffles, syrup, milk, and eggs. While we ate, Magus asked a question: "Out of curiosity, do any of you have last names?" Vlad and I told him no. "We didn't need them as traders. The leaders always told us names got in the way of a sell." I said, before finishing the last of the eggs. He then turned to Bella, "What about you?" She also said no. "We... We got last names when we turned eighteen or took up a profession. Even so, everyone went by first names." Magus began to scratch his chin before saying "Well, most people around here have last names. Would you mind if I gave you one? You can't take Arcana, that name only brings trouble. So how about "Highborn"?" All three of us thought it over, then one by one we nodded with approval. Magus began to grin, saying "Very well, henceforth you shall be know as Vlad, Demir, and Bella Highborn." We spent the rest of the day and the next filling out our rooms. Magus provided furniture, supplies, and countless other thing to help us feel at home. Unfortunately, I had no idea what a home was suppose to look like, so my room ended up looking a little barren. I asked Magus if I could move a strange table I found in one of the storage rooms into mine. He told me I could, and offered me a hand moving it. It was a plain wooden table with a red cloth on top, a few strange symbols were faded in the cloth and in the wood. As I touched the table I felt something strange in the heart of the table: a strange power that wanted to escape the table. I told Magus about it, and he was curious as well. "That is... Odd. I bought this a few years ago, intending to work out what it does. Feel free to take a crack at it yourself. Let's move it to the main workroom instead of your room then, alright?" We soon had it at one of the half dozen work spaces that doted the large room. This particular space was close to a white structure with an empty basin on top of it.
zh_tw: 我的生活曾經很簡單。黎明起床，跟著商隊移動，留意強盜，與出現的強盜戰鬥，做任何需要做的零工，然後睡覺。大約十年來，我的日常就是這樣，一年中只有幾天會打破這個循環。與商人們一起生活很辛苦，但並不糟。當我哥哥 Vlad 決定照顧 Bella，而我面臨留在 Merry Lamp 或與哥哥一起離開的選擇時，我放棄了這種生活。其實也沒什麼選擇。他知道的細節比我多，但在他找到她後不久，我們三人就走在前往一個叫「Magus Arcana」的人家中的路上。紮營後，我問哥哥他是否知道我們要去哪裡。我很快就得知，我們能依據的資訊並不多。哥哥聽過一些傳聞，但沒有什麼確切的東西。只憑「前往法師公會的土地！」這個大致方向，我們就出發了。我們的冒險就這樣開始了，雖然有點突如其來。我的名字是 Demir Highborn，我是一名血法師。我後來贏得了「戰鬥法師」的稱號，與我哥哥的「煉金術士」、我老師的「儀式大師」、我朋友 Tiberius 的「建築師」，以及我的養妹 Bella 的「惡魔親族」相配。但我說得太快了，回到我們小小「旅程」的開頭。離開商隊大約兩天後，我們在一座小鎮停下來給我哥哥買把劍（我們只剩夠買一把的閒錢），而我則去賣幾顆寶石。在市場時，我注意到兩個穿著法師長袍的人，所以如果有人知道在哪裡找到 Magus，那就是他們了。我走向他們附近的一個攤販，兩人在聊天，都沒注意到我從他們身邊走過。我用寶石換了一筆不錯的錢，然後以比平常稍大的聲音問商人：「既然我在這裡，你有沒有聽說過一個叫『Magus Arcana』的人的任何傳聞？我有些事情要找他。」商人輕笑著告訴我，他只是用來讓孩子們安靜下來的傳說罷了。幸好，他不是我真正要問的人。從眼角餘光，我看到那兩個穿長袍的男人都瞥了我一眼，然後迅速轉回去。他們絕對當不成商人。我謝過他的時間，然後開始走出市場，沿著一條幾棵橡樹下、幾乎沒什麼人的狹窄小徑走去。我走開時，注意到那兩個穿長袍的男人都跟了上來，正如我計畫的。我慢慢地沿著狹窄的小徑走，給這兩人足夠的時間追上我。「嘿，」其中一人走近我時說。我轉身，假裝很驚訝他們攔住了我。「哎呀，你們好。沒看到你們走過來。」我這樣告訴他們，這是個簡單的小把戲，即使是能分辨你是否說謊的法師也會被騙。雖然我確實沒有「看到」他們，但我心裡完全知道他們會來。右邊那個點點頭，解讀出我說的是實話。「我們聽到你在打聽 Magus，你找他有什麼事？」左邊的那個問我。「嗯，這有點複雜。我需要找到他，這樣他或許能教導我和我哥哥。我已經懂一點魔法，但如今願意幾乎不收錢就教導的人寥寥無幾。」右邊的人又點點頭，然後說：「這話說得太對了。我哥哥 Way 和我曾是 Magus 的學徒，而他拒絕了我們試圖給他的每一枚硬幣。如果你想找到 Magus，往東北方向去，到這片土地中心一個叫 Lurric 的村莊。我們無法給你確切的方向，但我確定這比你原本有的要好。但先警告你，他往往不願意教導隨便上門敲門的人。」我謝過他們兩人，他們叫我替他們向老師問好。回到我哥哥說要碰面的水井旁，我發現 Bella 和 Vlad 都在等我。「怎麼這麼久？你通常賣東西不會花這麼久。」我哥哥問。我告訴了他我發現的事。「這次我得到的不只是錢。我得到了一個名字：Lurric。那是 Magus 應該住的地方，我們往東北走就應該能找到。」走了大約三週後，我們抵達了 Lurric。它和傳言所說的一樣平淡無奇，幾乎沒有跡象表明這附近住著一位法師。Vlad 找到了這樣的一個跡象，當時 Bella 和我去找一些消毒劑，用來處理他被一隻骷髏出其不意攻擊時受的傷。他帶著笑容與我們會合，然後指給我們看一條通往村外的圓石小徑。沿著小徑走了大約四分之一英里後，我們終於看到了偉大法師 Magus Arcana 傳說中的石屋。說它看起來不像法師會住的房子，都算輕描淡寫了。外觀很簡單，沒有任何東西顯眼到會大喊「魔法！」，所以我對他如果住在這樣的地方，究竟有多偉大，開始深感懷疑。它比一些當地領主的住宅還小，更別說大多數貴族的了。我們走向那扇簡單的木門，我們剩下的所有財產就只有身上的衣服、Vlad 的釀造台、Vlad 多年來蒐集但賣不掉的一些雜物，以及我們幾週前買的、不止一次救過我們性命的那把劍。如果是我，我不會讓我們進去，更別說收我們為徒並教授魔法了。老實說，我們看起來更像街頭流浪兒，而不是潛在的法師。我們走到門前時，Vlad 問我們兩人是否準備好了。我告訴他我準備好了，而 Bella（躲在我和 Vlad 身後）對他迅速地點了點頭。得到我們的祝福，Vlad 用力敲了門。將近一分鐘後，門開了，一個高個子男人應門。Vlad 與他交談，問 Magus 是否在這裡。又過了一分鐘，一個稍高一點的男人迎接了我們。我讓 Vlad 負責說話，看著那個男人先是顯得困惑，然後好奇，在讓我們進去時臉上帶著笑意。之後發生的大部分事情我都忘了，主要是因為 Magus 讓另一個男人做三明治。我吃完第二個三明治時，他們也談完了。Magus 和那個男人離開了我們，我則開始和我哥哥聊天。一小時後，Magus 和他的學徒 Tiberius（我吃東西的時候 Vlad 向我說明了發生的事。當他說他對我對食物比對提供食物的人更感興趣一點也不驚訝時，我差點受傷了）帶著禮物回來了。Tiberius 勉強搬進一大捲布料，Magus 則是兩手滿載更多食物進來。再一次，接下來發生的事一片模糊。接下來我清楚記得的，是 Magus 和 Tiberius 用魔法為房子創造新的房間。難怪從外面看起來那麼普通，建築的大部分都在地下。有了三間新房間和一條走廊，我們每個人都有了一間屬於自己的房間。這對 Vlad 和我來說很奇怪，因為我們一直共用一間房（通常還跟其他人一起）。我們洗完澡，換上 Magus 用「附魔布料」做的衣服，每件長袍染成不同的顏色。Vlad 的是綠色，我的是紅色，而 Bella 要了紫色。換好衣服後，我們一起吃早餐。那是簡單的一餐，有鬆餅、糖漿、牛奶和雞蛋。我們吃的時候，Magus 問了一個問題：「出於好奇，你們有人有姓氏嗎？」Vlad 和我告訴他沒有。「當商人時我們不需要。領隊們總說名字會妨礙買賣。」我說完，吃掉最後一點雞蛋。然後他轉向 Bella，「那妳呢？」她也說沒有。「我們……我們是在十八歲或從事某項職業時才得到姓氏。即使如此，大家還是用名字稱呼。」Magus 開始摩挲下巴，然後說：「嗯，這附近大多數人都有姓氏。介意我給你們取一個嗎？你們不能用 Arcana，那個名字只會帶來麻煩。那麼『Highborn』如何？」我們三人都想了想，然後一個接一個地點頭表示贊同。Magus 開始咧嘴笑，說：「很好，從此以後你們將被稱為 Vlad、Demir 和 Bella Highborn。」我們用接下來的那天和隔天的時間布置我們的房間。Magus 提供了家具、用品和無數其他東西，幫助我們有家的感覺。不幸的是，我不知道一個家該是什麼樣子，所以我的房間最後看起來有點空蕩蕩。我問 Magus 能不能把我在其中一間儲藏室發現的一張奇怪桌子搬到我房裡。他說可以，並提議幫我搬。那是一張樸素的木桌，上面鋪著紅布，布上和木頭上有一些褪色的奇怪符號。當我碰到桌子時，我感覺到桌子核心有某種奇怪的東西：一股想要從桌子中逃出的奇異力量。我把這件事告訴了 Magus，他也很好奇。「那……很奇怪。我幾年前買下了這個，打算弄清楚它的用途。儘管自己試試看。我們把它搬到主工作室吧，而不是你的房間，好嗎？」我們很快就把它放在散布在大房間裡的半打工作區之一。這個特定的區域靠近一個頂部有個空盆的白色結構。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It took me three days, but after looking into a few books I discovered gaining access to the power inside the table was going to be both easy and tricky. To get it out of the table I needed some sort of "Bridge", but I discovered there were two problems: Finding something that works as a bridge, and what happens next. I had no idea what would happen when the power was released. As far as I knew, it might be nothing or it might unleash hell on earth. I hoped it was somewhere in between. I quite literally stumbled over the answer to the first problem. At one point when I was walking out the back door to the strange structure so I could get a little air I tripped over the leg of a table, knocking off a small box that popped open to reveal a small red crystal sphere. The box had the label "Failed attempt" written on the lid, and it also had a very sharp edge that I quickly cut my thumb on. As I picked up the sphere with my cut hand, I felt a strange sensation as I touched the crystal with my bloody thumb. Then the crystal started vibrating. It was soft at first, and as I carried it down to the work room it grew stronger and stronger. It suddenly stopped when the crystal touched the table, and it seemed to flash briefly when this happened. So one half of the task was done, finding the bridge between the world and the table. My next goal was to see what happens when that power is released. With the permission and assistance of Magus, I went out a few hundred meters to conduct the test. With a simple nod from Magus, I began trying to tap into the crystal's power. At first, nothing happened. Then I felt a burst of arcane energy, that then did nothing. "How odd..." Magus said as we walked home, defeated. "I felt the magic of the crystal as well, but it was almost without any form. There might be a way to shape it, so don't give up." While Magus left to help the others, I returned to the work room. Then I noticed something odd: The table was a few inches closer to the white structure (which I later learned was a blood altar). On nothing but a hunch I used the crystal again. Once more the arcane energy went out, doing nothing. But I watched the table while this happened, and as I thought it seemed to move a little closer to the altar. With a quick push from me the table sat next to the altar, and the runes seemed to brighten a bit. I rested my hand on the table, and felt the power moving from the table into the altar as if it was seeking something. Going with my gut once more, I started searching for an item to use as a "Focus." After a few minutes I dropped a set of flint and steel in the altar, then went back outside to try again with Magus watching from just outside the door. After tapping into the crystal, I felt a wave of warm air around me. It seems a focus is not enough, so I returned to search for something to refine the table's power even more. After an hour I found a few old skulls and heads of several monsters. After placing a skeleton skull on the table, I felt the table hum with power briefly. It was nearing dark, so with the last few lights of the day I tried the crystal's power one last time. Magus watched near me as I tapped into the crystal's power, and felt myself get a little weaker as a ball of fire shot out of the crystal.
zh_tw: 我花了三天，但在翻閱幾本書後，我發現取得這張桌子內部力量既容易又棘手。要把它從桌子裡取出，我需要某種「橋樑」，但我發現有兩個問題：找到能當作橋樑的東西，以及接下來會發生什麼。我完全不知道釋放這股力量時會發生什麼。就我所知，可能什麼都不會發生，也可能引來人間地獄。我希望結果介於兩者之間。第一個問題的答案，我可以說是字面意義上絆到的。有一次我走出後門去那個奇怪的結構附近透透氣時，被一張桌腳絆倒，撞掉了一個小盒子，盒子彈開，露出一顆紅色的小水晶球。盒蓋上寫著「失敗的嘗試」，而且它有一個非常鋒利的邊緣，我的拇指很快就被割傷了。當我用受傷的手拿起那顆球時，我用沾血的拇指碰到水晶，感覺到一種奇怪的感覺。接著水晶開始振動。起初很輕微，當我把它帶到工作室時，變得越來越強烈。當水晶碰到桌子時，它突然停了下來，發生這情況時似乎還短暫閃了一下。所以任務的一半完成了，找到了世界與桌子之間的橋樑。我的下一個目標是看看釋放那股力量時會發生什麼。在 Magus 的允許和協助下，我走到幾百公尺外進行測試。Magus 一點頭，我就開始嘗試汲取水晶的力量。起初什麼都沒發生。接著我感覺到一陣奧術能量爆發，然後就沒有然後了。「真奇怪……」我們垂頭喪氣地走回家時，Magus 說。「我也感覺到了水晶的魔法，但它幾乎沒有任何形態。也許有辦法塑造它，所以別放棄。」Magus 離開去幫助其他人時，我回到了工作室。然後我注意到一件怪事：桌子比之前離那個白色結構（我後來才知道那是血祭壇）近了幾英寸。僅憑直覺，我再次使用了水晶。又一次，奧術能量釋放出去，什麼也沒做。但我在這期間一直看著桌子，正如我所想，它似乎往祭壇靠近了一點。我稍微推了一把，桌子就停在祭壇旁邊，符文似乎亮了一點。我把手放在桌子上，感覺到力量從桌子流入祭壇，彷彿在尋找什麼。再次相信自己的直覺，我開始尋找可以當作「焦點」的物品。幾分鐘後，我把一套打火石與鋼片放進祭壇，然後走回外面再試一次，Magus 就站在門外看著。汲取水晶的力量後，我感到周圍有一陣暖風。看來一個焦點還不夠，於是我回去尋找能進一步精煉桌子力量的東西。一小時後，我找到了幾個舊頭骨和幾種怪物的頭顱。把一顆骷髏頭骨放在桌子上後，我感覺到桌子短暫地嗡嗡作響，充滿力量。天快黑了，所以我趁著當天最後一點光線，最後一次嘗試水晶的力量。Magus 在我附近看著，我汲取水晶的力量，感覺到自己變得有點虛弱，同時一顆火球從水晶中射出。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: After showing Magus and the others my setup, both Magus and Tiberius seemed surprised to see that it needed the altar. After I showed them the crystal I had found, Magus and Tiberius asked me to hold off on experimenting with this further for a few days. Two days later I found out why. I don't feel like putting down all the details, so a quick summary: Each of us had unknowingly discovered new branches of "Blood Magic." Blood magic was a new form of magic that he and Tiberius had been trying to create and perfect for quite some time. Everything we had done so far had connected into blood magic in ways both of them had never expected. If we wanted to continue with the work we had been doing, my spells, my brots' alchemy, and Bella's demon taming we would need to become blood mages like them. They went over the risks involved, told us that death was a real possibility, and that if we didn't want to go into blood magic we didn't have to. We quickly gave them our answer: We've already started on the path, so we can't really turn back now. We then went through the first test of any blood mage: The creation of a Weak Blood Orb. All of our palms were tender at the end of the day, but we were now blood mages.
zh_tw: 向 Magus 和其他人展示我的裝置後，Magus 和 Tiberius 看到它需要祭壇似乎都很驚訝。在我給他們看了我找到的水晶之後，Magus 和 Tiberius 要我暫緩幾天，先不要再繼續實驗下去。兩天後，我知道了原因。我不想寫下所有細節，所以簡短總結：我們每個人都在不知不覺中發現了「血魔法」的新分支。血魔法是他和 Tiberius 試圖創造並完善了相當一段時間的新形式魔法。我們到目前為止所做的一切，都以他們兩人從未料想到的方式與血魔法連結起來。如果我們想繼續我們一直在做的工作，也就是我的法術、我哥哥的煉金術，以及 Bella 的惡魔馴服，我們就需要像他們一樣成為血法師。他們說明了其中涉及的風險，告訴我們死亡是真實的可能性，並且說如果我們不想進入血魔法，也不必勉強。我們很快給了他們答案：我們已經踏上了這條路，所以現在真的回不了頭了。接著我們通過了任何血法師的第一道試煉：製作虛弱血球。一天結束時，我們所有人的手掌都隱隱作痛，但我們現在是血法師了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I discovered that the spells the table created used LP, and for the next month I searched for items to act as foci. Here is the list that I have discovered so far, but I don't want to write all the details, so anyone reading this will need to experiment on their own. As Magus says "Life is nothing without a few mysteries."
zh_tw: 我發現桌子所製造的法術會消耗 LP，接下來的一個月，我四處尋找可作為焦點的物品。以下是我目前發現的清單，但我不想寫下所有細節，所以任何讀到這裡的人都需要自己去實驗。正如 Magus 所說：「沒有一點謎團，生命就什麼都不是。」
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Flint and Steel acts as, surprise surprise, foci for fire. As a result, most of the spells it creates will leave you or something else with a few nasty burns.
zh_tw: 打火石與鋼片作為火焰的焦點，這一點並不令人意外。因此，它所製造的大多數法術都會讓你或其他東西遭受嚴重的灼傷。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Bucket of Water has to do with the control of water, strangely. Expect drowning and water, not necessarily in that order.
zh_tw: 水桶說來奇怪，與控制水有關。預期會有溺水和水，不一定是按這個順序。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Apprentice Blood Orb create some strange combat effects that have little rhyme or reason from my experience.
zh_tw: Apprentice Blood Orb create some strange combat effects that have little rhyme or reason from my experience.
notes: TRUNCATED

english_value: Something else that is interesting about the table is that it does not need to be re-bound to the crystal. If you change the foci or the paradigm the spell will change as well the next time you use the crystal. I also found four "Paradigms" to use with the spells. Skeleton heads imprinted a ranged attack to the energy of the spell, the wither skeleton skull made the spell more suited for close combat, the zombie turned the spell defensive, and the creeper head gave the spell more environmental impact. I should also note that Magus shared with me crafting recipes for turning wither skeleton skulls into heads of the other mobs. Seems a bit pricy, but when you have no other choice...
zh_tw: 關於這張桌子，還有一件有趣的事，就是它不需要重新綁定到水晶上。如果你改變了焦點或範式，下次使用水晶時，法術也會隨之改變。我還發現了四種可用於法術的「範式」。骷髏頭使法術的能量帶有遠程攻擊的特性，凋零骷髏頭顱使法術更適合近戰，殭屍使法術偏向防禦，而苦力怕頭顱則賦予法術更大的環境影響力。我還應該提到，Magus 與我分享了將凋零骷髏頭顱轉換成其他怪物頭顱的合成配方。似乎有點貴，但當你別無選擇時……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I asked Tiberius how he made the spell crystal, and he told me that while trying to create a new blood orb he stumbled across it. All it needed was a piece of glass in a blood altar, using 1k LP to transform the glass into the crystal.
zh_tw: 我問 Tiberius 他是怎麼製作法術水晶的，他告訴我，那是他在嘗試製作新血球時偶然發現的。它只需要在血祭壇中放入一塊玻璃，使用 1k LP 把玻璃轉化為水晶。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: We managed to recreate the powers and effects of the "Spell Table" using blood magic. Amazing what you can do with items laying around Magus's home...
zh_tw: 我們成功用血魔法重現了「法術桌」的力量與效果。真是令人驚訝，Magus 家裡隨便放著的東西居然能做到這些……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: This brings us up to today, when Tiberius brought us books so we could write all our work down, if we wished. It has taken a few hours, but here we are. Currently I am working with my brother to create a much more advanced form of the spell system, and will add any information I learn to this book when I have time. Has it really been three years since we came to this place? My life before coming to Magus seems like a distant memory now, and my days have become filled with training and work that I have fallen in love with. Since I last wrote here so much has happened... My sister Bella has come out of her shell, freely walking amongst the villagers in the market without cowering behind us. She has become more outgoing, helping Magus deal with demon attacks and cutting the number of deaths every year substantially. She has formed pacts with over a dozen demons, while working with Magus and my brother to create a way to "Pull" demons into our world, body and soul. My brother Vlad has been busy with his alchemy, creating new potions that have powerful effects but more often then not taste like tree bark mixed with dirt. Alongside that he has been helping me create the components I need for my spell constructs. I needed materials that conduct large amounts of magical and elemental energy, and he has been the only reason I've gotten so far. And no, I'm not writing that just because he is sitting next to me, though it would be a lie to say that hasn't been a factor.
zh_tw: 這就把我們帶到了今天，Tiberius 給我們帶來了書，這樣我們若願意，就可以把我們所有的工作寫下來。這花了幾個小時，但我們到了這裡。目前我正與我哥哥合作，創造一種更先進得多的法術系統，等我有時間時，我會把學到的任何資訊加進這本書。我們來到這個地方真的已經三年了嗎？我在來到 Magus 這裡之前的生活，現在彷彿是遙遠的記憶，而我的日子已充滿了我熱愛的訓練與工作。自從我上次在這裡寫字以來，發生了太多事……我的妹妹 Bella 已經走出了她的殼，能在市場上自由地走在村民之間，而不再躲在我們身後瑟瑟發抖。她變得更外向，協助 Magus 對付惡魔襲擊，每年大幅減少了死亡人數。她已與十幾隻惡魔訂立契約，同時與 Magus 和我哥哥合作，創造一種將惡魔連同身體與靈魂「拉」進我們世界的方法。我哥哥 Vlad 一直忙於他的煉金術，創造出效果強大、但往往嚐起來像樹皮混泥土的新藥水。除此之外，他還一直在幫我製作我的法術構造所需的組件。我需要能傳導大量魔法與元素能量的材料，而他是我能走到這一步的唯一原因。不，我寫這句話並不是因為他正坐在我旁邊，不過說這不是一個因素就是在說謊了。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Anyway, back to what we're here to write about. We have discovered a way to use the items known as "Blood Shards" and my brots alchemical reagents to create a new way to form spells using blood magic. It uses four components: Paradigms, Effects, Modifiers, and Enhancements. The main improvement of this system over the old one is the ability to "Chain" spell effects together. Before I cover how to create the spells, I should go over the parts.
zh_tw: 言歸正傳，回到我們在此要記錄的主題。我們發現了一種方法，可以利用被稱為「血之碎片」的物品，以及我哥哥的煉金試劑，來創造一種使用血魔法形成法術的新方式。它使用四種組件：範式、效果、修飾符與增幅。這個系統相較舊系統的主要改進，是能夠將法術效果「串連」在一起。在說明如何創造法術之前，我應該先介紹各個部分。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The paradigms act as the starting point for the spells, and define what the spell will target. There is only one "Output" side to these blocks, and it is on the side with five points(It will be hard to miss it), and the output side can be rotated with a simple right-click. We have currently created four different paradigm versions: Projectile, melee, self, and tool. While the names feel self explanatory, I'd best talk about them anyway.
zh_tw: 範式是法術的起點，並定義法術的目標。這些方塊只有一個「輸出」面，位於有五個點的那一面（很難不注意到），輸出面可以透過簡單的右鍵旋轉。我們目前已創造出四種不同的範式版本：拋射物、近戰、自身與工具。雖然名稱感覺不言自明，但我最好還是談談它們。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Tool: Creates an alchemical manifestation of the spell from the crystal in the shape of a mace. Depending on what is in the spell, it can change what this mace does, from being a weapon or a digging tool or "Crushing" any block it breaks.
zh_tw: 工具：從水晶創造出法術的煉金具現，形狀為一把釘頭錘。依據法術中的內容，它可以改變這把錘子的作用，從武器、挖掘工具，到「粉碎」它所破壞的任何方塊。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Next we have the effect blocks, and these are what give the paradigms some kick. Unlike the paradigms, theses have both an input and an output. An effect blocks input is always the five pointed non-colored side, while the output is the side with the colored ends(The color depends on the effect block). We currently have the effect blocks for fire, earth, wind, and ice. The effects of these blocks are heavily influenced by the modifiers that come after it, but spells can function with only a paradigm and one effect.
zh_tw: 接下來是效果方塊，它們為範式提供了威力。與範式不同，它們同時有輸入與輸出。效果方塊的輸入永遠是五個點、沒有顏色的那一面，而輸出則是帶有彩色端點的那一面（顏色取決於效果方塊）。我們目前有火、土、風與冰的效果方塊。這些方塊的效果受到其後修飾符的強烈影響，但法術只需要一個範式和一個效果就能運作。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Modifiers change what the last effect in the chain before them does. So, if you had a fire, ice, wind chain then placed an offensive modifier, the wind would take an offensive effect while the others remain default. The current modifiers are: Default, Offensive, Defensive, and Environmental.
zh_tw: 修飾符會改變鏈中位於其前的最後一個效果的作用。所以，如果你有一條火、冰、風的鏈，然後放置一個攻擊性修飾符，風就會採用攻擊性的效果，而其他的保持預設。目前的修飾符有：預設、攻擊性、防禦性與環境。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Default makes the effect act as if you left it without a modifier. Useful for spells where you want to guaranty its effect.
zh_tw: 預設讓效果的表現如同你沒有加上修飾符一樣。適用於你想要確保其效果的法術。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Defensive has shown to change effect to protect the user. This comes in several forms, from creating shields and cloaking the user to slowing an opponent.
zh_tw: 防禦性已顯示會改變效果以保護使用者。這有幾種形式，從製造護盾和隱蔽使用者，到減緩對手的速度。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Environmental does what the name says: It makes spell effects have bigger impact on the world, from setting fires at the targets feet to carving out large chunks of land.
zh_tw: 環境就如其名：它讓法術效果對世界產生更大的影響，從在目標腳下縱火，到挖掘大片土地。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Finally we have enhancements. Enhancements improve the spell without major changes to the effect. The enhancements are: Power, Cost, and Potency. Like most other spell blocks, plain is in and colored is out. What should also be covered are the frames that hold enhancements. There are three types of frames, each stronger then the last. Your cheap and basic unstable frame can only withstand one per type(You may have one power, one cost, and one potency. If you try to add two unstable power enhancements one will not be able to improve the spell, and actually might blow up damaging the blocks around it). While you may only have one unstable per type, you may have two standard and three reinforced for a grand total of three enhancements of any type(If you want to save on the resources needed for these enhancements, try having one of each in the chain, placed in the order of weakest to strongest. While an unstable can only handle its own power, a standard can handle its own and that of a unstable, with a reinforced able to channel all three without failing). As I write this down I realize it is a little confusing, but with a little practice it becomes simple.
zh_tw: 最後是增幅。增幅在不大幅改變效果的情況下改善法術。增幅有：威力、成本與效能。與大多數其他法術方塊一樣，無色的是輸入，有色的是輸出。還需要說明的是承載增幅的框架。框架有三種，每一種都比前一種更強。你那便宜的基礎不穩定框架每種類型只能承受一個（你可以有一個威力、一個成本和一個效能。如果你嘗試加入兩個不穩定的威力增幅，其中一個將無法改善法術，而且實際上可能會爆炸，損壞周圍的方塊）。雖然每種類型只能有一個不穩定框架，但你可以有兩個標準框架和三個強化框架，合計共三個任意類型的增幅（如果你想節省這些增幅所需的資源，可以試著在鏈中各放一個，並依從最弱到最強的順序放置。不穩定框架只能承受自己的威力，標準框架可以承受自己的和不穩定框架的威力，而強化框架則可以在不失敗的情況下導引全部三者）。寫下來之後我發現這有點令人困惑，但稍加練習就會變得簡單。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Power boosts the, well, power of the spell. If you had a spell that did damage and gave the target a potion effect, the spell would do more damage or make the potion effect stronger.
zh_tw: 威力提升法術的，嗯，威力。如果你有一個造成傷害並給目標藥水效果的法術，該法術會造成更多傷害，或使藥水效果更強。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Cost lowers the cost of the spell effect. Doesn't get much simpler then this, yet will always be useful as the cost of these spells can get quite hefty after you chain a few effects.
zh_tw: 成本降低法術效果的成本。沒有比這更簡單的了，但永遠都很有用，因為在你串連幾個效果之後，這些法術的成本可能變得相當驚人。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Potency increases the potency of the spell. What this means differs from spell to spell, but with our damage/potion effect example it might make the effect last longer or be stronger.
zh_tw: 效能提升法術的效能。這代表什麼因法術而異，但以我們的傷害／藥水效果的例子來說，它可能讓效果持續更久或更強。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: This covers all the parts of a spell, but there is still one block remaining: the conduit. It doesn't add anything to the spell, but it allows you to place the parts of the spell farther apart. The input and output are dictated by the dots on the respective side. Four small dots indicate the input; one large dot is the output. Now then, how do you create a spell? First, pick your paradigm. Then, create a complex spell crystal to bind to the paradigm (crafting recipes will be on the following pages for convenience) and make sure the crystal is also bound to an owner. Next, place and connect an effect block to the paradigm (change outputs with right-click, inputs with sneak-right-click. Note that one side can't be both the input and the output). Now the spell will work, but it might not do what you want. You can alter the spell's effect by placing and connecting a modifier. This still doesn't mean the spell will work as expected, but you can at least nudge it in the right direction. Finally, you can add enhancements to boost the spell, but they might make the effect cost more (unless you add cost enhancements). There are three tiers of enhancements, and a spell effect can only handle so much... You know what, I went over this in the modifiers section-look there for more information. But you don't need to stop at one effect; you can chain to another effect, and another, and another... The possibilities are as endless as your soul network will allow. A few final notes: Every spell will do something. Some need other effects to really flourish, while others work best on their own. The cost of the spell will always be the sum of all the effects and their enhancements, multiplied by the complexity factor. So you can create massive spells with several effects at once, but watch your soul network as you use it. Just a warning.
zh_tw: 以上涵蓋了法術的所有部分，但還剩下一個方塊：導管。它不會為法術增加任何東西，但它讓你能把法術的各個部分放置得更遠。輸入與輸出由各自一側的點決定。四個小點表示輸入；一個大點是輸出。那麼，如何創造法術呢？首先，選擇你的範式。然後，製作一個複雜法術水晶綁定到範式上（為了方便，合成配方會在後續頁面中）並確保水晶也綁定給了擁有者。接著，放置並連接一個效果方塊到範式上（用右鍵更改輸出，用潛行右鍵更改輸入。注意同一面不能同時是輸入與輸出）。這樣法術就能運作了，但它可能不會做你想要的事。你可以透過放置並連接一個修飾符來改變法術的效果。這仍然不代表法術會如預期般運作，但你至少可以把它往正確的方向推一推。最後，你可以加入增幅來強化法術，但它們可能會使效果花費更多（除非你加入成本增幅）。增幅有三個等級，而一個法術效果只能承受那麼多……你知道嗎，我在修飾符的部分已經講過了——請在那裡查看更多資訊。但你不必停在一個效果；你可以串連到另一個效果，再一個，再一個……可能性與你的靈魂網路所允許的一樣無窮無盡。最後幾點注意事項：每個法術都會做點什麼。有些需要其他效果才能真正發揮，有些則單獨使用效果最好。法術的成本永遠是所有效果及其增幅的總和，再乘以複雜度係數。所以你可以創造同時含有多種效果的龐大法術，但使用時要留意你的靈魂網路。僅此警告。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: And now Vlad is requesting that I mention the effects of the spells... This might take a few pages, but I guess it is worth doing.
zh_tw: 現在 Vlad 要求我提到法術的效果……這可能需要好幾頁，但我想這是值得的。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Self paradigm effects are always interesting... A default fire effect causes the user to burst into flames, while an offensive effect cloaks you in fire to ignite attackers and nearby entities. Defensive forms a puddle of magma at your feet (useful if you can't be hurt by fire, but the thing trying to kill you can). Finally, for fire, environmental causes you to superheat an area, causing fires and things to change (sand to glass, cobble to stone).
zh_tw: 自身範式的效果總是很有趣……預設的火焰效果會讓使用者燃燒起來，而攻擊性效果會讓你披上火焰，點燃攻擊者和附近的實體。防禦性會在你腳邊形成一灘岩漿（如果你不會被火傷害、但試圖殺死你的東西會的話，很有用）。最後，對於火，環境效果會讓你將一個區域加熱到極高溫，引發火災並讓東西改變（沙子變玻璃、圓石變石頭）。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Earth is a bit less... wild in its effects for self. Default raises the ground below you up to your feet, forming a platform to stand on, and I have found it helpful for when you suddenly don't know where the ground has gone (happened once when testing a wind spell). Offensive creates an impact at your feet that crushes blocks (Cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand). Defensive is a powerful combat option with a catch: you become much heartier and you're able to take far more damage than normal at the cost of movement. Environmental creates a quick shockwave that weakens nearby entities.
zh_tw: 土對於自身的效果比較沒那麼……狂野。預設會把你腳下的地面抬升到你的腳邊，形成一個可以站立的平台，我發現它在你突然不知道地面跑哪去的時候很有幫助（測試風之法術時發生過一次）。攻擊性會在你腳邊產生一次衝擊，粉碎方塊（圓石變礫石、礫石變沙子）。防禦性是一種強大的戰鬥選項，但有個代價：你會變得更加強健，能承受遠超平常的傷害，代價是行動能力。環境會產生一道快速的衝擊波，削弱附近的實體。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Ice has been a fun one to use. Default creates a small pillar under you that pushes you up, allowing for quick vertical movement. Offensive causes entities around you to become lethargic, moving slower. Defensive is a bit more interesting, allowing you to slow entities and freeze water using a cloak of ice (you can easily use this to walk on water). When water isn't available, you can create a bridge of ice using environmental ice.
zh_tw: 冰用起來很有趣。預設會在你腳下形成一根小柱子將你推高，讓你能快速垂直移動。攻擊性會使你周圍的實體變得遲緩，移動變慢。防禦性比較有趣，讓你能用一件冰之斗篷減緩實體速度並凍結水（你可以輕易地用它在水上行走）。沒有水的時候，你可以用環境冰創造一座冰橋。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Wind has turned out to be quite practical in its uses, from my tests. Default has the useful effect of creating a brief burst of wind that puts out fires on the user and protects the user from sudden downward momentum that can cause quick yet extremely messy death. Offensive mimics the effects of an air sigil, launching you forward. Defensive causes nearby entities to have a strong downward wind, limiting movement. Finally, environmental causes a large high-pressure area to form around the user, which then moves toward low-pressure areas (everywhere else). This has the side effect of taking entities with it in the sudden gust of air.
zh_tw: 從我的測試來看，風的用途相當實用。預設有個實用的效果，就是製造一陣短暫的風，撲滅使用者身上的火，並保護使用者免於突如其來的下墜動量，那種動量可能造成迅速但極其悲慘的死亡。攻擊性模仿空氣印記的效果，把你向前發射。防禦性會對附近實體造成強烈的向下風力，限制其移動。最後，環境會在使用者周圍形成一大片高壓區域，隨後向低壓區域（其他所有地方）移動。這有個副作用，就是會在突然的氣流中帶走實體。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: On to melee effects, for those who like close-range combat. Starting off with fire again, this effect as default causes spontaneous combustion for nearby entities. The always entertaining offensive effect causes the target to gain an effect called "Fire fuse." This effect does nothing until it expires, at which point the entity explodes. The explosion not only damages the entity but also launches it into the air while damaging nearby entities. Defensive allows you to wall off areas with fire, stopping things from passing unless they brave the flames. Environmental causes it to form a short-range projectile that evaporates any water nearby.
zh_tw: 接著是近戰效果，給喜歡近距離戰鬥的人。同樣從火開始，這個效果的預設會使附近的實體自燃。永遠有趣的攻擊性效果會使目標獲得名為「火引信」的效果。這個效果在到期之前什麼也不做，到期時實體會爆炸。爆炸不僅傷害該實體，還會將其拋向空中並傷害附近的實體。防禦性讓你能用火焰封鎖區域，阻止東西通過，除非它們勇敢地闖過火焰。環境會使其形成一個短程拋射物，蒸發附近的任何水。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Earth melee has a few of the old effects in a new form. Default destabilizes blocks, causing them to fall akin to sand. Offensive has the same smashing effect from earlier in projectile form. Defensive forms a wall by raising a chunk of the ground up. Environmental, on the other hand, is able to remove the stone from an ore, leaving a fair amount of dust to process into ingots.
zh_tw: 土近戰有一些舊效果的新形式。預設使方塊失穩，讓它們像沙子一樣掉落。攻擊性有著與先前拋射物形式相同的粉碎效果。防禦性透過抬升一塊地面形成一堵牆。另一方面，環境則能從礦石上移除石頭，留下相當數量的粉末，可以加工成錠。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Ice allows some useful combat options, starting with a default effect that allows the target to lose the tolerance to pain that happens after a blow, effectively allowing you to apply more damage in less time. Offensive rockets the target into the air akin to the self ice effect from earlier. Defensive forms a wall of ice to protect you from damage. While environmental... well, it is odd. It unleashes an omnidirectional volley of snowballs at the target.
zh_tw: 冰提供了一些有用的戰鬥選項，從預設效果開始，它讓目標失去受到打擊後產生的痛覺耐受，實際上讓你能在更短時間內造成更多傷害。攻擊性像先前自身冰效果那樣，把目標火箭般射向空中。防禦性形成一堵冰牆來保護你免受傷害。至於環境……嗯，很奇怪。它會對目標射出全方位的一輪雪球。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Wind is very combat flow-oriented, with default pulling entities towards the user, offensive pushing them away, and defensive affecting entities in the air. Environmental is more utility-oriented, as it pulls items on the ground toward the user.
zh_tw: 風非常注重戰鬥流程，預設把實體拉向使用者，攻擊性把它們推開，防禦性影響空中的實體。環境更偏向實用，因為它會把地上的物品拉向使用者。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Projectile spells share many of the effects of other types with a few all their own. Default fire allows the attack to unleash a torrent of fire when it hits something. Offensive creates flowing lava in the air under the target, but is tricky to use without the aid of other spell effects. Defensive smelts blocks, while environmental evaporates water.
zh_tw: 拋射物法術與其他類型共享許多效果，另有一些專屬的。預設的火讓攻擊在擊中物體時釋放一股火焰洪流。攻擊性會在目標下方的空中製造流動的熔岩，但如果沒有其他法術效果的輔助，很難使用。防禦性冶煉方塊，而環境則蒸發水。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Earth projectiles are mainly focused on mining, with default disintegrating all matter it comes in contact with. Offensive forms a hole under an entity it hits (normally only in mundane blocks like dirt and Cobblestone). Defensive smashes blocks in the same manner stated before, while environmental mines blocks in an area around the projectile.
zh_tw: 土拋射物主要專注於挖掘，預設會使其接觸到的所有物質分解。攻擊性在被擊中的實體下方形成一個洞（通常只限於泥土和圓石等一般方塊）。防禦性以前面所述的相同方式粉碎方塊，而環境則挖掘拋射物周圍區域的方塊。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Ice has a lot of classic effects, with default being an ice plume on impact, offensive slowing targets, defensive freezing water and making snow, and environmental just freezing water in an area around the projectile.
zh_tw: 冰有許多經典效果，預設是撞擊時的冰柱，攻擊性減緩目標速度，防禦性凍結水並製造雪，而環境則只是凍結拋射物周圍區域的水。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Wind has a few interesting effects, with default sending mobs flying, offensive giving "Heavy Heart" to ground entities, defensive letting blocks mined by the spell drop as if mined by a silk touch pickaxe, and environmental pulling items to the user.
zh_tw: 風有一些有趣的效果，預設把生物吹飛，攻擊性給予地面實體「沉重之心」，防禦性讓被法術挖掘的方塊像是用絲綢之觸鎬挖掘一樣掉落，而環境則把物品拉向使用者。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Tool spells seem to be a mix of utility and combat, with many of the effects allowing it to function as a set tool type. Starting with earth, default acts as a pickaxe, offensive as a way to remove mundane blocks, defensive as a shovel, and environmental gives it the power to mine multiple blocks. I know I sound like I'm rushing through these, but they mostly do what they say on the tin.
zh_tw: 工具法術似乎是實用與戰鬥的混合，許多效果使其能作為特定類型的工具運作。從土開始，預設的作用像鎬，攻擊性用來移除一般方塊，防禦性像鏟子，而環境賦予它挖掘多個方塊的能力。我知道我聽起來好像在趕著講完這些，但它們大多就如標籤所說的那樣。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Fire has a few powerful effects, with default smelting anything mined (cobble to smooth stone, sand to glass...), offensive acting like the Fire Aspect enchantment, defensive increasing the time the spell stays in tool form, and environmental letting it turn stone into lava.
zh_tw: 火有幾個強力的效果，預設會冶煉任何被挖掘的東西（圓石變平滑石頭、沙子變玻璃……），攻擊性的作用像火焰附加附魔，防禦性延長法術維持在工具形態的時間，而環境則讓它能把石頭變成熔岩。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Ice is more combat-centered, with default letting blows it deals slow entities, offensive giving it a few sharp points for more damage, defensive unleashing a torrent of cold air when the tool is summoned that creates snow and slows mobs. The environmental effect is a black sheep, allowing the tool to function as if it has silk touch.
zh_tw: 冰比較以戰鬥為中心，預設讓它造成的打擊減緩實體的速度，攻擊性賦予它一些尖刺以造成更多傷害，防禦性在工具被召喚時釋放一股冷空氣洪流，製造雪並減緩生物速度。環境效果是個異類，讓工具的作用像是擁有絲綢之觸。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Wind has effects that are just... useful. Default allows it to function as an axe, offensive gives it extra punch to throw mobs back after being hit, defensive weighs them down, and finally environmental pulls items closer to the user.
zh_tw: 風的效果就只是……有用。預設讓它能作為斧頭使用，攻擊性賦予它額外的力道，在擊中後把生物擊退，防禦性使它們變得沉重，最後環境會把物品拉近使用者。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Tiberius has informed me that this book will update as I add to it, so if we ever create more blocks for the advanced spells, you'll know when I do. For now, this is the end. And yet it might be your beginning. I'll go off-topic for a bit, because today something happened that I never thought possible: I killed a Wither (you know, the big black flying skeletal death monster that wants to kill everything?). Not only did I kill one, but I also helped kill twenty more. Magus said the most killed at once before this was ten by three people, so we crushed the record. We needed a few Nether Stars to upgrade our altar, but Nether Stars are near impossible to get, unless you work on the conglomeration board like Magus does. (He runs the largest country in the world, apparently. I know, I can hardly believe it either.) After inviting every world leader for a holiday weekend (which they actually treated like a holiday trip), Magus managed to get us a reservation in a battle arena to kill thirty Withers. To say I was shocked is an understatement. By some miracle, we managed to not only kill all of the Withers (and all of us lived to tell about it). Sadly, I'm stuck in bed with a busted leg (a Wither Skull nailed me when I was casting a spell), so I've taken this as an opportunity to try new kinds of food (Magus cooks like any five-star chef). I'd keep writing, but I smell roasted chicken coming down the stairs now... Vlad has finally found a more stable recipe for the advanced spell parts for the augments. While he has been able to create them before, the new orbs we have allow them not to fall apart four out of five times. A slight improvement, I'm sure you may agree. With this, the reinforced spell augments are much more reliable. Well, the last few days have been interesting. We have managed to open a hole in the fabric of space to let in an invading army of demons, but it was to stop another portal letting in other demons, so it is all fine. Sorry, but I had to comment on how ridiculous that sounded when I first heard Magus's plan. But it isn't as bad as it sounds, since with the second portal we had control over where the demons come out and can prevent them from running wild. Absurd sounding, I know, but when you deal with holes in space leading to demonic realms, things are rarely simple. Or when a mage has any involvement, for that matter.
zh_tw: Tiberius 告訴我，這本書會隨著我的補充而更新，所以如果我們日後為進階法術創造了更多方塊，你會在我寫下時知道。目前，這就是結尾。然而，這或許是你的開始。我要稍微離題一下，因為今天發生了一件我從未想過可能的事：我殺死了一隻凋零怪（你知道的，那種想殺死一切的、巨大黑色飛行骷髏死亡怪物？）。我不僅殺了一隻，還協助殺死了另外二十隻。Magus 說，此前一次同時殺死的最高紀錄是三個人殺十隻，所以我們徹底打破了紀錄。我們需要幾顆下界之星來升級我們的祭壇，但下界之星幾乎不可能取得，除非你像 Magus 那樣在 Conglomeration 董事會工作。（顯然他管理著世界上最大的國家。我知道，我自己也很難相信。）在邀請了世界上每位領袖來度過一個假期週末（他們真的把它當成假期旅行）之後，Magus 成功為我們在一座戰鬥競技場訂到了名額，去殺三十隻凋零怪。說我很震驚都算輕描淡寫了。靠著某種奇蹟，我們不僅殺死了所有的凋零怪（而且我們全都活著講述這件事）。可惜我現在因為腿斷了而臥床（我施放法術時被一顆凋零頭骨擊中），所以我把這當作嘗試新種類食物的機會（Magus 煮得像任何五星級主廚）。我還想繼續寫，但我現在聞到烤雞的味道從樓梯下來了……Vlad 終於找到了一個更穩定的進階法術零件配方，用於增幅。雖然他以前就能製作它們，但我們現在擁有的新血球使它們不會五次中有四次崩解。我相信你會同意，這是一個小小的進步。有了這個，強化法術增幅可靠得多。嗯，過去幾天很有趣。我們成功在空間結構上開啟了一個洞，讓一支入侵的惡魔大軍進來，但那是為了阻止另一扇傳送門放進其他惡魔，所以一切都沒問題。抱歉，但我必須評論一下，我第一次聽到 Magus 的計畫時，覺得它聽起來有多荒謬。但它並不像聽起來那麼糟，因為有了第二扇傳送門，我們能控制惡魔出現的地點，並能防止它們失控肆虐。我知道聽起來荒謬，但當你處理通往惡魔領域的空間洞時，事情很少是簡單的。或者說，只要有法師牽涉其中，就是如此。

english_value: Gah, look at me! I opened this musty old book to mention the new augments Vlad and Tiberius had created using the spoils of this "war", and ended up ranting about how strange and wonderful life as a mage can be. Right, Vlad managed to make a few parts better using the life and soul shards we've been collecting. Not much else to it, really. Sure, Vlad might say he had to create new laws of alchemy to explain this process, but he does that on a daily basis anyway.
