english_value: I have found something... well, unexpected to say the least. The self-proclaimed hedge mage Athis stopped by our still-in-construction homestead in Venric's Folly to visit Tiberius. Apparently, in one of the letters he wrote her, he mentioned being unable to relax after working on watching the demons running around and building various things he and Magus decided we needed here (isn't this meant to be a temporary base of operations?). She came by with a small pouch of wood ash incense and a little brazier to help him with this, but what this provided was far more valuable than simple scented air. I joined Tiberius and Athis for the first use of the incense, and to her credit, I started feeling relaxed breathing in the sweet scents it let off. Partway through, I got up to visit the blood altar, being my turn in the roster to top out the communal soul network. After performing a sacrifice like normal, something odd happened: there was more LP in the altar than there should be, by a fair margin. Several sacrifices later, I couldn't get it to happen again, so I went in to mention it to Tiberius. (While it might have been a simple miscalculation, we must always look deeper into it. This philosophy was passed down to us by Magus and has saved us time, led us to great discoveries like this, and at times has resulted in a lot of cheese). He performed his own sacrifice in the altar, and again there was more LP than there should be. Long story short, involving investigations into the local flora, positions of stars, and phases of the moon, we discovered it was the incense of all things causing the discrepancy. As it turns out, being under the effects of this simple wood ash resulted in a greater exchange of raw life essence for a given amount of blood, akin to how self-sacrifice runes work. After some experimentation, we have a basic calculation for the process and method for the most profit. You must sit in range of the improved brazier I designed after giving it wood ash until white particles are emitted (you can do the sacrifice before this, but you won't get the full effect). You then must sacrifice almost all of your blood in one quick burst (achieved by holding right-click for several seconds, then releasing). LP will then be added to the altar based on the number of hearts sacrificed, plus the bonus of the self-sacrifice runes in the altar. This total is then multiplied by the effect of the highest quality incense you are under. Example: if you sacrifice nine hearts into an altar without any self-sacrifice runes while under the full effect of wood ash, you would add 2160 LP to the altar instead of the normal 1800. This process isn't without issues, however, as this rapid expenditure of blood weakens you for a time, with an effect not unlike soul fray.
zh_tw: 我發現了一件……嗯，至少可以說是出乎意料的事。自稱草籬法師的 Athis 路過我們仍在興建中、位於 Venric's Folly 的家園，來拜訪 Tiberius。顯然，他在寫給她的一封信中提到，在忙著監視惡魔四處跑動、並建造他和 Magus 決定我們在這裡需要的各種東西之後，他無法放鬆下來（這裡不是應該只是個暫時的行動基地嗎？）。她帶著一小袋木灰薰香和一個小火盆過來幫助他，但這帶來的遠比單純的香氣有價值得多。我加入 Tiberius 和 Athis，一起首次使用這種薰香，公平地說，吸入它散發的甜香讓我開始感到放鬆。進行到一半時，我起身去血祭壇，因為輪到我按輪值表把共用的靈魂網路補滿。像平常一樣進行獻祭後，發生了奇怪的事：祭壇裡的 LP 比應有的多，而且多出不少。又獻祭了幾次之後，我無法讓它再次發生，於是進去向 Tiberius 提了這件事。（雖然這可能只是單純的計算失誤，但我們總是必須更深入地探究。這個理念是 Magus 傳給我們的，它為我們節省了時間，帶我們發現了像這樣的重大發現，有時也帶來了大量的起司。）他在祭壇裡進行了自己的獻祭，再次發現 LP 比應有的多。長話短說，經過對當地植物群、星辰位置和月相的調查，我們發現造成差異的竟然是薰香。結果發現，處於這種簡單木灰的影響之下，會使一定量的血液換得更多原始生命精華，類似於自我犧牲符文的運作方式。經過一些實驗，我們得出了這個過程的基本計算，以及獲得最大收益的方法。你必須坐在我設計的改良火盆範圍內，在其中加入木灰，直到它散發出白色粒子（你可以在此之前進行獻祭，但無法獲得完整效果）。然後你必須以一次快速爆發獻祭幾乎你所有的血（透過按住右鍵幾秒鐘後放開來達成）。LP 隨後會依據獻祭的心數加入祭壇，再加上祭壇中自我犧牲符文的加成。這個總數接著乘以你所處的最高品質薰香的效果。例如：如果你在完全受到木灰影響的情況下，向一個沒有任何自我犧牲符文的祭壇獻祭九顆心，你會向祭壇加入 2160 LP，而不是正常的 1800。不過，這個過程並非沒有問題，因為這種血液的快速消耗會使你暫時虛弱，其效果與靈魂磨損不無相似。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Now then, I mentioned "Highest quality incense" before. Well, after the revelation that mundane wood ash would offer a sizeable boon to LP creation, I descended into my lab to perfect the process by creating better incense. After three days, ten pots of coffee, and one nap I emerged with four new incenses: Byrrus, Livens, Viridis, and Purpura for bonuses to LP creation of 60%, 120%, 200%, 300% respectively, compared to the 20% of wood ash. There is a minor issue, however: You can't just make and use the strongest one and be done with it. You see, these are designed to be used with each other and wood ash in a sort of chain. Once you reach the peak of wood ash, Byrrus can start taking effect, once you are at it's peak Livens can start, and so on. I should also note that while the LP gains they offer are improved, the relative scents they can let off vary from par with the wood ash to as foul as a compost pile. Sacrifices must be made, and a few foul fumes is worth the gains. I should note that you can speed up the process by which you are effected by increasing the volume of vapours inhaled. In laymans terms, the more braziers active with the same incense around you the faster the effect can take hold.
zh_tw: 好了，我之前提到了「最高品質的薰香」。嗯，在發現一般的木灰能為 LP 製造提供可觀的助益之後，我走進我的實驗室，透過製作更好的薰香來完善這個過程。經過三天、十壺咖啡和一次小睡之後，我帶著四種新薰香走了出來：Byrrus、Livens、Viridis 和 Purpura，相較於木灰的 20%，它們對 LP 製造的加成分別為 60%、120%、200%、300%。不過有個小問題：你不能只做最強的那種，用了就完事。你看，這些薰香是設計成彼此以及與木灰以一種鏈狀方式搭配使用的。一旦你達到木灰的巔峰，Byrrus 才能開始生效，一旦你達到它的巔峰，Livens 才能開始，以此類推。我還應該說明，雖然它們提供的 LP 收益有所提升，但它們散發的氣味相對來說從與木灰相當，到像堆肥坑一樣惡臭，各不相同。必須有所犧牲，一些難聞的氣味換取收益是值得的。我應該說明，你可以透過增加吸入的蒸氣量來加快你受到影響的過程。用外行人的話來說，你周圍使用相同薰香的火盆越多，效果就越快生效。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: That is it for the reagents, for now. The other use for the alchemical chemistry set I have found is the creation of potions unlike anything anything I have ever seen. While not big on taste(But really, has there ever been a potion that isn't hard to swallow?), the potions it makes are more... refined. Using a single flask(Made in a T2 blood altar with2K and a glass bottle, the first being made by accident when I dropped the bottle in the lab after tripping on a table leg that had been moved), a potion ingredient, and a binding agent I can turn the solution in the flask(A mixture of nether wart, Redstone, and Glowstone dust) into a potion that has eight uses or "Swigs" instead of the normal one per bottle. Another interesting power of these new potions is that the red and blue alchemy items I had acquired from the adventures(Who in turn got from some chest in a dungeon) can be used to "Augment" the potions by mixing them in with more of potions ingredient. The red ones I have dubbed "Power catalysts", making the potions effect much more potent at the cost of shortening the effect. The blue ones I have started calling "Lengthening catalysts", as they make the potions last much longer then normal. On another note, I have started trying to make a better binding catalyst after an idea came to me from a mishap in the lab. I had tried to make a slowness potion(We had a few villagers that had been pestering us, so I wanted to get rid of them without hurting them), but after adding in the Sugar powered I tried mixing in a fermented spider eye. Trying to add it in with a weak binding catalyst, I noticed that instead of mixing with the speed potion it was forming it's own section the same color of a weakness potion. Then the flask exploded. If my theory holds true, these potions can hold more then one effect, but the solution destabilizes when an effect is added. Should the potion fully destabilize, it will cause a small explosion that shatters the flask and damages anyone close to it with the glass shards. If I can help keep the potion stable, I might have found a secret of alchemy countless mages have sought but never found...
zh_tw: 目前試劑就到這裡。我發現煉金化學套件的另一個用途，是製作與我所見過的任何東西都不同的藥水。雖然口味不佳（但說真的，有沒有哪種藥水不難以下嚥？），它所製作的藥水更……精煉。使用單一燒瓶（在二級血祭壇中以 2K 和一個玻璃瓶製成，第一個是意外做出來的，當時我被一條被移動過的桌腳絆倒，把瓶子掉在實驗室裡）、一種藥水材料和一種結合劑，我可以把燒瓶中的溶液（地獄疣、紅石和螢石粉的混合物）變成一種有八次使用機會、即「口」的藥水，而不是每瓶正常的一次。這些新藥水的另一個有趣特性是，我從冒險者（而冒險者又是從某個地下城的箱子裡拿到的）那裡獲得的紅色和藍色煉金物品，可以透過與更多的藥水材料混合來「增幅」藥水。我把紅色的稱為「威力催化劑」，使藥水的效果更強，代價是縮短效果的持續時間。藍色的我開始稱它們為「延長催化劑」，因為它們使藥水持續比正常久得多。另一件事是，在實驗室一次意外中得到靈感後，我已開始嘗試製作更好的結合催化劑。我曾試圖製作一瓶緩慢藥水（有幾位村民一直在糾纏我們，所以我想擺脫他們而又不傷害他們），但在加入糖粉後，我試著混入一顆發酵蜘蛛眼。當我試著將它與虛弱結合催化劑一起加入時，我注意到它沒有與速度藥水混合，而是形成了自己的區塊，顏色與虛弱藥水相同。然後燒瓶就爆炸了。如果我的理論成立，這些藥水可以擁有不只一個效果，但每當加入一個效果時，溶液就會失穩。如果藥水完全失穩，會引起一場小爆炸，震碎燒瓶並用玻璃碎片傷害靠近它的任何人。如果我能幫助維持藥水穩定，我也許就找到了無數法師追尋卻始終未能發現的煉金術祕密……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I have been experimenting with what I can make with this new blood orb, a gift from Tiberius for my help with his sigils. Using this orb I have finally been able to recreate the power and lengthening catalyst. Sadly, I can only make the mundane versions of each, but one step at a time. I haven't actually made many new items for my potions and alchemy(Well, compared to the shift from weak to apprentice orbs) but everything I have found is extremely useful with my potions. Then there is what I've been making for my brother, but I wrote most of the uses of them in his book. I'll add the recipes here anyway, for completeness sake.
zh_tw: 我一直在實驗用這顆新血球能製作出什麼，這是 Tiberius 為了感謝我協助他的印記而送的禮物。有了這顆血球，我終於能夠重現威力與延長催化劑。可惜我只能製作每種的普通版本，但一步一步來。我其實並沒有為我的藥水和煉金術製作很多新物品（嗯，與從虛弱血球換成學徒血球的轉變相比），但我發現的一切對我的藥水都極為有用。然後還有我為哥哥製作的東西，但我已經把它們大部分的用途寫在他的書裡了。為了完整起見，我還是在這裡補上配方。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The first step towards these new reagents was to make a better form of catalyst. Surprisingly, this was the easy part. By mixing in a netherwart and bonemeal into two simple catalysts, I could create two "Strengthened catalyst" with which to create new reagents and enhance old ones.
zh_tw: 邁向這些新試劑的第一步，是製作一種更好形式的催化劑。令人驚訝的是，這是簡單的部分。把一份地獄疣和骨粉混入兩份簡易催化劑中，我就能製作出兩份「強化催化劑」，用來製作新的試劑並強化舊有的試劑。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Shortly after this discovery, I managed to make a reagent I have dubbed "Offensa" by mixing in two arrows, a flint, and a strengthened catalyst into an Incendium. While the original reagents represented elements, these new reagents seem to represent ideas and concepts(With "War and battle" being given to offensa).
zh_tw: 這項發現後不久，我成功製作出一種我稱為「Offensa」的試劑，方法是將兩支箭、一塊燧石和一份強化催化劑混入一份 Incendium 中。雖然原本的試劑代表元素，但這些新試劑似乎代表理念與概念（Offensa 被賦予的是「戰爭與戰鬥」）。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: More tinkering gave birth to Praesidium, which seems to represent "Defense and protection" and is created by mixing tennibrae into strengthened catalyst, iron ingot(Ground into a powder at the set), Redstone dust, and a cobweb(This may or may not have fallen into the set when Bella was doing some cleaning, ending with this happy accident).
zh_tw: 進一步的修補催生了 Praesidium，它似乎代表「防禦與保護」，製作方法是將 tennibrae 混入強化催化劑、鐵錠（在套件中磨成粉）、紅石粉和一張蜘蛛網（這可能是 Bella 在打掃時掉進套件裡的，也可能不是，最終促成了這個美好的意外）。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: By strengthening Terrae with the better catalyst, sand, gun powder, and a Netherrack chunks(Luckily, we still have some from the last hell harvest festival but I must remember to buy more in a few months), I have created orbis Terrae. Where Terrae seems to be the element of earth, orbis Terrae is the environment itself, encompassing above and below ground from the dessert to the nether.
zh_tw: 透過用更好的催化劑、沙子、火藥和一塊地獄岩碎塊強化 Terrae（幸好上一次地獄收穫節我們還剩下一些，但我必須記得過幾個月再多買一點），我創造出了 orbis Terrae。如果說 Terrae 似乎是土之元素，那麼 orbis Terrae 就是環境本身，涵蓋從沙漠到下界的地上與地下。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: After a few days of nothing, I managed to form a powder now called "Virtus" from two parts Redstone, one part coal, and one part gun powder mixed into a strengthened catalyst. From what I can tell, this is the raw manifestation of power(Fitting, this reagent is hard to control and a few of our uses of it have backfired horribly). It holds in it a great deal of potential energy, but releasing it(And then controlling it) has proven to be very difficult.
zh_tw: 無所事事的幾天後，我成功製作出一種現在稱為「Virtus」的粉末，方法是將兩份紅石、一份煤炭和一份火藥混入強化催化劑中。就我所知，這是力量的原始顯現（很貼切，這種試劑難以控制，我們有幾次使用它的嘗試都慘遭反噬）。它蘊含著大量的潛在能量，但要釋放它（以及隨後控制它）已被證明非常困難。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: This next one is a little odd. Late one night in the lab I had been mixing things together to see the results, and something caused me to mix a gold ingot powdered in the stand, soul sand from our nether wart farm, Redstone dust, and a carrot of all things in the strengthened catalyst. When I awoke the next day, I found three things: A reagent called Reductus(The aspect of reduce and diminish), a large mess in the lab, and that this wasn't the strangest things I had mixed together. Since then I have started brewing pots of coffee before I begin working late in an attempt to stay lucid.
zh_tw: 下一個有點古怪。某天深夜，我在實驗室裡把各種東西混合在一起看看結果，不知為何促使我把一塊在套件中磨成粉的金錠、我們地獄疣農場的靈魂沙、紅石粉，還有偏偏是一根胡蘿蔔，混入強化催化劑中。隔天醒來，我發現了三件事：一種叫做 Reductus（縮減與減弱之相）的試劑、實驗室裡的一大堆爛攤子，以及這並不是我混合過的最奇怪的東西。從那時起，我開始在深夜工作前先煮幾壺咖啡，試圖保持頭腦清醒。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The final reagent that I have created is called "Potentia", due to the energy that causes it to crackle and pop on its own(Note: As my brother accidentally discovered, this powder does have some electrical properties to it that caused his hair to stand on end when he was working with it). Created with two chunks of lapis lazuli, Glowstone dust, a piece of nether quartz, and a strengthened catalyst, this powder is similar to virtus. The difference is that while virtus is raw power, potentia is energy. Ironically, virtus is the more stable of the two, only giving off energy in large bursts while potentia seems to give off a little at all times.
zh_tw: 我製作的最後一種試劑叫做「Potentia」，因為其能量使它自己會劈啪作響（注意：我哥哥不小心發現，這種粉末確實帶有一些電學特性，在他處理它時讓他的頭髮豎了起來）。以兩塊青金石、螢石粉、一塊下界石英和強化催化劑製成，這種粉末與 virtus 類似。差別在於，virtus 是原始的力量，而 potentia 是能量。諷刺的是，virtus 是兩者中較穩定的，只在大量爆發時釋放能量，而 potentia 似乎隨時都在釋放一點點。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: After a few weeks worth of work, I finally managed to upgrade the binding agent and have made one that lets me make more advanced potions with more then one effect. Unfortunately, it doesn't work every time. For the first effect it works every time, like the Weak Binding Agent. For the second effect, it only works four times out of ten(On average). Then the third effects works only sixteen times out a hundred(Again, on average.) It also needs 1.5K LP to make the binding agent when mixing a Weak Binding Agent, a Sanctus and a Crystallos. With how rare some of the ingredients of my potions are, I decided to create a "Filling agent" that replaces the solution in the potion flask so that I can get more uses out of them. I have noticed that potions with more then one effect require stronger filling agents, as every effect in the potion cuts down how effective the agent is. The Weak Filling Agent is made with a Simple Catalyst, a pile of Redstone and Glowstone dust, and a piece of nether wart. The Weak Filling Agent can then be upgraded with a Terrae and 1K LP into a "Standard" filling agent.
zh_tw: 經過幾週的工作，我終於成功升級了結合劑，做出了一種讓我能製作擁有不只一個效果的更進階藥水的結合劑。不幸的是，它並非每次都有效。第一個效果每次都有效，就像虛弱結合劑一樣。第二個效果，只有十次中四次有效（平均而言）。然後第三個效果一百次中只有十六次有效（同樣是平均而言）。將虛弱結合劑、一份 Sanctus 和一份 Crystallos 混合製作這種結合劑時，還需要 1.5K LP。考慮到我藥水的某些材料有多稀有，我決定製作一種「填充劑」來取代藥水燒瓶中的溶液，這樣我就能從中獲得更多使用次數。我注意到擁有不只一個效果的藥水需要更強的填充劑，因為藥水中的每個效果都會降低填充劑的效力。虛弱填充劑以一份簡易催化劑、一堆紅石與螢石粉，以及一塊地獄疣製成。虛弱填充劑接著可以用一份 Terrae 和 1K LP 升級成「標準」填充劑。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I managed to find a new use for the weak blood shards that the others have been gathering. Since the shards are technically part of a "Soul", I tried mixing it in with a bucket of water and sand using my chemistry set to get a fairly close replication of an uncommon nether resource, soul sand. While not identical, it can serve the same purpose as the normal one found in the nether.
zh_tw: 我找到了其他人一直在收集的虛弱血之碎片的新用途。由於這些碎片在技術上是「靈魂」的一部分，我嘗試用我的化學套件把它與一桶水和沙子混合，得到了一種不常見的下界資源——靈魂沙——相當接近的複製品。雖然不完全相同，但它能達到與下界中發現的一般靈魂沙相同的目的。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It just occurred to me, it has been over three years since I came to Magus's doorstep with my brother and sister. I've gotten so use to living here, and the daily routine seems like something I've done all my life. Strange, I never thought I'd settle down. Five years ago, I'd have never considered leaving the caravan. I have barely left my lab in the last month, aside from when Magus, my brother or sister drag me out by the back of my robe. Normally I would go out willingly, but we recently finished our altar upgrade and have created the "Master Blood orbs." As is customary, this new orb has given me the boost in power needed to create more alchemy items for both general use and my potions. As a result, progress has been coming in leaps and bounds with something new almost every other day. After many late nights and early mornings, theses are the fruits of my labor.
zh_tw: 我突然想到，自從我和我的弟弟妹妹來到 Magus 家門口，已經過了三年多。我已經如此習慣在這裡生活，日常作息彷彿是我一生都在做的事。奇怪的是，我從沒想過自己會安定下來。五年前，我絕不會考慮離開商隊。過去一個月我幾乎沒離開過我的實驗室，除了 Magus、我弟弟或妹妹抓著我的長袍後面把我拖出來的時候。通常我會自願出去，但我們最近剛完成了祭壇的升級，並創造出了「大師血球」。按照慣例，這顆新血球給了我製作更多煉金物品所需的力量提升，既供一般使用，也用於我的藥水。因此，進展突飛猛進，幾乎隔天就有新東西出現。經過許多個熬夜到深夜與清晨的日子，這些就是我辛勤勞動的成果。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I managed to improve the catalyst even further by mixing in a gold nugget and the fragments of a bone into the strengthened catalyst, making it into a much more concentrated form, hence the name "Concentrated catalyst." With it, I have been able to infuse the imbued slates created in the blood altar with alchemical power, making it stronger then normal and able to construct devices to hold alchemical and magical energy. On the potion items, I can finally make all the forms of the power and lengthening catalysts, filling agents. By merging two of a catalyst with a Standard Binding Agent you can make the standard form of said catalyst, and then you can create the greater form of the catalyst by fusing two of the standard with a reagent(Incendium for power and Aquasalus for lengthening). Adding these to a potion is the same process as the mundane, place the potion and the ingredient in the stand with the catalyst of choice. Note: You don't need to teir up from normal to the greatest, you can jump strait to the greatest effect by mixing in a greater catalyst. Adding a better catalyst to an old potion does nothing for the effect, and is the same as if you added it to a potion that never had a catalyst added. The greater filling agent is able to resort six charges to a one effect potion, and is made by adding Aquasalus and magicalus to a Standard Filling Agent. The remainder of my time has been spent brewing potions. Bella has almost finished the demon summoning area, and I have been creating a few reagents for that and brewing potions to buff myself during the fights. Bella has mentioned a beast called an "Elemental", and it has me slightly worried. A few new bruises later, and I now have a demon blood shard to call my own. I also have one procured by Magus to improve his ritual activation crystal with, and I will need to use a few reagents to merge the blood shard with the crystal, and some experimentation will be needed to find out what...
zh_tw: 我成功進一步改良了催化劑，方法是將一粒金粒和骨頭碎片混入強化催化劑中，使其成為濃度高得多的形態，因此得名「濃縮催化劑」。有了它，我得以用煉金之力灌注在血祭壇中製成的灌輸石板，使其比平常更強，並能夠建造用來容納煉金與魔法能量的裝置。在藥水物品方面，我終於能製作出威力與延長催化劑、填充劑的所有形式。將兩份催化劑與一份標準結合劑合併，就可以製作出該催化劑的標準形式，然後你可以將兩份標準形式與一種試劑（威力用 Incendium，延長用 Aquasalus）融合，製作出催化劑的進階形式。將這些加入藥水的過程與一般的相同，把藥水和材料與所選的催化劑一起放在台子上。注意：你不需要從一般等級逐級提升到最高級，你可以透過混入進階催化劑直接跳到最高級的效果。將更好的催化劑加入舊藥水不會對效果造成任何影響，其結果與加入一瓶從未加過催化劑的藥水相同。進階填充劑能為單一效果的藥水恢復六次使用次數，製作方法是將 Aquasalus 和 magicalus 加入標準填充劑。我剩下的時間都花在釀製藥水上。Bella 幾乎完成了惡魔召喚區域，我則一直在為此製作一些試劑，並釀製藥水在戰鬥中為自己增益。Bella 提到了一種稱為「元素精靈」的野獸，這讓我略感擔憂。幾處新的瘀青之後，我現在有了一枚屬於自己的惡魔血之碎片。我還有一枚是 Magus 為了改良他的儀式啟動水晶而取得的，我需要用幾種試劑將血之碎片與水晶融合，並且需要一些實驗才能找出會發生什麼……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: A few tries later, and the binding of the demonic power to the crystal works with Aquasalus, Incendium, and Aether. In theory, a Nether Star can be used in place of a demon blood shard, but considering how hard those are to get a hold of... Magus has been thrilled with his new crystal, and I have started work on a new project with Tiberius as a surprise for Magus. His rituals as they stand are good, but I have had an idea to make them even better... I'm having a hard time sleeping tonight, so I might as well go over our idea and hope Magus doesn't read this. As it stands, the rituals only use life essence to run and are often "one-trick ponies." What I proposed to Tiberius is this: What would happen if one of the rituals was charged with alchemical power, costing reagent to give it new or stronger effects? We might get nothing, or something amazing. Time will tell which it is.
zh_tw: 試了幾次之後，將惡魔之力綁定到水晶上，在使用 Aquasalus、Incendium 和 Aether 時成功了。理論上，下界之星可以用來取代惡魔血之碎片，但考慮到它們有多難取得……Magus 對他的新水晶欣喜若狂，而我已經和 Tiberius 開始著手一個要給 Magus 驚喜的新專案。照目前的狀況，他的儀式很不錯，但我有個想法可以讓它們變得更好……我今晚睡不著，所以不妨把我們的想法寫出來，並希望 Magus 不會讀到這個。目前，這些儀式只使用生命精華運作，而且往往是「一招鮮」。我向 Tiberius 提出的想法是：如果其中一個儀式以煉金之力充能，消耗試劑來賦予它新的或更強的效果，會怎麼樣？我們可能什麼都得不到，也可能得到驚人的成果。時間會告訴我們是哪一個。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It has taken the last two months, but we have the groundwork for testing our idea done. The results so far have been even better than expected. We have only tested the full Spring ritual and have discovered quite a few effects, but I'll let Magus cover those.
zh_tw: 這花了過去兩個月，但我們已經完成了測試我們想法的基礎工作。到目前為止的結果甚至比預期的更好。我們只測試了滿春儀式，並發現了相當多的效果，不過我會讓 Magus 來介紹那些。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Instead, I'll write how the reagent system works. You first need an Alchemic Calcinator, then place a Blood Orb into it to act as a power source. After that, reagents can be placed by hand or fed into the Calcinator to turn into pure alchemical energy, the type based on the reagent fed in. Once it has a solid reagent, it will use LP to turn one reagent into 1000 AR (Alchemy Reagent), which is then moved into the 2000 AR "Buffer" of the Calcinator. Once in the buffer, the reagent slowly starts being moved into the main tank, which can then be siphoned out.
zh_tw: 我改為來寫試劑系統是如何運作的。你首先需要一個煉金煅燒爐，然後在其中放入一顆血球作為動力來源。之後，試劑可以用手放入，或送入煅燒爐中轉化為純粹的煉金能量，類型取決於所送入的試劑。一旦它有了一份實體試劑，就會消耗 LP 將一份試劑轉化為 1000 AR（Alchemy Reagent，煉金試劑量），然後移入煅燒爐 2000 AR 的「緩衝」槽。進入緩衝槽後，試劑會開始慢慢移入主槽，之後就可以被抽取出來。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Now then, to move it out of the main tank, you need to have somewhere for it to go. To this extent, you have three options: a Crystal Belljar, an Alchemic Relay, or a Master Ritual Stone. How you need to link it is simple: Create an Alchemic Router, then Shift-right-click with it on the Calcinator to select the reagent type for it to transport (a note for blocks with more than one tank and more than one reagent type: Shift-right-clicking again on the block will swap between the available reagents inside the block), then normal right-click on the block with the router to bind it to the block. After that, right-click on the destination (needs to be within a few blocks; the range isn't that large). If it has worked, you should see reagent "flowing" to the destination from the source (in this case, the Calcinator). We have tweaked it so you can't see reagent moving with the naked eye-you need to have a tool (like the Alchemic Router) in hand to see this effect. You can also use a Divination Sigil on the Belljars, Relays, Calcinator, and Master Ritual Stone to read how much reagent the device holds. This process of binding can be applied to all the other blocks, so I shouldn't need to cover it further, but I should note that these blocks can only accept and send reagent to a limited number of locations at once. For example, the Belljar can only accept reagent from one location, and send it to one location. I must also reiterate that if you have a Relay set to send Aether to destination A and Tennibrae to destination B, Aether can never travel to B, and vice versa for Tennibrae. New connections must be made for each reagent type, and we could not get a "colorless" version of a connection to function.
zh_tw: 好了，要將它從主槽中移出，你需要有個地方讓它去。為此，你有三個選項：水晶鐘形罩、煉金中繼器，或主儀式石。連結的方式很簡單：製作一個煉金路由器，然後按住 Shift 對煅燒爐右鍵，選擇要讓它運送的試劑類型（對於擁有不只一個槽和不只一種試劑類型的方塊的注意事項：再次按住 Shift 右鍵該方塊，會在該方塊內可用的試劑之間切換），然後用路由器對該方塊按一般右鍵，將其綁定到該方塊。之後，對目的地按右鍵（需要在幾格範圍內；範圍並不大）。如果成功了，你應該會看到試劑從來源（在此例中為煅燒爐）「流向」目的地。我們已經調整過，使肉眼無法看到試劑移動——你需要手持工具（例如煉金路由器）才能看到這個效果。你也可以對鐘形罩、中繼器、煅燒爐和主儀式石使用占卜印記，讀取該裝置存有多少試劑。這個綁定過程可以應用於所有其他方塊，所以我應該不需要進一步說明，但我應該說明的是，這些方塊同一時間只能接受和傳送試劑到有限數量的地點。例如，鐘形罩只能從一個位置接受試劑，並傳送到一個位置。我還必須重申，如果你設定一個中繼器將 Aether 送往目的地 A、將 Tennibrae 送往目的地 B，那麼 Aether 永遠無法前往 B，Tennibrae 對 A 亦然。必須為每種試劑類型建立新的連結，而我們無法讓「無色」版本的連結運作。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Getting more into detail about the blocks and items of our new system, I'll cover the Belljar first. Created out of mundane glass and wood slabs, then filled with a Concentrated Catalyst solution to contain the alchemical energy in a stable enough environment to allow you to move the jar without losing any energy inside. While it can hold only one type of reagent and is restricted to one source and one destination, it functions as a portable form of "bulk storage" (able to hold 16000 AR). An option for more storage is to link a few Belljars together, but I feel this is far from a perfect answer to the problem of mass storage of reagent... I will need to talk with Tiberius and Magus about this later. Regardless, Tiberius managed to incorporate a bit of Redstone interaction into the design of the jar. Based on the amount of reagent inside the jar, it outputs a Redstone signal (15 when full, 0 when empty, and so on). With a bit of work, you can use this for automated systems.
zh_tw: 進一步詳述我們新系統的方塊與物品，我先介紹鐘形罩。它由普通玻璃和木半磚製成，然後填入濃縮催化劑溶液，使煉金能量處於足夠穩定的環境中，讓你移動罐子時不會損失其中的任何能量。雖然它只能容納一種試劑，且僅限於一個來源和一個目的地，但它能作為一種可攜式的「大量儲存」形式（可容納 16000 AR）。想要更多儲存空間的一個選項是把幾個鐘形罩連結在一起，但我覺得這遠非試劑大量儲存問題的完美答案……我之後需要和 Tiberius 與 Magus 談談這件事。無論如何，Tiberius 成功將一點紅石互動融入了罐子的設計。根據罐內的試劑量，它會輸出紅石訊號（滿時為 15，空時為 0，依此類推）。稍作調整，你就可以將它用於自動化系統。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: The "Alchemy Relay" acts as a small buffer (two tanks that can hold two reagents each) and can be used to merge and divide a transport line of reagent energy. Each relay can have limitless sources and four destinations. With the creative use of relays, you can create a large power network for transporting reagent. Tiberius has worked his magic on this device as well and tweaked it to not send reagent when a Redstone signal is applied (it also spins slightly slower to represent this).
zh_tw: 「煉金中繼器」作為一個小型緩衝（兩個槽，每個可容納兩種試劑），可用於合併和分流試劑能量的運輸線路。每個中繼器可以有無限個來源和四個目的地。透過創意地使用中繼器，你可以創造出一個運輸試劑的大型能量網路。Tiberius 也對這個裝置施展了他的魔法，並調整它在施加紅石訊號時不傳送試劑（它也會轉得稍微慢一些來表示這點）。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: To assist with the use of this system, we have three items to manage these devices. The Alchemic Router is used to bind the destinations of set reagents for all devices. The Alchemic Segmenter is used to partition tanks to a set reagent. All you need to do is set the reagent type the same way you would the router, then right-click the device you want to partition a tank for that reagent type. One tank will be set for that type per right-click, and if you exceed the maximum number of available tanks, it will reset all partitioned tanks to the default "first come, first served." I should also note that if you set a relay to accept Sanctus, Offensa, and Virtus, the two available tanks will be distributed to whichever reagents arrive first. The final item is the Alchemic Cleanser, and its use is simple but very useful: it resets all destinations. All locations the device is set to send reagent are cleared, so you can easily bind the device to new locations.
zh_tw: 為了協助使用這個系統，我們有三件物品來管理這些裝置。煉金路由器用於為所有裝置綁定特定試劑的目的地。煉金分割器用於將槽分配給特定試劑。你只需要像設定路由器那樣設定試劑類型，然後對你想為該試劑類型分割槽的裝置按右鍵。每按一次右鍵，就會為該類型設定一個槽，如果你超過了可用槽的最大數量，它會將所有已分割的槽重設為預設的「先到先得」。我還應該說明，如果你設定一個中繼器接受 Sanctus、Offensa 和 Virtus，兩個可用的槽就會分配給最先到達的試劑。最後一件物品是煉金清除器，它的用途簡單但非常有用：它會重設所有目的地。該裝置被設定要傳送試劑的所有位置都會被清除，這樣你就可以輕鬆地將裝置綁定到新的位置。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: Now, we have made a few minor alterations to the "Master Ritual Stone" to enable our system to function. Its recipe and normal uses have remained the same, but it now has three internal tanks that each hold 1000 AR. If the ritual has any reagent, it will display an "Alchemy Ring" above the Master Ritual Stone as a sign that it has been augmented. Then, depending on the ritual and the effect in question, it will use an amount of reagent to perform a new effect or augment an old one. An example of this is the full Spring filled with Aquasalus, which will convert earth into farmland then hydrate it in a nine-by-nine area around the Master Ritual Stone, but if the full Spring is given Crystallus, it will freeze all water source blocks around it. This is all paired with the base effect of the rituals, so the full Spring can still function as an endless water source. This is all I can think of to write down about our new system. Tiberius and I plan to show it to the others tomorrow, so I need to get some rest. We showed our new system to Magus and my siblings today, and to say they loved it was an understatement. We had decided to be a little flashy with the show, building a full Spring next to a small pond that had formed from the recent rainfall. After a bit of work hiding the relays and the Belljar, Tiberius hid out of sight while I showed the others the demonstration. I asked Magus to activate the ritual, keeping a close eye to see if he focused on anything in particular, but he quickly and effortlessly activated the ritual without pausing for a moment. After he returned to my side, I yelled for Tiberius to throw the switch. In an instant, the reagent flowed to the ritual, and as the alchemy circle formed in the air, the water created by the ritual and that of the pond quickly froze over. I heard gasps from both of my siblings, and I noticed Magus's eyes widen for just a moment (his equivalent of a jaw hanging slack) before he composed himself. Afterwards, we went over the details for them of how it works for the others, explaining the minor modifications we had made to the basic Master Ritual Stone design and such.
zh_tw: 現在，我們對「主儀式石」做了一些小改動，使我們的系統能夠運作。它的配方與一般用途保持不變，但現在它有三個內部槽，每個可容納 1000 AR。如果儀式有任何試劑，它會在主儀式石上方顯示一個「煉金環」，作為已被增幅的標誌。然後，依據儀式和相關效果，它會消耗一定量的試劑來執行新的效果，或增幅舊有的效果。一個例子是裝滿 Aquasalus 的滿春儀式，它會將土地轉為農地，然後滋潤主儀式石周圍九乘九的區域，但如果給滿春儀式 Crystallus，它會凍結周圍所有的水源方塊。這一切都與儀式的基本效果搭配，所以滿春儀式仍然可以作為無盡的水源運作。關於我們的新系統，我能想到要寫下的就這些了。Tiberius 和我打算明天向其他人展示，所以我需要休息一下。我們今天向 Magus 和我的兄弟姊妹展示了我們的新系統，說他們喜歡都算輕描淡寫了。我們決定表演得稍微花俏一點，在最近降雨形成的一個小池塘旁建造了一個滿春儀式。稍微花了點功夫藏好中繼器和鐘形罩之後，Tiberius 躲到看不見的地方，而我向其他人展示示範。我請 Magus 啟動儀式，並密切注意他是否特別專注於什麼，但他毫不停頓地迅速而輕鬆地啟動了儀式。他回到我身邊後，我大喊要 Tiberius 拉下開關。轉瞬間，試劑流向儀式，隨著煉金圓陣在空中形成，儀式產生的水和池塘的水迅速結凍。我聽到我兩個兄弟姊妹倒抽一口氣，也注意到 Magus 的眼睛睜大了片刻（他版本的下巴鬆垮），然後才恢復鎮定。事後，我們向其他人講解了它如何運作的細節，說明我們對基本主儀式石設計所做的小改動等等。
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: It has been a week since we ironed out most of the kinks with the reagent system, and Magus brought all of us together around the dinner table to go over the next few months. He said that he could get us something he felt would be needed to upgrade the altar to tier five, but it would take a little over a year to get them. He also mentioned that we should be getting a few messages after this year's Hell Harvest Festival, which I thought was a little odd. "A little odd" doesn't begin to describe what has been happening the last few days. It seems most of us have put research aside while we watch some of the "Replies" come in. They have come in via airdrop, mechanized mail carriers, train, and countless other ways that always seem stranger than the last. Tiberius managed to ask Magus what this was all about, and he simply replied that he invited a few guests over, and these were the replies they had sent. When pressed for more details, he just said they wouldn't be coming for a few months, so we should start mastering what we can do with our blood orbs. We then started showing each other the little details of the branches of blood magic we had created and had been perfecting. In the last few months I have befriended a few demons with the help of my sister, created a few spell crystals and helped construct a large complex spell with my brother, and then forged armor and sigils with Tiberius. Then it came time to teach the others alchemy and potion brewing... I was reluctant to give out my secrets to brewing potions, even to them. I had told no one the recipes for these brews, brewing potions for the others myself when they needed them. I almost wanted to tell the others no, but then Magus made me an offer. "I understand how you want to keep the secrets of your brews hidden, so how about we make a trade of knowledge instead?" he asked me when I was contemplating this matter. He offered me details about himself, something that wasn't common knowledge, and even gave me permission to write everything down. Considering how little I knew of him, even after all these years, I quickly took him up on this offer. The very next day I had everyone in my personal lab, showing them the details and reciting the recipes for some of the most potent effects I had found, then demonstrating their uses. I was done showing them everything shortly before dinner, so while we ate in the common room, Magus told us his story. I'll jot as much of it as I can recall here, for you to enjoy as well. "So it is time to tell my story... I always hate doing this. So many questions that I really don't have answers for, and frankly it is a long bloody story. But a deal is a deal, and you all deserve to hear it. I have only told a handful of people this, all of them were either mages or Conglomeration members. You will so count among this number... I was born in the middle of the Talus Kingdom, before all these corporations were founded and started forming their own governments. Back then gods and kings dictated law, and wars were fought on the battlefield and not in market shares and advertisement campaigns. My family was small; all I had was a mother who did all she could at home and a father who worked at the royal library. I ended up spending many hours in that library, both helping my father with his work and studying the countless tomes that adorned those shelves. At an early age I discovered a hidden treasure trove in those shelves: books on magic. At the time magic wasn't well known, and most regarded it as nothing but myths created by fools. Because of this, these books stayed lost and forgotten on these shelves until I came along. While other boys were learning the right way to hold a sword or a pickaxe, I spent my time studying the arcane. At the end of my first year there, I had already created a basic fireball spell and a Thaumanonicon. I managed to keep my activities in magic hidden from everyone, my parents included, until I had come of age and needed to find a profession. It was then that I told them of what I had been working on all those years, showing them some of the smaller tricks I had perfected. To say they were shocked is an understatement, so I felt it best to leave their little world in the kingdom and set out to find a new home to practice magic without needing to be as secretive. That is how I came to Lurric, and it has been my home ever since then. The early days were hard, as I really didn't have the funds to live off of, let alone support my research. I managed to get by helping the locals: merchants with bookkeeping and identifying some of the more obscure relics and "treasures" they had for sale, farmers with stock and management, and even as a cook when times were really dark for me. But this only lasted a year or two, then I had the infrastructure in place to support myself with a little extra to live on. Amazing how much traders are willing to spend on floating balls of flame and purple metal... Skipping ahead a few years through the dull portion, I had begun to master a few forms of magic like thaumurgy and botany. My name had started to spread to the other nearby villages, and people asking for favors and knowledge started popping up at my door like they do now. At the time I never asked for gifts or compensation, but I didn't turn down food or books if they were offered. Traders started traveling to Lurric more and more, hoping to acquire a few goods that only I could provide at the time in exchange for gold, jewels, and rare books. Those who brought the third I gave the best deals. Still, life went on like this for a few more years, with books starting to pile up in my library, more than enough gold to pay for my more "exotic" materials, and never having a day of rest for the full decade I had first lived here. That peace was shattered the day a man by the name of Gareth broke down my door. He came in, adorned in full iron armor and longsword in hand, to challenge me to a duel to the death. It took more than a few sleep spells to knock him out of his rage, at which point I restrained him to a reclined chair I had in the back that I used when treating the wounded. When he finally awoke, I started interrogating him. Well, interrogate isn't quite the right word for it... Honestly, I just asked him a few questions. Once I saw that he had calmed down, I untied him and offered food. Did I mention the sounds his stomach made while he was unconscious? They were strong enough to rattle the chair. After eating a whole bread loaf and a large part of the stew I had been preparing before he arrived, we sat in this very room to talk like civil beings over why he decided to break down my door. His story is about as ludicrous as mine is. He was one of fifty-seven immortal beings who walked the earth. He told me what details he could, but he seemed unsure about it as well. What he did tell me was that the gift of immortality comes with a few boons aside from the obvious, and what they are differs from person to person. He said his gift was that of prophecy, and he recently had a vision of the future where I and people I influence would play a major role. As a result, he came here to challenge me to a duel to the death. I then asked him if that wasn't a bit unfair, him being immortal and all. He, in the most serious tone possible, said that it was completely fair: While an immortal cannot be killed normally, there are set ways that it can happen. One way is by a one-on-one duel to the death, with immortality wagered as the prize. They really don't have much choice in this, as it is like natural magic: The mere act of the duel happening is enough for the "wager" to take place. If both parties exert their full strength, then the killing blow is enough to complete the wager and transfer the gift. We talked for the next few hours, and I learned quite a few interesting facts. He had no idea who the other fifty-six immortals were, and he frankly had no way to tell them apart from normal humans. He also mentioned that he could still be injured outside of the duel, but he would not fall to mortal wounds and would heal at an accelerated rate-not much of one, however, as he mentioned breaking a leg once and it taking over a month to fully heal. Another note was how short a time he had been immortal; he had gained it about two decades ago. While to you that seems like a long time, he said the one he killed was alive for over a century. We finally ended that night with an agreement: In one week's time he would return to my home, where we would share a fine meal, then have our duel the next morning. He wanted to get straight to the duel, but I had the meal as a non-negotiable point that he finally caved on. I spent the next week preparing for the battle, arming myself with the most potent spells and artifacts at my disposal from several schools of magic. In a flash that week went by, then Gareth once again sat with me to eat at my table. I gave him a bed to sleep in that night, then at dawn we both walked to the hill just behind this house where Bella's garden currently lays. Of all things about Gareth, our battle is one thing I barely remember. Once we reached the top of the hill, we both drew our blades and turned to each other. After that, I only remember flashes and out-of-order scenes. It felt like it was over in only a few minutes, but it might have been hours and was one of the most brutal fights I have ever been a part of. His agility was far greater than I expected, dodging my swings and spells with ease. Unfortunately for him, I was still a force to be reckoned with back then. I never let up on my spells, casting fire, ice, and lightning one after another using my foci, then teleporting around with a few spells. In the end, he died when he dropped his sword in reflex to the heat my flame spell had left on it, and I capitalized on this. By this point, we both felt taxed by the fight, and he could barely avoid my slowest attacks. The final blow I dealt was out of mercy, a quick end for his suffering that I had caused. I watched as Gareth grinned at me like he knew this would be how he died, then he closed his eyes as his body turned into sand carried away in the wind. I fell to my side after that, strength sapped and mana depleted, to awake a few hours later. I felt a new strength in my body when I got up, slight but still there. All in all, suddenly having immortality was rather lackluster, but that was how it happened." At this point I was shocked into silence at his words-not what he said, but how he said them: little feeling or emphasis. It was like he just said that he gained a new scar or it started to rain. He has been more emotional over the acquisition of a rare book than immortality. Glancing at the others, I could tell they were mulling over this information as well. After a few minutes, my brother spoke up to start the questions. "So... Did your life change much after that?" Demir asked Magus, before taking a bite out of a sandwich he seemed to have created from thin air. "Not really. Life as an immortal was just the same as life as a mortal. More researching, more learning, more magic." "Have you met any more immortals since then?" Bella asked. "Two, and I happen to be related to both of them." "Related?" asked Tiberius with curiosity, "I never knew you had any relatives." "Well, they never came up. One of them is my brother, who started studying the Myst a few decades ago and hasn't been heard from since. I expect he will pop by anytime he feels homesick for a few days, then drop out of touch again." "And the other immortal?" Bella asked with interest. "The other is my wife." Once again we all went into stunned silence, Tiberius and Demir slack-jawed. "You're married! Since when?" Bella asked after a moment. "A few centuries ago. We met when a small war was being fought with a necromancer, and she was the one leading the forces. Of course, most people at the time didn't know her real gender. She tried hard to keep it hidden, so the troops wouldn't think of her any differently. I was brought in to help deal with the "Undead army" details of the whole thing, and that had me working with her. One thing led to another, and we were married a few months after the war was over. Currently she works as a commander of the Conglomeration's defense force, so she rarely has time to come home." The questions continued for the next half hour, ranging from "Did you really open the first Nether Portals?" to "Why are you on the Conglomeration board?" Magus took all our questions with the air of a man who has done this all before. When the questions were over, all the others started retiring to their rooms while I stopped by the library to look up something. The Talus Kingdom fell almost a millennium ago. Wow... It has been a few months since I last wrote in this book. I've met more people in the last few weeks than I have in the last few years, many of them from lands I have never set foot in! Kings and queens, rulers and underlords, CEOs and owners from every nation. Then there was the fight with the Withers... I'm not sure what to say about all that. I sort of walked in there, chugged a few potions, then let the years of training with Magus take over. By the time the adrenaline rush was over for me, we had killed all of the Withers, and I was barely aware of a dull pain in my leg. Magus has used a spell to restrict my movement so I won't leave this bed while my broken leg heals, since I "may" have tried to sneak into my lab once or twice to get to work. For now, I must be content with my notebook and what Magus brings me from his library to pass the days...
zh_tw: 距離我們理順試劑系統的大部分問題已經過了一週，Magus 把我們全都召集到餐桌旁，討論接下來幾個月的事。他說他可以弄到他覺得升級祭壇到五級所需的東西，但需要一年多的時間才能取得。他還提到，在今年的地獄收穫節之後，我們應該會收到一些訊息，我覺得有點奇怪。「有點奇怪」不足以形容過去幾天發生的事。似乎我們大多數人都把研究擱置一旁，看著一些「回覆」湧進來。它們透過空投、機械化郵遞員、火車，以及無數其他似乎一個比一個更奇怪的方式送達。Tiberius 設法問了 Magus 這到底是怎麼回事，他只是回答說他邀請了一些客人，而這些是他們寄來的回覆。在被追問更多細節時，他只說他們幾個月後才會來，所以我們應該開始精通我們血球能做到的事。接著，我們開始向彼此展示我們創造並一直在完善的血魔法各分支的小細節。在過去幾個月裡，我在妹妹的幫助下結交了幾隻惡魔，與哥哥一起製作了幾枚法術水晶並協助建造了一個大型複雜法術，然後與 Tiberius 一起鍛造了盔甲和印記。接著輪到我教其他人煉金術和藥水釀製了……我不太願意透露我釀製藥水的祕密，即使是對他們。我沒有告訴任何人這些藥水的配方，當其他人需要時我就自己為他們釀製。我差點想拒絕其他人，但接著 Magus 向我提出了一個提議。「我理解你想要保守你藥水的祕密，那我們不如改成交換知識如何？」當我正在思考這件事時，他這樣問我。他提供了關於他自己的細節，那是不為人知的事，甚至允許我把一切都寫下來。考慮到即使這麼多年過去，我對他的了解仍然那麼少，我很快就接受了這個提議。隔天，我讓所有人到我的私人實驗室，向他們展示細節並念誦我發現的一些最強效效果的配方，然後示範它們的用途。我在晚餐前不久講解完所有內容，所以我們在共用的房間裡吃飯時，Magus 向我們講述了他的故事。我會盡我所能記得的，把它寫在這裡，供你們也一起欣賞。「那麼是時候講我的故事了……我總是討厭做這件事。有太多問題我真的沒有答案，而且坦白說這是個很長的鬼故事。但約定就是約定，你們都值得聽。我只告訴過少數幾個人這件事，他們不是法師就是 Conglomeration 成員。你們現在也算在這群人之中了……我出生在 Talus 王國的中心，那是在所有這些公司成立並開始組成自己的政府之前。那時是神明和國王制定法律，戰爭是在戰場上打的，而不是在市場佔有率和廣告戰役中。我的家庭很小；我只有一位在家盡其所能的母親，和一位在皇家圖書館工作的父親。我最終在那座圖書館度過了許多時間，既協助父親工作，也研讀裝飾那些書架的無數典籍。我很早就在那些書架中發現了一座隱藏的寶庫：關於魔法的書。當時魔法並不廣為人知，大多數人認為它不過是愚人編造的神話。正因如此，這些書一直遺失並被遺忘在那些書架上，直到我出現。當其他男孩正在學習握劍或鶴嘴鋤的正確方法時，我把時間花在研究奧術上。在我到那裡的第一年結束時，我已經創造出基本的火球術和一本 Thaumanonicon。我成功地將我在魔法上的活動瞞著所有人，包括我的父母，直到我成年、需要找一份職業。就在那時，我把這些年來一直在研究的事告訴了他們，並向他們展示了一些我已臻完美的小把戲。說他們震驚都算輕描淡寫了，所以我覺得最好離開他們在王國中的小世界，出發去尋找一個新的家，在那裡我可以修習魔法而不需要那麼隱密。這就是我來到 Lurric 的經過，從那以後這裡就一直是我的家。早年很艱難，因為我真的沒有足夠的資金生活，更別說支援我的研究。我設法靠幫助當地人過活：為商人記帳並鑑定他們出售的一些較為冷僻的遺物與『寶物』，為農夫處理牲畜與管理，甚至在我真的很落魄的時候當過廚師。但這只持續了一兩年，後來我有了足夠的基礎來養活自己，還有一點額外的生活費。真驚人，商人們願意為漂浮的火球和紫色金屬花那麼多錢……跳過無聊的部分快轉幾年，我已經開始精通幾種魔法形式，例如奇術和植物學。我的名聲已開始傳到附近的其他村莊，要求幫忙和知識的人開始像現在這樣出現在我家門口。那時我從不索取禮物或報酬，但如果有人提供食物或書籍，我也不會拒絕。商人們開始越來越頻繁地前往 Lurric，希望獲得一些當時只有我能提供的商品，以換取黃金、珠寶和珍稀書籍。帶來第三種的人，我給的優惠最好。生活就這樣又持續了好幾年，我的藏書室裡書越堆越多，有足夠的黃金來支付我較『異國』的材料，而且在我最初居住在這裡的整整十年裡，從沒有一天休息。那份平靜在一個名叫 Gareth 的男人踹破我的門的那天被打破了。他走進來，身穿全套鐵甲，手持長劍，要向我挑戰一場生死決鬥。我用了不只幾個睡眠法術才讓他從暴怒中平靜下來，這時我把他綁在後面的一張躺椅上，那是我治療傷者時用的。他終於醒來時，我開始審問他。嗯，審問並不是恰當的詞……老實說，我只是問了他幾個問題。一看到他冷靜下來，我就鬆了綁並提供食物。我有沒有提到他昏迷時肚子發出的聲音？大到足以讓椅子震動。吃完一整條麵包和我在他到來之前準備的大部分燉菜後，我們坐在這個房間裡，像文明人一樣談他為什麼決定踹破我的門。他的故事跟我的一樣荒唐。他是行走在大地上的五十七名不死者之一。他告訴了我他所能說的細節，但他似乎對此也不確定。他確實告訴我的是，除了顯而易見的之外，不死的天賦還伴隨著一些恩賜，而這些因人而異。他說他的天賦是預言，他最近看到了一個關於未來的異象，其中我以及受我影響的人將扮演重要角色。因此，他來到這裡向我挑戰生死決鬥。我於是問他，這是否有點不公平，畢竟他是不死之身。他以最嚴肅的口吻說，這完全公平：雖然不死者無法被正常殺死，但有既定的方式可以發生。其中一種方式是一對一的生死決鬥，以不死作為賭注。他們對此真的沒有多少選擇，因為這就像自然魔法：決鬥發生的這個行為本身就足以讓『賭注』成立。如果雙方都使出全力，那麼致命一擊就足以完成賭注並轉移天賦。我們接下來談了幾個小時，我學到了相當多有趣的事實。他不知道其他五十六位不死者是誰，坦白說他也沒有辦法把他們與一般人類區分開來。他還提到，在決鬥之外他仍然可能受傷，但不會死於致命傷，並以加速的速度癒合——不過沒快多少，因為他提到有一次摔斷了腿，花了一個多月才完全痊癒。另一件事是他成為不死者的時間有多短；他大約是二十年前獲得的。雖然對你來說那似乎是很長的時間，但他說他殺死的那位活了一百多年。我們那晚最終達成了協議：一週後他會回到我家，我們會共享一頓美餐，然後在第二天早上進行決鬥。他想直接決鬥，但我把那頓飯當作不容談判的一點，他最終讓步了。接下來一週，我都在為戰鬥做準備，用我手邊來自幾個學派最強大的法術與神器武裝自己。轉眼間那週就過去了，Gareth 再次與我坐在一起，在我的桌子旁用餐。那晚我給了他一張床睡覺，然後黎明時我們倆走到這間房子正後方的山丘，也就是 Bella 的花園現在所在的地方。關於 Gareth，我們的戰鬥是我幾乎不記得的一件事。到了山頂後，我們都拔出了劍，轉向對方。在那之後，我只記得一些片段和錯序的場景。感覺只過了幾分鐘就結束了，但也可能有好幾個小時，那是我參與過最殘酷的戰鬥之一。他的敏捷遠超我的預期，輕鬆閃過我的揮擊與法術。不幸的是，我那時仍然是一股不可小覷的力量。我從不放鬆我的法術，利用我的焦點接連施放火、冰與閃電，然後用幾個法術四處傳送。最終，他的死因是他因為我的火焰法術留在他劍上的熱度而條件反射地丟掉了劍，而我抓住了這個機會。到了這個時候，我們兩人都覺得被這場戰鬥耗盡了力氣，他幾乎無法躲開我最慢的攻擊。我給出的最後一擊是出於憐憫，為我所造成的他的痛苦做一個迅速的了結。我看著 Gareth 對我咧嘴笑著，彷彿知道自己會這樣死去，然後他閉上眼睛，身體化為沙子，隨風而逝。在那之後我倒向一側，力氣被抽乾、魔力耗盡，幾個小時後才醒來。我起身時感覺到身體裡有一股新的力量，雖然微小但確實存在。總而言之，突然擁有不死之身相當令人失望，但事情就是這樣發生的。」此時我被他的話震驚得說不出話來——不是他說了什麼，而是他說話的方式：幾乎沒有感情或強調。就像他只是說他多了一道新疤痕或開始下雨了。他對得到一本稀有的書，比對不死還要情緒化。瞥了一眼其他人，我看得出他們也在思索這些資訊。幾分鐘後，我的弟弟開口發問。「那麼……那之後你的生活有很大改變嗎？」Demir 問 Magus，然後咬了一口他似乎憑空變出來的三明治。「不太有。不死者的生活和凡人的生活一樣。更多研究、更多學習、更多魔法。」「從那之後你有遇過其他不死者嗎？」Bella 問。「兩位，而我恰好與他們兩位都有親屬關係。」「親屬？」Tiberius 好奇地問，「我從不知道你有親人。」「嗯，他們從來沒被提起過。其中一位是我哥哥，他在幾十年前開始研究 Myst，之後就音訊全無。我預期他每當想家的時候就會來待個幾天，然後又失去聯繫。」「那另一位不死者呢？」Bella 感興趣地問。「另一位是我的妻子。」我們再次全都陷入驚愕的沉默，Tiberius 和 Demir 張大了嘴。「你結婚了！從什麼時候？」過了片刻，Bella 問。「幾個世紀前。我們是在與一名死靈法師打一場小戰爭時認識的，她是領導軍隊的人。當然，當時大多數人不知道她真正的性別。她努力隱瞞，這樣部隊才不會用不同的眼光看待她。我被請去協助處理整件事中的『不死大軍』細節，這讓我和她共事。一件事接著另一件，我們在戰爭結束後幾個月就結婚了。目前她擔任 Conglomeration 防衛部隊的指揮官，所以很少有時間回家。」問題又持續了半小時，從『你真的開啟了第一批下界傳送門嗎？』到『你為什麼在 Conglomeration 董事會？』Magus 以一個已經做過這一切的人的神態回答了我們所有的問題。問題結束後，其他人都開始回房休息，而我則順道去了藏書室查點東西。Talus 王國在將近一千年前就滅亡了。哇……自從我上次在這本書上寫字已經過了幾個月。過去幾週我認識的人比過去幾年都多，其中許多來自我從未涉足過的土地！國王與王后、統治者與領主、來自每個國家的執行長與所有者。然後是與凋零怪的戰鬥……我不確定該對這一切說些什麼。我大概就是走進去，灌下幾瓶藥水，然後讓與 Magus 多年的訓練接管一切。等我的腎上腺素衰退時，我們已經殺死了所有的凋零怪，而我只隱約意識到腿上有一陣鈍痛。Magus 用法術限制了我的行動，這樣我在斷腿癒合期間就不會離開這張床，因為我『可能』試圖偷溜進實驗室一兩次去工作。目前，我必須滿足於我的筆記本，以及 Magus 從他的藏書室為我帶來的書，來打發日子……
notes: 人名／地名（Tiberius、Magus、Vlad、Demir、Bella 等）保留英文

english_value: I've only had a little time at my chemistry set, so I haven't had much time to experiment with my new orb. All my tests trying to make new reagents failed, and I so far have only managed to make two new runic slates for my brother (but we have been trying to find new uses for them). The normal runic slate is a simple upgrade to the old cracked slates by infusing Terrae into them. The final slate, dubbed imbued, is two runic slates bound together with Magicales, Incendium, and Aquasalus. These days I've been working with the others on a few secret projects, so I have needed to keep up with and research all kinds of strange subjects. I also always seem to need to make more reagents, as our experiments burn through them rather quickly... I will write more when I have the time.
zh_tw: 我在化學套件前的時間很少，所以沒有多少時間用我的新血球做實驗。我所有試圖製作新試劑的測試都失敗了，到目前為止，我只成功為我哥哥製作了兩種新的符文石板（但我們一直在尋找它們的新用途）。普通的符文石板是對舊的裂痕石板的簡單升級，方法是將 Terrae 灌注進去。最後一種石板被稱為灌輸石板，是將兩塊符文石板用 Magicales、Incendium 和 Aquasalus 結合在一起。這些日子我一直在與其他人合作進行幾個祕密專案，所以我需要跟進並研究各種奇怪的主題。我似乎也總是需要製作更多試劑，因為我們的實驗消耗得相當快……等我有時間時，我會寫更多。

english_value: Now its time for the Omega Ritual. So the Omega armor is an upgrade from the normal Bound Armor from Blood Magic. You hve to Building a the Omega Chamber the most complicated and most important part of the Omega ritual. The duration and protection of your Omega Armor will be almost completely based on this. The idea behind the ritual is that activating the ritual releases the reagents like a gas from the master ritual stone. However the gas must be contained in order to empower your armor, so the chamber must be completely sealed when you activate the ritual. Once the reagent gas has entered your armor, the chamber may be broken and you can exit. Because it is a gas, the volume of the chamber is not important. Every FACE of a block the is exposed to the gas once the ritual is activated counts for 1 point of stability.
zh_tw: 現在該進行 Omega 儀式了。Omega 護甲是血魔法中一般綁定護甲的升級版。你必須建造 Omega 腔室，這是 Omega 儀式中最複雜也最重要的部分。你的 Omega 護甲的持續時間與防護力幾乎完全取決於它。這個儀式的原理是：啟動儀式時，試劑會像氣體一樣從主儀式石釋放出來。然而，這股氣體必須被封閉起來才能強化你的護甲，所以啟動儀式時腔室必須完全密封。當試劑氣體進入你的護甲後，就可以拆開腔室離開了。因為是氣體，腔室的體積並不重要。儀式啟動時，每一個暴露在氣體中的方塊「面」都算作 1 點穩定性。
